Tags: [CONFIRMED] = I saw the real source. [BRIEF] = stated by the developer, source not seen. [WRITTEN] = I wrote it, never run in Studio. [SEEN] = the developer ran it and described what happened. [ASSUMED] = a guess that still needs checking.

## 0. HOW TO WORK WITH ME
>>> RULE ZERO [v7, Oct 7 2026]. READ THIS BEFORE WRITING ANY SCRIPT. The dev's exact words (he was angry; he must never have to say it twice):
    "Use the fucking EventUtil idk why you needed to make 2. Just update the excisting one and add onto it, if you don't have it; Ask for it, then COMMIT IT to your DOCUMENT so you DON'T have to ASK FOR IT AGAINN. I dont want you making new scripts for excisting ones unless you have to"
  What I did wrong: his game already had Systems/EventUtil (the helper his events use). On Oct 4 a chat wrote a second helper next to it (Systems/EventKit) and on Oct 7 another chat wrote a THIRD (Systems/EventKit2), each time because the source of the existing one was not in this document. The right move was to ask for EventUtil and add to it.
  The rule, every time:
  1. ONE SCRIPT PER JOB. Before creating ANY new ModuleScript / Script / LocalScript, check section 2 (Studio layout), the file maps and section 99 (source library). If a script for that job already exists: CHANGE THAT SCRIPT. Add the new functions to it and send it back in full as a REPLACE. Never put a "2", "V2", "New", "Kit", "Helper", "Plus", "Extra" copy next to it, and never write a wrapper module around an existing module just to add functions to it.
  2. SERVER HELPERS FOR EVENTS LIVE IN Systems/EventUtil. Nowhere else. A new helper function for events is ADDED TO EventUtil. (EventKit and EventKit2 are the mistake. [v11] EventKit2 IS FOLDED IN (Oct 8, section 25.2; source 99.2). [v12] and it is DELETED from his game: the Oct 7 events require EventUtil now. EventKit, the Oct 3-4 one, still has to be folded in and needs his Studio copy: ask for Systems/EventKit ONCE.)
  3. CLIENT HELPERS FOR EVENT VISUALS: the dev's ReplicatedStorage/Utility (camera, screen, emit, fade) and Shared/EventFX (parts, rigs, particles, banners; it CALLS Utility for every camera / screen effect). Add to those two, never a third. EventFX exists only because a client cannot require anything in ServerScriptService; the dev has NOT said whether he is fine with it being separate from Utility. If he says "put it in Utility": ask for Utility's source and move it.
  4. IF I DO NOT HAVE THE SOURCE of the script I have to change (not in section 99, not pasted in this chat): ASK FOR IT by its exact name and place, in ONE short line. Do not guess its API, do not write around it, do not make a new one.
  5. COMMIT IT. The moment he pastes a shared / helper script, its FULL source goes into section 99 of this document (verbatim, dated). Every time I change such a script, its block in section 99 is replaced in the same delivery. A script that is in section 99 is NEVER asked for again (only if he says he changed it himself in Studio).
  6. A NEW SCRIPT IS ONLY OK WHEN I HAVE TO: nothing exists for that job (a new event = one new Events module + one new EventClients module; a brand-new feature), or the existing script cannot hold it (client vs server). Then say in ONE line in the delivery why it had to be new.
  7. BEFORE SENDING a delivery: list every NEW script in it and check each against point 6. Also list every script name that could look like a copy of something he already has, and rename or merge it.
>>> RULE ONE [v21, Oct 8 2026]. PRE-BUILT ASSETS UNDER THE EVENT, NOT SCRIPT-BUILT ONES. READ THIS BEFORE MAKING ANYTHING A PLAYER CAN SEE. The dev's words (line breaks removed; his whole message is kept verbatim in 37.6; it opened with "UPDATE THE MASTER DOCUMENT."):
    "From now on, I do NOT want you to build stuff in scripts unless necessary. When I say this, I mean BIG, COMPLEX THINGS. Its fine to spawn a part or whatnot, but, making an entire event's assets is a no go. THIS DOES NOT MEAN DON'T MAKE ASSETS. What I am asking of you, is that you make the assets, put it UNDER the event so its contained, and DOESN'T have to be BUILT from SCRATCH everytime. The assets should be sent in the .rbxm file, so its ready. Why? Instance.new() is more expensive than clone(). If you spawn 50+ parts for an event, that's a lot more expensive."
  What I did wrong: since Oct 7 every client-drawn event assembles its whole look in Init from single parts (FX.Rig():Block():Ball():Cyl(), FX.AddImp / AddSkull / AddGhost, the goblin's buildRig tables), and the server-built events before that did the same with Instance.new on the server. Dozens of Instance.new calls every time an event runs.
  The rule, every time:
  1. I STILL MAKE THE ASSETS. A monster, rig, prop, vehicle, set piece, or any piece that is used many times (a tentacle segment, a firecracker, a spider, a step) is a MODEL of real instances that I author and send INSIDE the delivery .rbxmx ("the .rbxm file" in his words). Code only CLONES it, then moves / poses / tweens / recolours it.
  2. WHERE: under the event's own script, ServerScriptService/Events/<Module>/<Asset>. That is his own convention (Gargoyle, Shed, Vampire, DinnerTable, LampPost sit there) and it needs no new code [CONFIRMED from the sources in 99]: EventSystem.mirrorAssets (99.7) clones every non-script child of an event module into ReplicatedStorage/EventAssets/<Id> when the server starts, and EventVisualsClient.build (99.1) clones EventAssets/<Id>/<asset> for Visuals.Spawn / EventUtil.Show(context, "<asset>", ...); it only asks the client module's Build for a placeholder when nothing with that name is there. So a Model named EXACTLY like the asset the server shows arrives in the FX.Module visual as self.Inst, already cloned (ONE Clone, no Instance.new): Init finds its pieces by name instead of building them. Details: 37.1.
  3. Pieces the CLIENT clones many times (segments, projectiles, debris, a spider) = more Models under the same script, cloned from ReplicatedStorage.EventAssets[<Id>]. Things players STAND on or the server needs (decks, steps, a prop with a prompt) = cloned on the server from the event script's own children. Helpers for this are ADDED to Shared/EventFX and Systems/EventUtil (RULE ZERO), e.g. one that turns a cloned model into an FX.Rig (Rig.Add takes a part that already exists), so the posing code of an event stays and only its build code goes.
  4. STILL FINE IN CODE ("Its fine to spawn a part or whatnot"): one part or a few (a marker, an anchor for a sound, a hit box), particles / beams / lights made on the fly, things whose shape only exists at run time (a line between two moving points), a clone of something that is already in the game (a plate). [MY NUMBER, not his] more than about 5 parts for one thing = it belongs in the file.
  5. HOW I BUILD THOSE MODELS (so the framework places them right and he can restyle them in Studio without touching code): ONE Model per asset; PrimaryPart = an invisible UNROTATED part named Root at the ground point; front = -Z; every part Anchored with CanCollide / CanQuery / CanTouch false (the framework sets that again on the clone); no scripts inside; every piece the code moves is its own named part or sub-Model (the NAMES are the contract with the code: say in _Notes which names must stay); emitters, lights, attachments and sounds are in the model too (a burst emitter = Enabled false + an EmitCount attribute, his Utility.Emit convention, 9b); colours and materials live in the model, not in the code. The framework wipes the ROOT's attributes on the clone: a setting goes on a child. Keep models lean: everything under Events is copied to every client when it joins.
  6. DELIVERY: the assets travel as children of their event script inside the ONE update .rbxmx (pack_update.py: X.children/ next to X.lua, raw .xml Items, 33.4). The installer (32.1) ADDS an asset that is missing and KEEPS his when one with that name exists; an asset I changed carries the attribute DMPReplace = true and _Notes says it replaces his. Assets are mirrored ONCE, when the server starts: restart Play after installing. NEVER tell him to drag-replace an event script (his models and mine are its children, 26.1).

## 1. CONCEPT
Gothic plate-survival (like Plates of Fate). Grid of plates (Plate_N, GameConfig.PlateSize Vector3, spacing capped by GameConfig.MaxPlateGap 7.5; default plate 20x1x20 with 7.5 gap, 5x5) around Workspace.Map.Plates.Center.
Random overlapping events every GameConfig.EventInterval (default 5s); last alive wins (solo testing: the round runs until you die). R6 avatars.
Soul (signed number): + = Ghost, - = Vampire, 0 = unaligned. Haunt (buff) +5 (Vampire haunting +10), Feed (debuff) -5 (Ghost feeding -10). 1 feed/haunt per match; final action on death. Exposure rule exists.
Currency: Candles. Round rewards: +5 played, +1/15s alive, +25 win.
Data: ProfileService via DataManager (Soul, Candles, Wins, RoundsPlayed, Settings as "Setting_<Key>" attributes). Inventory has its OWN DataStore. Pet nicknames: DataStore "DMP_PetNames".

## 4. CONFIRMED CORE APIs (source seen)
### Stats (Systems/Stats) [CONFIRMED]
Stats.Get(player, stat), Stats.AddModifier(player, stat, {Add=,Mult=}, id?) -> id (string; own id replaces), Stats.RemoveModifier(player, id), Stats.ClearModifiers(player), Stats.Apply(player).
Stats: MaxHealth (base GameConfig.BaseStats.MaxHealth), WalkSpeed (base from config), Jump (multiplier, base 1), Regen (HP/s), DamageTaken (base 1), Gravity (base 1; implemented with a VectorForce). Final = (base + all Adds) * all Mults; minimums: MaxHealth 1, others 0.
Modifiers belong to the CHARACTER: reset to {} on every CharacterAdded. Gaining MaxHealth also heals that much; losing it clamps. Regen tick every 0.5s. Removes Roblox's default "Health" script.
### EventUtil (Systems/EventUtil) [CONFIRMED]
[v11] THE server helper for events (RULE ZERO): new helper functions are ADDED HERE, never to a new module. ITS FULL SOURCE IS SECTION 99.2 (his Studio copy pasted Oct 8 + everything from EventKit2 + Announce): never ask for it again, cut it out of 99.2 and work in it. The list below is his original 23 functions; the 55 folded-in names are listed in 25.2.
GetRemote(name); IsAlive(player) (Alive attr true + in Players); GetAlivePlayers() (fresh list every call); GetRoot(player) -> root, humanoid; GetFeetY(root, humanoid); GetVerticalSpan(player) -> feetY, headY; GetPlayersInRadius(pos, radius, height=10) (flat radius, |dy| <= height, alive only); GetPlateTop(plate); MakePart(props) (Anchored, no collide/query/touch, smooth surfaces; Parent applied last); CreateWarningCircle(pos, r, parent); TweenModel(model, cf, time, trash, style, dir) (yields); PrepareModel(model, canQuery?); GetTemplate(container, name, build, canQuery?); BuildModel(name, parts); Push(player, velocity, duration); GetPlayersOnSpot(pos, radius, surfaceY, height?); Arc(a, b, t, height); MakePrompt(pos, action, object, hold, parent) -> anchor, prompt; GetPlateUnder(player, plates); PickPlate(plates) -> plate, player?; PickPlayersPlate(getPlate) -> plate, player; Notify(player, title, text?, color?); GetGroundOffset(model) (pivot height above lowest point).
### PlateSpawner (Systems/PlateSpawner) [CONFIRMED]
SpawnPlates(players, layout?) -> {[UserId]=plate} (random plate each; plate attrs Row, Col, OwnerUserId; UPDATED Oct 4 session 3, see the layout note after this block), GetPlate(player), GetOwner(plate), GetSpawnCFrame(player), GetPlateAt(row,col), GetRow(row), GetColumn(col), GetAllPlates() (CLONED list), GetOwnedPlates(), DestroyPlate(plate) (removes from grid and ownership, 4 crumbling chunks via Debris 4s, destroys the plate -> whoever stood on it falls into the void), GetGridSize() -> rows, cols, GetCenter(), Clear(). Uses ServerStorage.PlateTemplate if present. Plates sit at Center's Y; plate top = Center.Y + PlateSize.Y/2. Grid grows only if more players than plates.
PlateSpawner layout (session 3, [WRITTEN, never run]): layout = { Count, Scale } (from RoundModifiers.GetPlateLayout()) REPLACES the grid with Count plates in one row along X, centred on Center, each GameConfig.PlateSize x Scale in X and Z (thickness unchanged), spacing = plate width + GameConfig.MaxPlateGap, Row=1, Col=1..Count. When there are more players than plates they are dealt round-robin onto them (players shuffled), several share a plate, and GetSpawnCFrame spreads them in a circle (radius = clamp(n*6/2pi, 4, plate half-size - 2.5), slot = order dealt). The OwnerUserId attr is only the FIRST player dealt onto a plate; GetPlate(player) is right for everyone. GetOwnedPlates() returns each plate ONCE. DestroyPlate also clears the shared-plate bookkeeping. createPlate takes an optional size. RISK: any event that reads GameConfig.PlateSize instead of plate.Size treats big plates as small (Cursed Tree's aura radius is one suspect).
### EventSystem (Systems/EventSystem) [CONFIRMED]
Loads every ModuleScript under ServerScriptService.Events (GetDescendants) that returns a table with Name + Run. Event = { Name, Id, Weight, Duration, Target = "Player"|"Arena", Run(context) }. Id defaults to the module name.
context = { Event, Target, TargetPlate, Center, Folder (workspace.Map.EventObjects/<name>, destroyed at end), Trash, IsRunning(), ListenForHits(fn), Visuals }.
context.Trash is EventSystem's OWN table: call with a DOT, context.Trash.Add(x). Accepts an Instance (destroyed), a connection (disconnected), or a function (run with task.spawn). Cleaned in REVERSE order of adding. The Folder is item 1, so it is destroyed LAST (a cleanup function you add runs before the Folder is destroyed). Systems/Trash is a different module (method style, unused by EventSystem).
CRITICAL: when Duration elapses the event's MAIN thread is CANCELLED (task.cancel) and Trash is cleaned. Code after a long wait never runs; do cleanup through Trash. Threads you task.spawn yourself are NOT cancelled (check context.IsRunning()).
ListenForHits(fn): one listener per event Name; clients fire EventHit:FireServer(event.Name, ...); the server calls fn(player, ...) only if the player is Alive. The listener is removed when the event ends.
Events overlap. chooseEvent never repeats the last event and skips ones still running. Targeting for Player events is weighted by player attr "EventTargetWeight" (default 1); attr "BlackCat" sends the event to someone else once. EventSystem.Run(event, forcedTarget?) -> duration|nil; RunRandom(); PrepareNext() (called SixthSenseLead early; Sixth Sense players get a "SixthSense" ClientEffect); Find(name/id); GetEventNames(); GetEventList() -> {{Id,Name}}; StopAll() (called at round end; also stops everything for /stopevents).
Attrs on ReplicatedStorage: ActiveEvent, ActiveEventTarget, EventId.
Assets: non-script children under an event's script (or a same-named sibling in Events) are copied to ReplicatedStorage.EventAssets/<Id> at startup (stop/restart the test after adding a model/sound).
### Event visuals framework (Systems/EventVisuals + StarterPlayerScripts/EventClients/EventVisualsClient) [CONFIRMED]
Server: context.Visuals = { Spawn(asset, cframe, props?) -> id (auto-destroyed with the event), Circle(pos, r, color?), Move(id, cf), Tween(id, cf, time, style?, dir?) (style/dir are enum NAME strings, e.g. "Linear","In"), Call(id, method, ...) (remembered and replayed to late joiners), Signal(id, method, ...) (NOT remembered), Destroy(id) }. Asset names starting with "@" are built on the client ("@Circle": Radius, Color, Transparency). Late joiners get every active Spawn + its Calls.
Client lookup: ReplicatedStorage.EventClients/<event Id> (ModuleScript). Spawn on the client: build = clone EventAssets/<Id>/<asset> (root attributes cleared) else module.Build(asset, props) placeholder; prepare = EVERY part Anchored=true and CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch=false; PivotTo(cframe); Parent to workspace.ClientEventVisuals; module.Spawned(inst, state, props). state.Asset = asset name.
Module hooks: Build(asset, props), Spawned(inst, state, props), Render(inst, state, base, dt) (if defined it positions the visual; base = tween-updated CFrame; an error in Render disables Render for that visual), any method name callable via Visuals.Call/Signal -> fn(inst, state, ...), Destroyed(inst, state). props may contain numbers, strings, Vector3, CFrame, Color3 (Call args with a Vector3 worked for the piranha Strike).
Rules: rotated cylinder placeholders need an UNROTATED invisible PrimaryPart or PivotTo tips the model; to make a part SOLID (boat/deck) set CanCollide/CanQuery true in Spawned (again via task.defer) and give it AssemblyLinearVelocity every frame; to ANIMATE a rig, unanchor everything except the HumanoidRootPart (the framework anchors all parts). The framework PivotTo(cframe) turns a cloned model to its OWN pivot orientation, which can lay a custom model on its side: fix orientation inside Spawned.
### RoundManager (Script) [CONFIRMED]
Players.CharacterAutoLoads=false; every spawn = player:LoadCharacter(). `alive` table mirrors the "Alive" attr. eliminate(player, reason): alive=false, Rewards.OnEliminated, FeedHaunt.GrantFinalAction (unless "left"). Elimination sources: Humanoid.Died; CharacterRemoving without a replacement; checkForFallen (root.Y < Center.Y - GameConfig.VoidDepth -> FeedHaunt.TrySaveFromVoid else Health=0); ANY script setting attr "Alive"=false ("taken out").
runRound: participants = DataManager.IsLoaded and not AFK -> SpawnPlates(participants, RoundModifiers.GetPlateLayout()) -> spawnOnPlate (LoadCharacter then PivotTo GetSpawnCFrame) -> setAlive(true) -> Rewards.StartRound -> RoundModifiers.StartRound -> loop (event every RoundModifiers.EventInterval(GameConfig.EventInterval); RoundModifiers.EventsPerTick() extra RunRandoms; ItemCrates.Drop() every CrateEvery events; PrepareNext SixthSenseLead early) -> end (alive <= 1, or 0 when solo, or MaxRoundTime): EventSystem.StopAll, ItemCrates.ClearAll, RoundModifiers.EndRound, winners Alive=false, Rewards.EndRound, EndScreenTime, LoadCharacter winners, PlateSpawner.Clear.
runIntermission (session 3): ModifierVote.Open() when the countdown starts; on /skipcountdown or when the timer hits 0 -> ModifierVote.Close() (queues the winner) -> round; if players drop below GameConfig.MinPlayers -> ModifierVote.Cancel() (a new vote with fresh options opens next countdown). /skipcountdown while WAITING for players skips the vote (no modifier). The vote is open for the whole countdown.
Solo testing: the round runs until you die; dying ends the round AND the event (Alive=false + StopAll).
Commands: /skipcountdown, /pause. VoidServer: parts tagged "Void" set Alive=false (if in round) then LoadCharacter.
### ItemCrates (Systems/ItemCrates) [CONFIRMED]
Drop(count?) (default ceil(alive * GameConfig.CratesPerPlayer), one per plate max; items = random Tool from ServerStorage.Items (searched recursively)), ClearAll(). Chest model ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Chest, client module "crates" (Chest Animation: Motor6D rig + owned animation; falls back to swinging Hinge). Prompt "Open"/"Chest" hold 0.3. Chests last 40s or until their plate breaks.

### Commands (Systems/Commands) + DevCommands (Script) [CONFIRMED, source seen Oct 3 2026]
Commands: creates ReplicatedStorage.Remotes (Folder) if missing, plus CommandReply (RemoteEvent, shown by CommandReplyClient) and AdminRequest (RemoteFunction).
- Commands.Register("/alias", function(player, args) ... end): the alias INCLUDES the slash. Makes a TextChatCommand (Name = alias without "/" + "Command", PrimaryAlias = alias) under TextChatService.TextChatCommands; args = the words typed after the command, as a table of strings ("/damage 25" -> {"25"}).
- Commands.Run(player, alias, args): ADMIN ONLY (non-admins are silently ignored), pcall-wrapped; a thrown error replies "<alias> errored: ...".
- Commands.IsAdmin: Studio = always true; else GameConfig.AdminUserIds, the game creator (user-owned) or group rank 255 (group-owned).
- Commands.Reply(player, text, isError?): print/warn to Output AND fires CommandReply to that player (their chat).
- Commands.FindPlayer(name) -> player | nil, "none"|"ambiguous": exact username/display name first, then a UNIQUE start-of-name match; a leading "@" is ignored.
- Commands.TakeTarget(player, args) -> Player? : MUTATES args (table.remove). First word "me"/"@me" = the caller (word removed); a word naming a player = that player (word removed); an "@Name" that matches nobody replies an error and returns NIL (so every command does `if not target then return end`); any other word = the caller, args untouched (a player named "Bat" beats the argument "bat": say "me" first).
- Commands.AddProvider(name, fn(player)): extra data for the admin panel. AdminRequest requests (all admin-gated): "IsAdmin", "GetCommands" (sorted aliases), "Run"(alias, argText), or any provider name (e.g. "GetEvents").
- To add a command: Commands.Register("/name", function(player, args) local target = Commands.TakeTarget(player, args) if not target then return end ... Commands.Reply(player, "...") end). The admin panel lists it automatically. Any module can register a command (the Excalibur module registers /giveexcalibur itself).
DevCommands (Script in ServerScriptService; requires Commands, Stats, Damage, EventSystem, FeedHaunt, DataManager, ItemCrates, SigilScythe). Locals: reply = Commands.Reply, takeTarget = Commands.TakeTarget, who(player, target) -> "You" or DisplayName, simplify(text) = lowercase with spaces/apostrophes removed (fuzzy item matching).
  /damage [t] n (default 10): Damage.Deal(target, n, {Source="DevCommand"}) -> dealt. /kill [t]: Damage.Kill. /heal [t] n (default 25): Damage.Heal -> healed.
  /setstat [t] Stat n -> pcall(Stats.AddModifier, target, stat, {Mult=n}, "Dev_Set_"..stat); /addstat -> {Add=n}, id "Dev_Add_"..stat (an unknown stat makes AddModifier error, hence the pcall); /resetstats [t]: Stats.ClearModifiers.
  /shield [t]: Damage.AddHandler(target, "DevShield", 10, fn) cancels the next hit, then RemoveHandler. /bring <t>: target:PivotTo(caller pivot * CFrame.new(0,0,-5)) (needs another player).
  /setevent <name>: only while ReplicatedStorage GameState == "InRound"; EventSystem.Find(table.concat(args," ")) then EventSystem.Run(event) (truthy = started). /listevents (EventSystem.GetEventNames), /stopevents (EventSystem.StopAll); provider "GetEvents" -> EventSystem.GetEventList().
  /soul [t] n: FeedHaunt.SetSoul, replies Soul + FeedHaunt.GetSide. /feed, /haunt [t] query: FeedHaunt.ApplyEffect(nil, target, "Feed"|"Haunt", table.concat(args," ")) -> effect (.Name) or nil. /listfeeds, /listhaunts: FeedHaunt.GetEffectNames(kind). /resetaction [t]: target:SetAttribute("ActionUsed", false).
  Items: getItems() = every Tool under ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Items", true). /giveitem [t] <name|all>, /giveallitems [t], /listitems clone tools into the target's Backpack (first fuzzy match). /givescythe [t]: SigilScythe.Give(target) (tops up charges if they already have it; dash/slash only work while Alive, i.e. in a round).
  /data [t]: DataManager.GetAll(target) (table or nil), printed sorted. /candles [t] n: DataManager.Set(target, "Candles", floor(n)). /spawncrates [n] (InRound only): ItemCrates.Drop(n or nil) -> count dropped.
API facts confirmed by usage: Damage.Deal -> dealt number, Damage.Heal -> healed number, Damage.Kill(target, {Source=}), Damage.AddHandler(target, id, priority, fn(context)) with context.Amount / context.Source / context.Cancelled, Damage.RemoveHandler(target, id); FeedHaunt.SetSoul/GetSoul/GetSide/ApplyEffect/GetEffectNames as above; DataManager.GetAll / DataManager.Set(player, key, value); EventSystem.Find returns the event or nil.

## 5. APIs FROM THE BRIEF (source NOT seen) [BRIEF]
- Damage: Deal(player, amt, {Source=}) -> dealt; Heal(player, amt, {Source=}); Kill(player, {Source=}); AddHandler(player, id, priority, fn(ctx)) (ctx.Amount, ctx.Source, ctx.Cancelled=true blocks); RemoveHandler(player, id). I assume Kill/Deal work on any alive player. (Usage confirmed in DevCommands, see section 4.)
- DataManager: AddCandles(player, amount) (negative = spend), IsLoaded, GetAll, Set(player, key, value).
- FeedHaunt: SetSoul, GetSoul, GetSide(soul), ApplyEffect(nil, target, "Feed"|"Haunt", query) -> effect{Name}, GetEffectNames(kind), GrantFinalAction(player), TrySaveFromVoid(player).
- Rewards: StartRound(players), EndRound(winners), OnEliminated(player).
- Inventory (Systems): IsLoaded, Has, GetOwned, Add, Remove (also clears wheels/loadout/pet), Wipe -> count, GetWheels, SetWheelSlot, GetLoadout(player) -> list copy, isNew, SetLoadout(player, list), GetPet(player), SetPet(player, id?), OnLoaded, OnAdded, OnRemoved. Saves additively (UpdateAsync merge) but tracks removals/wipes; saved fields Owned, Wheels, Loadout, Pet. Attrs "Owned_<Id>", "EmoteWheels" (JSON 2x8), "ToolLoadout" (JSON id list), "EquippedPet", "InventoryLoaded"/"InventoryFailed".
- Receipts: THE ONLY ProcessReceipt. Receipts.Register(productId, fn(player, receipt) -> bool).
- ShopWebhook.Send(kind, title, description, color); kinds MainStock, LuxuryStock, BellRestock, LuxuryPass, ModifierWheel.
- Toast (client): Toast.Show(title, text, color, {FadeTitle=true}). Server->player toast: ClientEffect:FireClient(player, "Notify", {Title, Text, Color}) or EventUtil.Notify.
- ReplicatedStorage attrs: GameState ("WaitingForPlayers"/"Intermission"/"Starting"/"InRound"/"Ending"), Timer, EventTimer, EventsPaused, ActiveEvent, ActiveEventTarget, EventId, LastWinners, ShopStock, ShopRefreshAt, LuxuryStock, LuxuryRefreshAt, QueuedModifiers, ActiveModifiers.
- Player attrs: Alive, AFK, Candles, Soul, Pass_Luxury, Pass_ExtraSlots, Pass_SecondWheel (emote passes), Pass_ItemSlots, ToolSlots, ToolLoadout, EquippedPet, PetName_<PetId>, PlayingEmote, PersonalShopStock, PersonalShopUntil, ActionUsed, Setting_<Key>, SixthSense, BlackCat, EventTargetWeight, JumpCooldown (Gargoyle's Weight).
- GameConfig fields seen: PlateSize (Vector3), ArenaSize, GridRows, GridCols, SkipCenterCell, MaxPlateGap, SpawnHeight, VoidDepth, RespawnDelay, MinPlayers, IntermissionTime, MaxRoundTime, EndScreenTime, SixthSenseLead, EventInterval, CrateEvery, CratesPerPlayer, BaseStats {MaxHealth, WalkSpeed, JumpPower, JumpHeight, RegenPerSecond}, AdminUserIds.
- StatusEffectsClient [CONFIRMED]: handlers on ClientEffect: Blind{Duration} (black overlay), BatShove (random shove + bat visual), ShadowGrasp{Duration}, SixthSense{Plate, EventName} (highlight + toast), Notify (Toast.Show); also the Gargoyle's Weight jump cooldown via attr "JumpCooldown". ScreenGui "StatusEffectsOverlay" (DisplayOrder 100).

### oldman — The Old Man [REWRITTEN Oct 4; WRITTEN, never run in Studio] (Events/OldMan; client "oldman" = source NOT seen)
Setup: his R6 rig (Model with a Humanoid, any name, front -Z) UNDER the OldMan script with a walk Animation inside (AnimationId owned by the dev/group); the hand-built workspace.Map.PocketDimension; OPTIONAL a Part / MeshPart / Union / Model named "Puddle" anywhere under the script (not inside the rig).
Event fields: Target "Arena", Weight 1, Duration 95 (was 80), IntroTime 2.5 (he rises out of the ooze), WalkSpeed 6 (studs/s, CONSTANT; raised automatically if the path is too long to finish inside Duration - IntroTime - FadeTime - PocketTime), PathOvershoot 22, StrollRing 0.65, StrollWobble 0.18, StrollWobbles 3 (keep an integer), StrollLaps 1, FadeTime 1.5, PuddleSpacing 8, PuddleAhead 12, PuddleRadius 7.2 (visual width AND touch radius; was 3.6), MaxPuddles 60, BodyRadius 3.2, TouchHeight 4, Immunity 5, PocketTime 30, BulletDamage 4, BulletSpeed 110, ShotGapMin 0.0083 / ShotGapMax 0.0233 (about 63 shots/s; originally 0.25-0.7), AimSpread 15, HitRadius 2.4. Locals: STEP 0.8, STROLL_ENTER 0.12, STROLL_LEAVE 0.12.
THE STROLL (replaced the straight line): makeStroll(y) = a wandering lap around the arena on an ellipse through the plate bounds (a, b = half extents): a spiral in from outside the edge (first 12% of the path), a ring at StrollRing of the arena that drifts in and out by StrollWobble StrollWobbles times, then a spiral back out (last 12%); random direction and start angle each time. CONSTANT SPEED: the path is sampled 800 times into cumulative arc lengths and positions are looked up by DISTANCE walked (the first version used the time fraction, so the spirals were ~60% faster than the ring and he left no puddles outside the arena: that was the "walks way too fast and leaves no puddle" bug). strollAt(distance) -> position, heading (finite difference). Clients get his movement as short Visuals.Tween steps (Linear, STEP 0.8s, each to the position + heading at the end of the step); the server uses the same maths for the puddles and for touching him. RISK: the client "oldman" module was never seen, and Visuals.Tween did NOT move models in the Vampiette shop earlier.
PUDDLES: server-built parts in context.Folder (replicate to everyone, destroyed with the event). One every PuddleSpacing studs of his walk (by distance, not time), placed PuddleAhead studs AHEAD of him on his route (none past the route end), ALWAYS placed: on the plate under him, else at plate-top height in the air over a gap / the void / outside the arena. Template = the dev's "Puddle" (cloned once per event, wrapped in a Model if a lone part, anchored, no collide, scripts removed, ScaleTo(2 * PuddleRadius / max(X,Z footprint)) uniform, authored rotation kept + a random yaw per puddle, set on the surface with EventUtil.GetGroundOffset, lift 0.03 + (n % 6) * 0.012 so overlapping puddles don't z-fight); no Puddle part = a flat dark cylinder disc (12,12,16, reflectance 0.1) that spreads out over 0.8s. NO spheres (those came from the client's old "Ooze" visual, which the server no longer spawns; the client module still has it, unused). The oldest puddle is destroyed past MaxPuddles.
POCKET: touching a puddle (feet within TouchHeight, flat distance <= PuddleRadius) or him (BodyRadius, while walking) pulls you into workspace.Map.PocketDimension; PocketTime 30 with toasts at 20/10/5 left; Immunity 5 after returning; everyone is returned at event end (Trash); safeReturn raycasts the plates else picks a random plate. Names the server reads: parts named "PocketSpawn"/"Spawn" (or a SpawnLocation) = spawn points (3.5 above the top); Models with "soldier" in their name = shooters (pivot = muzzle + chest, optional child "Muzzle"). Fallbacks: raycast spawn from the room middle, 8 virtual shooters around the edge. The room MUST sit above Center.Y - VoidDepth (the event warns if not). NO COVER: the dev removed all cover; the cover lookup and the bullet-blocking raycast are gone (the toast no longer says "hide behind cover").
SOLDIERS: fireBullet picks a shooter and a target on the other side of the room, then turns the shot a random +-AimSpread degrees about the vertical axis (so bullets sweep every spot you can stand on; horizontal only, bullets stay at chest height), sends the "Tracer" Signal on the PocketFX visual (from, to, serverTime, speed) and a server bullet (hit = segment distance <= HitRadius -> Damage.Deal BulletDamage). Shots come faster than the 0.05s loop, so up to 16 are fired per tick. BALANCE WARNING: at ~63 shots/s the damage per second is ~5x the 3x-rate version (players can die in seconds); lower BulletDamage if too lethal. Tracer traffic is heavy (one signal per shot to every client); batch them if it lags.
Client "oldman" (unseen): rig (unanchors all but the HRP, plays the walk Animation looped at ANIM_SPEED 0.5 x gait; drips on arms, steam on head), "PocketFX" anchor for Signal("Tracer", from, to, serverStartTime, speed), FadeOut(time).

### sigilknight — Mirrors of the Sigil Knight [WRITTEN, not run in Studio] (Events/DarkSigilKnight; no client module, no models)
Target "Arena", Duration 66, Weight 0.7. ONE mirror (server parts: silver glass, no sigil/light) on a random plate; MIRROR_LIFETIME 34, MIRROR_RADIUS 3.2; the first player near it is taken (others lose the race). The ROOM is HAND-BUILT by the dev (the code no longer builds it): a Model named "SigilRoom" in workspace.Map.EventRooms. Contract the script reads: DOORS = Parts or Models whose name is "door" + optional number (Door, Door1...; "DoorFrame" is ignored), at least 2 (4 = the 25/50/25 split), found recursively; there is NO interact button: you pick a door by WALKING INTO it. Every 0.1s the script checks the visitor's root position against each door's box (a Part's CFrame/Size, a Model's GetBoundingBox, saved at event start) padded by DOOR_TOUCH_PADDING 1.5 studs in every direction (door can be solid or not; raise the padding if doors are thick); the nearest door containing the position wins. Any ProximityPrompts inside the doors are ignored/untouched. SPAWN = a Part/Model/SpawnLocation named Spawn / SigilSpawn / PocketSpawn inside the room (player lands 3.5 above it with its facing), else a raycast onto the floor under the room's middle. The room must sit ABOVE Center.Y - VoidDepth or RoundManager kills the visitor. Missing room / fewer than 2 doors = warns in Output and skips the event. The dev removed the Knight (reaper) from the room, so there is NO Knight and NO hint any more.
Doors shuffled per event: 1 "Death" (25%), SCYTHE_DOORS = 2 "Scythe" (50%), the rest random "Blessing" (+25 max health via Stats.AddModifier and a full Damage.Heal) or "Loot" (random Tool from ServerStorage.Items + REWARD_CANDLES 15 via DataManager.AddCandles). Choosing (walking into a door): a safe door's parts flash gold and fade to transparent, the deadly door's parts tween to black, then the outcome; death = Damage.Kill + toast "The Knight banished <Name>!". Door colours/transparency are snapshotted at event start and restored in the Trash cleanup (the room is permanent, never destroyed). ROOM_TIME 15s: a 5-seconds-left toast, and if no door was walked into in time the Knight BANISHES you (toast "<Name> took too long and was banished!" + Damage.Kill). Return = the mirror's plate (or a random plate if it crumbled; PlateSpawner.GetAllPlates). Trash cleanup also returns anyone still inside. RequestStreamAroundAsync before the teleport. TEST_SCYTHE_EVERYWHERE = true makes every door the scythe and nobody dies. Test: /setevent sigilknight.
### Sigil Scythe (Systems/SigilScythe + StarterPlayerScripts/SigilScytheClient) [WRITTEN, not run in Studio except as the developer reported; source of both files seen Oct 4 2026]
KEPT for the round (removed when Alive turns false; not saved across rounds; NOT in ServerStorage.Items). Own model: any Tool whose name contains "scythe" inside ReplicatedStorage > Assets (searched recursively, cloned on every Give; needs a Handle; falls back to a Tool "SigilScythe" in ServerStorage, then to a parts-built placeholder with a one-time warning). API: `SigilScythe.Give(player, options?) -> Tool` (equips it; a second plain Give adds DUPLICATE_REFILL 3 slashes, cap MAX_CHARGES 12, unless the held tool has NoRefill), Has, AddCharges, Remove. options (all optional): Template (a Tool to clone instead of the scythe), Name, Charges (default START_CHARGES 6), Scale (slash size), Replace (destroy a held tool instead of refilling), Attributes (table copied to the tool). Tool attributes: SigilScythe = true, Charges (tooltip shows them), SlashScale, VfxPrefix, NoRefill, SlashAnimSpeed. findTool finds ONE such tool per player (a scythe and Excalibur can't be held together; Give with Replace swaps them).
- Slash (click while holding it, server-validated): click -> client plays the slash animation at once and fires "Slash"(hasMarker); the server checks cooldown 0.7 + a charge (uses one, no recharge), broadcasts "SlashStart"(userId), and WAITS for the strike: it happens when the animation reaches its marker named "Slash" (client: track:GetMarkerReachedSignal("Slash") -> remote "SlashMarker"), or after a fallback (MARKER_FALLBACK_DELAY 1.2s / the tool's SlashAnimSpeed with a marker animation, SLASH_HIT_DELAY 0.12s without one). On the strike (performSlash) it hits alive players within range = 9 x scale studs and height 8 x scale in a ~160 degree arc (SLASH_ARC_DOT 0.2): Damage.Deal 30 {Source="Sigil Scythe"} + EventUtil.Push knockback 70 + lift 26 for 0.25s, and broadcasts "Slash"(rootCFrame, scale, userId, hasMarker, vfxPrefix) to ALL clients. The scale is the tool's SlashScale attribute, else SLASH_SCALE 3 (scythe 3x = 27 studs; Excalibur 5x = 45 studs). Out of charges = toast "Out of slashes! Dashing still works."
- Dash (Q, or a DASH button on touch; unlimited; needs the tool in Backpack or hand): server cooldown 1.4, EventUtil.Push(player, dir * DASH_SPEED, 0.2) with DASH_SPEED = 95 * 0.7 (falls back to setting AssemblyLinearVelocity), 0.3s invulnerability via Damage.AddHandler "SigilDash" (priority 100, ctx.Cancelled = true), broadcasts "Dash"(userId, seconds). Direction = humanoid MoveDirection, else look vector. BLOCKED WHILE ROOTED: server isRooted = Stats.Get(player,"WalkSpeed") <= ROOTED_SPEED (1) refuses (cooldown not used, no afterimages, toast throttled 1.5s); the client skips it when Humanoid.WalkSpeed <= 1 and the panel shows "ROOTED!  CAN'T DASH" for 0.8s. Slash is still allowed while rooted.
- Client: ScreenGui "SigilScytheGui" (DisplayOrder 56) with a small dark-red panel "SLASH xN | Q DASH" above the hotbar; hooks Tool.Activated; afterimages = every 0.03s per body part an anchored dark-red ghost (90,15,30, transparency 0.35) fading to black + transparent in 0.45s (3x sparser when Setting_DisableParticles); all FX in workspace.SigilScytheFX.
- Animations: SLASH_ANIMATION_ID rbxassetid://128581954315815 (needs a keyframe marker named "Slash"; plays on the Animator at Action4, not looped, replicates to everyone); IDLE_ANIMATION_ID rbxassetid://130707616586255 (looped, Action, whenever the tool is in the hand); WALK_ANIMATION_ID rbxassetid://123953795001401 (looped, Action2, grounded and moving > 1 stud/s, speed = flatSpeed / WALK_ANIM_SPEED 16, clamped 0.2-2). They must be owned by the dev/group (Output warns). Excalibur uses the SAME three. Slash animation speed: on click `track:AdjustSpeed(tool attr SlashAnimSpeed or 1)`, at the "Slash" marker `AdjustSpeed(1)`. While SLASH_ANIMATION_ID is blank a built-in R6 RootJoint C0 twist swing runs locally on every client (twist direction a guess).
- Slash VFX (built on EVERY client from the "Slash" broadcast): vfxPrefix "" = ReplicatedStorage > Assets > SlashVFX + SlashProjectile, scaled by (server scale / VFX_BASE_SCALE 3) (Models via ScaleTo; offsets and projectile distance scale too); a prefix (Excalibur) = Assets > <prefix>VFX + <prefix>Projectile at REAL size (no scaling; size them for the 5x slash yourself); prefixed assets missing = one warning, then the default pair; both missing = old blue arc fallback. SlashVFX placed VFX_FORWARD_OFFSET 2 in front, flat, VFX_YAW; SlashProjectile starts PROJECTILE_START_OFFSET 2 in front and a Heartbeat loop flies it PROJECTILE_DISTANCE 20 along the attacker's forward (Quad Out), the dev's own tuning PROJECTILE_LIFETIME .25 and PROJECTILE_FADE_TIME 0.1, orientation = base * Angles(0, PROJECTILE_YAW -90, 0) * Angles(PROJECTILE_ROLL 90, 0, PROJECTILE_PITCH 0) (sync with the dev's copy before editing). prepare() anchors parts and turns off collisions; beams tween Width0/Width1 to 0 and parts fade (FADE_PARTS); ParticleEmitters with an "EmitCount" attribute get Emit(count), enabled ones keep emitting until the tween-out (all off when Setting_DisableParticles); VFX_LIFETIME 3 / BEAM_TWEEN_TIME 0.9; everything Debris-removed.
- Sounds in the tool's Handle (positional, each play restarts; a folder of Sounds plays all): `WindupSFX` the instant you click (other players: on "SlashStart"); `SlashingSFX` when the animation hits the "Slash" marker (other players: on the "Slash" broadcast); once per slash via slashSfxPending (marker first, else the broadcast).
- Camera effects (client, via ReplicatedStorage.Utility, attacker's own camera only). WIND-UP (a valid click = windupEffects): TweenFOV to BaseFOV - WINDUP_FOV_IN 10 over 0.35s, ShowVignette (transparency 0.55, color 10,20,50, in 0.25s) and a GROWING screenshake = Utility.ShakeRamp(0.03 -> 0.55 over 0.5s, roughness 14; deliberately teeny). NO lighting/colour change during the wind-up. STRIKE (the local marker, or the server's "Slash" broadcast when there is no marker animation = strikeEffects, once per wind-up via the windingUp flag): stops the ramp (0.06s fade), crash zoom TweenFOV to BaseFOV + 14 in 0.07s then ResetFOV(0.5), hit shake (5, 18, 0.02, 0.35) PLUS a lingering rumble (1.6, 9, fade in 0.15 / out 1.4), a tiny Blur (6, 1s), HideVignette(0.45), and a fresh Utility.ColorCorrection() tweened with Quad IN over 0.25s to {Brightness 0.06, Contrast 0.3, Saturation 0.4} with NO tint, then Reset over 0.7s and destroyed; skipped when tinting is off. WINDUP_TIMEOUT 1.5 puts everything back if the strike never comes. No flash anywhere. Needs the Utility module and PlayerGui > Vignette.
- Only works while the player's Alive attr is true (rounds). /givescythe [target] gives it (DevCommands).

Winner = full strength; others within NEAR_RANGE 120 = OTHERS_INTENSITY 0.5; farther = nothing. ### Server-built events (written Oct 3 2026, ALL [WRITTEN, never run in Studio]; Systems/EventKit + Events/<name>)
Shared by these ten (not piranha, see below): NO client modules and NO models, everything built from parts on the server (replicates to everyone), because Visuals.Move/Tween did not move models on clients earlier. Each is Target "Arena", cleans up through context.Trash (Folder destroyed last) and ends with `while context.IsRunning() do task.wait(0.25) end`. Systems/EventKit [WRITTEN] helpers: Part(name,size,cframe,color,material?,parent?) anchored non-colliding; Attach(base,name,size,offsetCFrame,color,material?,parent?) welded decoration that follows `base`; Shuffle; Tween(instance,props,time,style?,dir?); Announce(title,text,color?) = ClientEffect "Notify" to all; Plates() shuffled copy of PlateSpawner.GetAllPlates(); PlateAt(position,plates) / PlateUnder(player,plates) (X/Z bounds of UNROTATED plates + height window); ArenaCenter(plates) (Y = plate top) / ArenaRadius; Warning(position,radius,parent,color?,lifetime?) pulsing ground disc; FadeAndDestroy(instance,time); GiveRandomItem(player) (random Tool from ServerStorage.Items, recursive); AddCandles(player,n) (DataManager.AddCandles in a pcall); HasLantern(player) (a Tool whose name contains "lantern" in hand or Backpack). Damage/Stats/Push calls are the BRIEF/CONFIRMED APIs (Damage.Deal in pcall, EventUtil.Push in pcall).
- mimic — Mimic Plate (Duration 30): 1-4 plates (ceil(alive/2)) are mimics with only a faint hairline crack as a tell. Stand on one TRIGGER_TIME 0.5s: plate tweens blood red, a lid (welded square teeth) lifts to +15 and lower teeth rise (OPEN_TIME 0.6 = the warning), then CHOMP (lid slams in 0.12s): everyone still on the plate takes DAMAGE 40 and is launched up (Push 32). Mouth stays HOLD_TIME 1.4s then fades, plate colour restored, mimic spent (one chomp each).
- waves — Plate Waves (18): a sine ripple travels across the arena along a random direction (AMPLITUDE 3.5, SPEED 3 rad/s, WAVELENGTH 85, RAMP 1.5s ease in/out): every frame (Heartbeat) each plate's CFrame = base + dy and AssemblyLinearVelocity = dy/dt so riders are carried; plates restored in Trash. No damage (falls are the danger).
- skelhands — Skeleton Hands (30): 3 rounds; each round ceil(alive/2) (1-4) red circles (EventKit.Warning, radius 4) appear where random players stand, 1.4s later a hand (arm, palm, 5 two-part fingers, built sunk 7 studs under the plate and tweened up) erupts and GRABS everyone within GRAB_RADIUS 3.6: Stats WalkSpeed x0 and Jump x0.3 (so a tiny hop still happens), jumps counted from humanoid.StateChanged -> Jumping; JUMPS_TO_BREAK 6 within GRAB_TIME 4s frees them (Push up 38); otherwise SQUEEZE_DAMAGE 30 and release. Active victims are released in Trash. This server-side jump counting is UNVERIFIED (state replication); if it never frees anyone, a client remote is the fix. (The scythe dash is blocked while grabbed.)
- wreckingball — Wrecking Ball (60): a real pendulum (omega = sqrt(196.2 / length), length = clamp(arena radius, 45, 85)) from a crane head above the arena centre, lowest point 5 studs above the plates, THETA_MAX 58 degrees, swing plane turns at PRECESSION 0.1 rad/s, 3s ramp in/out; a 16-stud spiked ball (welded spikes), a stretched chain part and a ground shadow that grows/darkens as the ball comes down. Heartbeat moves it; a hit = within BALL_RADIUS 8 + 2.5 and ball speed > 6: Damage clamp(speed*0.6, 15, 45) and Push along its velocity (speed*1.1, max 120, +26 lift, 0.45s) = it keeps its momentum; 0.9s per-player cooldown.
- werewolf — Werewolf Moon (24; needs 2+ alive): a 120-stud Neon moon + halo rises over 3s behind the arena, one random player becomes a werewolf for WOLF_TIME 15s: R6 parts recoloured dark fur (originals saved), welded ears/red eyes/tail, a "WEREWOLF" BillboardGui, Stats WalkSpeed x1.45 / Jump x1.25; anyone within 5.5 studs gets Damage 10 + Push 75 (+30 lift), 1s cooldown per victim. Everything is undone (also in Trash and if the wolf dies).
- redlight — Red Light, Green Light (28): a skeleton DJ (hovering platform, booth, two turntables, bone skeleton with pink headphones; skull and arms bob with looping tweens that are paused on red) over the arena and a big beacon ball + billboard (GO! / READY... / FREEZE!). Cycle GREEN 3.5-5s, YELLOW 0.8s, RED 2.2-3.2s. After GRACE 0.35s into red, a player with Humanoid.MoveDirection > 0.05 or state Jumping takes DAMAGE 14 (0.7s cooldown, a one-time "You moved!" toast per red). MUSIC_ID is blank: set it to play on green and pause on red.
- wisp — Wisp Guide (22): per 3 players alive 1-3 HONEST wisps plus LIARS 3 (max 6 colours: Pink, Mint, Sky, Violet, Gold, Peach, shuffled) float from the centre to above their own plates (6s, smoothstep + bob); honest wisps' plates are safe. At IGNITE_AT 8s GHOSTFIRE lights every plate that is not safe (purple colour + flame emitter) for FIRE_TIME 6s: standing on one = Damage 8 per 0.5s. LANTERN: anyone with a Lantern Tool gets a private toast naming the honest wisp colours. Plates are recoloured/restored, emitters destroyed. (Design note: the fire is visible when it starts, so the wisps' value is pre-positioning.)
- goblin — Treasure Goblin (26): [v11: REWRITTEN Oct 8, section 25.3: same rules and numbers, but he is now an R6 character drawn by ReplicatedStorage/EventClients/goblin, and the script uses ONLY EventUtil.] Before: a green goblin with a sack of coins (parts welded to an anchored torso, "CATCH ME!" tag) hops from plate to plate (arcs, SPEED 32, HOP_HEIGHT 4, 0.25s pauses), choosing the reachable plate farthest from the nearest player. First player within CATCH_RADIUS 5 gets GiveRandomItem + 15 candles, coin burst, toast; nobody within RUN_TIME 20s = he escapes.
- piano — Haunted Piano (24): 12 giant white keys hang HOVER 34 above the plates, each a strip across the arena (plus decorative black keys). A key glows gold for WARN 0.55s then SLAMS (0.07s) and crushes anyone under that strip (|X - key X| <= half key width, below top+14): Damage 16 + Push up, 0.5s per-player cooldown; each key has a cooldown of ~1.07s. Rhythm: NOTES = nil by default so a frantic generated rhythm (runs, chords, hopping, STEP 0.22s, 16s) plays. RUSH E: I did NOT transcribe the song (copyrighted sheet music). The dev fills NOTES = {{t = seconds, key = 1..12}, ...} from their own transcription and SOUND_ID with their uploaded audio, and raises Event.Duration past the last note. [Session 3] Added KEY_SOUNDS = { [1..12] = "" } (key 1 = far LEFT/-X, key 12 = far RIGHT/+X): a per-key Sound parented to the key part (cleaned up with the event), KEY_SOUND_VOLUME 1, RollOffMinDistance 80 (keys hang 34 studs up), RollOffMaxDistance 800, played on SLAM (TimePosition reset to 0 first). SOUND_ID (the background track) is separate and still works. Delivered as HauntedPiano.lua.

### piranha — Piranha Plants [REWRITTEN twice; WRITTEN, tuned from the developer's Studio reports and one screenshot] (Events/PiranhaPlants + ReplicatedStorage/EventClients/piranha)
History: v1 built jointed jaws from parts (looked bad); v2 was a code-built plant (spring neck of spheres, grin mouth with fangs, Grass material); CURRENT: the developer's OWN plant model drives everything. The code-built look survives only as a client placeholder (module.Build) when no model exists. Piranha Plant is a Nintendo character: rename (e.g. "Snapper Plants") if the game goes public.
SERVER (Events/PiranhaPlants, Id "piranha", Weight 1, Duration 32, Target "Arena"): finds a Model UNDER the script (else any Model with "piranha" in its name under ServerScriptService); its name = the Visuals asset name (no model = "Plant" and the client builds the placeholder, with a warning); ensureReplicated copies it to ReplicatedStorage.EventAssets.piranha if missing (restart the test after changing the model). Spawns 3-6 plants (20% of plates, MIN 3 / MAX 6) on random plates with props Seed, Height 7, Base (the pot's ground point), Windup 0.45, Lunge 0.2, Hold 0.35, Retract 0.5, GrowTime 1.2, LeaveTime 1.2; calls Grow(startTime) / Strike(startTime, impactPoint) / Leave(startTime). A plant notices the nearest alive player within TRIGGER_RADIUS 8 (flat, height window), starts a strike NETWORK_LEAD 0.15s in the future (COOLDOWN 2.2s) and at t0 + WINDUP + LUNGE the server bites: everyone within BITE_RADIUS 5.5 (height 6) of the impact point takes Damage 22 and is spat out (Push 50 + lift 30, 0.35s). Plants leave LEAVE_TIME before the end; a crumbled plate takes its plant (Visuals.Destroy).
CLIENT (EventClients/piranha): the framework clones the model; Spawned finds the pieces by name and a RenderStepped loop drives them with math (no animations, no joints):
 - Neck = Stalk0..StalkN (sorted by number; reversed if Stalk0 is the head end), each placed along a quadratic curve from Stalk0's position (raised by NECK_LIFT) to the head's neck-attach point; the pieces keep their authored rotation (STALKS_FOLLOW_CURVE false = they never rotate).
 - Head group = every unit directly under the model that is not Root / static / a stalk; it moves rigidly with a spring head (sway, leans toward the nearest player within 40 studs, rears back, lunges, overshoots; MAX_NECK 15). TopJaw / BottomJaw (Models or Parts, found by name anywhere) are posed after the head. The model's POSE is the rest pose and the jaws are modelled OPEN: they idle open, open a bit wider on the wind-up (JAW_WINDUP_EXTRA 0.2), start closing during the lunge (at 35% of it) and clamp as it lands (close angle = atan(gap / 2 / lever) x JAW_CLOSE_SCALE 0.65 so a gap stays; JAW_CLOSE_ANGLE > 0 overrides), stay shut for the hold, then reopen. Each jaw turns about a hinge at the back of the mouth (y between the jaws, z = back edge; HINGE_OFFSET nudges it).
 - Static pieces = names containing pot / rim / dirt / leaf / soil / ground / planter (and Root); the pot group is turned by POT_TILT_DEG (0,0,-90 = a pot lying on its side tipped up to the right) about its middle and set back on the ground by its lowest point (+ POT_LIFT 0; leaves follow POT_LIFT).
 - ORIENTATION: the framework pivots the clone to its own pivot, which left the plant sideways. AUTO_ORIENT works out up (Stalk0 -> head) and front (head -> jaws), then turns ONLY the stalks + head + jaws about the Root (ROTATE_STATICS false). Output prints `[piranha] auto-orient: up=... front=...` once; the developer's model measured up = (-0.96, -0.01, -0.29), i.e. built lying along -X. FACING_OFFSET_DEG adds a manual turn.
 - Layout knobs (top of piranha.lua), current values: NECK_LIFT 2.5 (Stalk0 starts higher), STALK_TOP_LIFT 4.5 (the top stalk is raised; lower ones less, smooth t^2), NECK_SCALE 0.7 (shrinks neck + head height, spacing tighter), NECK_ARCH 0.3 (0 = straight, 1 = snake arch), HEIGHT_OFFSET 0, EXTRA_STALKS 0 (code to add copies of the top stalks exists but is OFF), AUTO_NECK_ATTACH true (the neck ends where the last stalk touches the head in the model), AUTO_FIX_POT false (old wrong guess), POT_LIFT 0, POT_TILT_DEG (0,0,-90).
 - The developer deleted Stalk7-10: the model now has Stalk0..Stalk6.
 - Debug: DEBUG_ORIENT / DUMP_MODEL print once: auto-orient, jaws (gap, lever, hinge, closeAngle), stalk reversal, and a plant dump (names, sizes, plant-local positions + rotations, ~70 lines). The developer has NOT pasted these yet; ask for them if anything is off.
 - The model must keep a part named Root on the ground point; fades use each part's own authored transparency; Spawned moves the clone's Root onto the Base prop (translation only), then orients.

### glass — Glass Plates [WRITTEN Oct 4, never run] (Events/GlassPlates; server-only, no client module, no remotes)
Target "Arena". The dev's Studio values: Duration 60, Weight 1, MIN_PLATES_LEFT 0, CRACK_SOUND_ID rbxassetid://128763165071133, SHATTER_SOUND_ID rbxassetid://138817960173178 (my defaults were 30 / 0.8 / 2 / blank). Only GLASS_PLATES_MIN 2 .. GLASS_PLATES_MAX 3 RANDOM plates (clamped to the plates that exist) turn to glass for the whole event (tween over GLASS_FADE 0.8s: Material Glass, GLASS_COLOR 165,205,220, transparency 0.4, reflectance 0.15; originals saved per part and restored through Trash; parts with Transparency >= 0.99 skipped); the other plates are untouched. Each glass plate gets a HIDDEN random step limit MIN_STEPS 10 .. MAX_STEPS 30. STEPS ARE COUNTED ON THE SERVER (Heartbeat) from alive players grounded (Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Air) on that plate (X/Z bounds of an unrotated plate + FEET_WINDOW 3.5 on the feet): 1 step per STRIDE 3.2 studs walked, LAND_STEPS 1 per landing, 1 step per IDLE_STEP_TIME 1.5s standing still (speed < IDLE_SPEED 1.5; <= 0 = standing is free), a jump of more than TELEPORT_DIST 12 studs in one frame counts as a teleport. Several players on one plate wear it down faster. Cracks (thin welded parts, CRACK_COLOR, CRACK_THICKNESS 0.16, branching from earlier crack ends) appear at CRACK_STAGES 0.34 / 0.67 / 0.9 of the limit (CRACK_LINES 3 / 4 / 6, lengths 3-6 / 4-8 / 6-11); at the limit: the glass goes almost clear for BREAK_DELAY 0.3s, then SHARD_COUNT 14 shards burst (SHARD_LIFETIME 3s), cracks go, PlateSpawner.DestroyPlate drops everyone on it. MIN_PLATES_LEFT: a plate holds on (stays fully cracked) if breaking it would leave fewer than that many plates in the WHOLE arena (platesInArena() - 1 < MIN_PLATES_LEFT; 0 = never holds). CRACK_SOUND_ID plays at 50% volume at each crack stage, SHATTER_SOUND_ID at 90% on the snap (positional, on a throwaway anchored part). Start toast "Glass Plates!". DEBUG prints each plate's limit. Server: Target "Arena", Weight 1, Duration 16, LitPlates 3, SafeRadius 12 (flat distance from a lamp, |dy| < 12), Damage 4 per TickTime 0.5 in the dark, FadeTime 1.5, GracePeriod 2.5, LightRange 26, LightBrightness 10. ### Stat shifts (Events/StatShifts via Systems/StatShift + Systems/StatShiftVisuals) [CONFIRMED: both sources seen Oct 4; both EDITED Oct 4]
StatShift.new(config): config = { Name, Id, Weight=1, Duration=60, Modifiers = {Stat={Add=,Mult=}} or function(player) -> that table (nil = can't be picked), Description (string or function(player)), Color, Opposes? }. Event Target "Arena"; Event.Duration = config.Duration or 60 is how long the EVENT counts as running (Event.Run returns at once; it does not block). Run: shuffles EventUtil.GetAlivePlayers; the target = the first player whose Modifiers resolve non-nil (and, with WHOLE_MATCH, who does not already have THIS shift); notifyAll toast = ClientEffect "Notify" FireAllClients {Title = Visuals.GetDisplayName(config), Text = "<DisplayName> <Description>", Color}; adds the Stats modifiers (no id given, so unique ids, kept in entry.ids); Visuals.Attach in a pcall (visuals must never break the stat change).
WHOLE_MATCH = true (top of Systems/StatShift, set Oct 4): every shift lasts the rest of the match instead of config.Duration (it overrides each shift script's Duration, so none of the ten scripts was edited); Visuals.Attach gets math.huge. An entry ends (finish: modifiers removed, visuals cleaned, idempotent, listeners disconnected) when: the victim's attr Alive turns false (eliminated / round over), Humanoid.Died, the character leaves the world (respawn), the player leaves, ReplicatedStorage attr GameState stops being "InRound" (finishEverything), or an opposing shift cancels it. WHOLE_MATCH = false = the old timed behaviour (task.delay Duration). Consequences: the SAME shift can't stack on a player (hasShift); DIFFERENT shifts still stack (e.g. Hermes + Feather); the event itself still ends after config.Duration so it can be picked again.
OPPOSING SHIFTS [tested working]: active[player] = list of entries {config, ids, cleanupVisual, character, finished, connections}. If the picked player already has a CONTRADICTING shift the new one is NOT applied; the old one is removed early and everyone gets a "Cancelled Out" toast ("<Name>'s <old> and <new> cancelled out"). Opposites come from (1) optional config.Opposes = {"keyword", ...} (substring of the other shift's lowercase Id+Name with spaces/punctuation removed, checked both ways), (2) DEFAULT_OPPOSES in StatShift (checked both ways): feather|maat <-> heart, hermes <-> tartarus, veil <-> nighthunt (added Oct 4), (3) ANY two different shifts whose Id/Name contains "styx" (Styx's Blessing vs Styx's Curse). getActive() drops entries from a previous character; PlayerRemoving finishes everything.
Events: Chains of Tartarus, Sandals of Hermes, Feather (display name "Feather"), Weighing of the Heart, Hel's Curse, Dipped in the Styx, Ofrenda, Valkyrie's Call, Night Hunt, Spectral Veil. Scripts in Events/StatShifts: ChainsOfTarturus (sic), Feathers, NightHunt, Ofrenda, Sandals, SpectralVeil, Styx's Blessing, Styx's Curse, ValkyriesCall, heavyHeart. Example config: Chains of Tartarus (Id "tartarus", WalkSpeed Mult 0.75, Color 120,125,140).
StatShiftVisuals (Systems): server-built, welded to the victim, folder workspace.StatShiftVisuals/<StatShift_userId_n> built OFFLINE then parented in one go (replicates to everyone). Visuals.Match(config) -> key by keywords in Id+Name (KEYS: tartarus, hermes, feather|maat, heart, helscurse|helcurse, styx, ofrenda, valkyrie, nighthunt, veil) with a special case checked FIRST: an Id/Name containing BOTH "styx" and "curse" -> key "styxcurse" (if the dev's Curse script has no "curse" in its Id/Name it comes out blue). Visuals.GetDisplayName (feather -> "Feather"). There is NO overhead tag/countdown any more (removed Oct 4). Attach(player, config, duration) -> cleanup fn: duration nil / <= 0 / math.huge / >= ENDLESS_AT 3600 = ENDLESS (polls every 0.5s, no fade); a timed duration fades everything over its last FADE_TIME 3s (Highlights fade fill + outline, parts transparency, emitters/beams off). valid() = not destroyed, character in the world, Humanoid alive, player in game, player attr Alive ~= false; cleanup is idempotent. ctx = {Character, Root, Folder, Key, Config, Tokens, Extras, AttachmentMoved, Stopped, Fading}.
HIGHLIGHT RULES (dev, Oct 4): every highlight is DepthMode Occluded with OutlineTransparency 1 (fill only, the outline colours are set but invisible). Helper characterHighlight(ctx, name, fill, outline, fillTransparency) puts one on the WHOLE character (Adornee = character, parented to ctx.Folder). Spectral Veil = pale blue-white VEIL_COLOR (190,220,255), fill transparency pulsing between VEIL_FILL_MIN 0.55 and VEIL_FILL_MAX 0.8 at VEIL_PULSE_SPEED 2 rad/s (0 = steady; the pulse stops when the fade-out starts via ctx.Fading); the old echo body + beams are GONE. Night Hunt = BLACK (fill 0,0,0, transparency 0.25; replaced the red eyes). Styx's Blessing (key "styx") = blue (60,120,220), 0.5 (replaced the drip emitter). Styx's Curse (key "styxcurse") = purple (140,70,210), 0.5. The Heart keeps its own Highlight on the heart part (fill 200,40,60, transparency 0.4, Occluded). Highlights are capped at ~31 server-wide.
Other builders: tartarus (ChainLeft/ChainRight templates on the ankles, each template's att1 VFX moved under the HRP), hermes (Sandal per foot), feather (Feather on the HRP), heart (Heart template on the chest, HEART_X -0.3 / HEART_Y 0.25, lub-dub pulse by tweening part sizes), helscurse (blue mist emitter), ofrenda (Ofrenda template), valkyrie (neon beam 70 studs tall + sparkles).
Part templates are CLONED, never built; lookup (names ignore case/spaces): 1) inside the event's OWN script (script name matched against Id/Name/keyword): a part/model with the wanted name, 2) else the first Part/MeshPart/Model directly under that script, 3) the wanted name under ANY script in Events, 4) ServerStorage.StatShiftAssets. Optional Vector3 attribute "Offset" on a template overrides its offset. Missing template = one warning in Output and no visual.

- Frog Wand [WRITTEN]: Tool in ServerStorage.Items; server Script + LocalScript (ItemRemote); builds a wand if no Handle. RANGE 70, FROG_TIME 12, COOLDOWN 1.5, CHARGES 3. The spell lives in Systems/FrogSpell (hides the body, welds a frog, WalkSpeed x0.55, Jump x0.4; ends on timer/death/respawn/Alive false) so it ends properly even if the wand is destroyed. - Lightning Rod [WRITTEN; the first version failed, the fix is not yet confirmed]: Tool "Lightning Rod" in ServerStorage.Items with a Script (builds a Handle if none, relays the click through its ItemRemote, destroys the Tool after a successful placement) + a LocalScript (equipped: a ring + ghost rod follow the cursor, blue in range / red out of range; click sends the cursor point). Logic lives in Systems/LightningRod: Place(player, point) validates (GameState == "InRound", Alive, MAX_RANGE 120, point on a plate = unrotated X/Z bounds + height window) and QUEUES the job; a Heartbeat loop in that module (owned by the permanent Script ServerScriptService/LightningRodServer) runs it. A rod blinks faster for a random DELAY 5-10s, shows a warning circle for the last WARN_TIME 1.2s, then a jagged bolt strikes: STRIKE_RADIUS 7 / height 10: Damage 70 + Push up 30 (including the placer), scorch mark, then the struck plate + neighbours (plates within (plate size + NEIGHBOR_GAP 10) x 1.5, diagonals included) glow blue and SHOCK for SHOCK_TIME 7s: Damage 3 every 0.5s and WalkSpeed x0.8 (Stats id "LightningShock") while standing on one, removed when they step off / at the end. Everything is server-built parts in workspace.LightningRods (the bolt ignores DisableFlashing). BUG FOUND: the first version did `task.spawn(runRod)` inside Place(), a thread owned by the Tool's Script, which then destroyed the Tool and killed the thread (the rod despawned via its Debris backup without striking). The queue + permanent-script loop is the fix. If the rod still vanishes, Output shows `[LightningRod] rod removed without striking: ...` or `rod error: ...`. Test: /giveitem Lightning Rod during a round. Not yet in Vampiette's PRICES.
- [v5] Knockback 9000 stick [WRITTEN, not run]: a Tool the DEV added to ServerStorage.Items; my server Script "KnockbackStick" goes INSIDE it (details in section 20.5).
- Sigil Scythe [WRITTEN]: given by the Dark Sigil Knight event or /givescythe (details in section 6). Not a lobby tool, not in ServerStorage.Items. Excalibur (section 6) is its variant.
- Gotcha: a destroyed Script can't run its own cleanup, and threads spawned from it die with it. Put effects in Systems modules driven by a permanent Script, add Debris backups, or hook tool.Destroying / GameState.

### Making .rbxmx files (notes for whoever generates them)
<roblox version="4">; Items with referent; Part props: Name, Anchored, CanCollide, CanTouch, CanQuery, Massless, CastShadow, <token name="shape"> (Ball 0, Block 1, Cylinder 2), <token name="Material"> (Plastic 256, SmoothPlastic 272, Neon 288, Wood 512, Slate 800, Concrete 816, DiamondPlate 1056, Metal 1088, Fabric 1312, Glass 1568), TopSurface/BottomSurface tokens 0, <Color3uint8 name="Color3uint8"> ARGB int, <float name="Transparency">, <Vector3 name="size">, <CoordinateFrame name="CFrame"> (X Y Z R00..R22); Weld: Ref Part0/Part1 + C0/C1 CoordinateFrames (WeldConstraint needs stored offsets, so use Weld); Model: Ref PrimaryPart; Values: NumberValue <double name="Value">, StringValue <string name="Value">; Scripts: <ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[...]]> (never contain "]]>"); Content: <Content name="TextureId"><null></null></Content>; PointLight Color = <Color3> R/G/B floats; ParticleEmitter: NumberRange "a b ", ColorSequence "t r g b 0 ...", NumberSequence "t v 0 ...", EmissionDirection token (Top 1), Vector2 SpreadAngle. A pet model's PrimaryPart must be an UNROTATED part (invisible root is fine).

### 9b. Utility module + the dev's client-effects style [CONFIRMED, source seen Oct 3 2026]
ReplicatedStorage.Utility (ModuleScript, CLIENT ONLY; require from LocalScripts; do not rename). It respects the player's Settings via Utility.GetSetting(key) = LocalPlayer attr "Setting_<Key>" == true (keys in Shared/SettingsConfig):
- Gates: CanCameraShake (DisableScreenShake), CanFlash (DisableFlashing), CanTint (DisableTinting), CanChangeFOV (DisableFOV), CanPostEffects (DisablePostEffects), CanParticles (DisableParticles).
- Utility.BaseFOV (camera FOV when the module first loads, normally 70). TweenFOV(fov, time?, style?, dir?) -> Tween or nil if FOV is disabled; ResetFOV(time?) tweens back to BaseFOV and is ALWAYS allowed. NOTE the dev's older effect scripts use "FieldOfView + 10" for a ZOOM OUT and "- 5" for a zoom in (bigger FOV = wider/zoomed out).
- Shake(magnitude?, roughness?, fadeIn?, fadeOut?) = same numbers as CameraShaker:ShakeOnce (defaults 3, 10, 0.1, 0.5); uses the dev's CameraShaker module (Sleitnick API: CameraShaker.new(Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value, function(shakeCf) workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame *= shakeCf end), :Start(), :ShakeOnce(...)) if a ModuleScript named "CameraShaker" is a child of Utility or anywhere in ReplicatedStorage, else a built-in noise shaker bound to RenderStep Camera.Value + 1. Typical dev values: ShakeOnce(5, 15, 0.1, 0.5) hits, (3, 10, 0.125, 2) builds, (8, 15, 0.05, 0.5) big strikes. ShakeRamp(from?, to?, duration?, roughness?) -> handle {Stop = function(fadeOut?)}: a shake that GROWS (ease-in) from `from` to `to` over `duration` and holds until handle.Stop(fadeOut) (default 0.3s), auto-fades 3s after it finished growing if never stopped; ALWAYS uses the built-in noise shaker (rotation degrees about noise * 1.5 * amplitude, movement 0.15 of that), safe no-op handle when screen shake is disabled.
- Blur(size?, duration?) -> BlurEffect or nil: starts at size (default 24), tweens to 0 over duration, Debris after duration + 0.25.
- Flash(strength?) (contrast/saturation flicker then a blur; skipped if flashing is disabled). Vignette: ShowVignette(transparency?, time?, color?) / HideVignette(time?) drive PlayerGui > "Vignette" ScreenGui > "Vignette" frame > ImageLabel (0 = dark, 1 = invisible; warns if that GUI is missing). ColorCorrection(props?, time?) -> handle with :Tween(props, time, style, direction) / :Reset(time) / :Destroy(delay) (no-ops when tinting is disabled).
- Emit(root): for every ParticleEmitter under root, after attribute EmitDelay (default 0) emits EmitCount particles (default 1 if neither EmitCount nor EmitDuration is set) and, if EmitDuration is set, enables it for that long. Skipped when DisableParticles is on. SetEmitters(root, enabled). FadeOut(root, time?) = emitters/trails off, Beams Width0/Width1 -> 0, parts/decals/textures Transparency -> 1, Highlights fade, Lights dim (does not destroy). Tween(instance, props, time?, style?, dir?) -> Tween.
The dev's effect scripts (DFXAssets death effects: DeathEffects.Register(name, function(Pos, Plr) ...) in a ModuleScript with children CameraShaker, forge-vfx, AkosBezierModule; EffectsModule.StartVFX(Target, mouseHit) for the big charge-up move with RocksModule, SideRocksModule, FloatRocks, BubbleModule, AkosBeamTweenerModule, forge-vfx) all follow one pattern: clone templates from ReplicatedStorage.DFXAssets/<Name>, PivotTo/Position them, call Emit (emitters carry attributes EmitDelay / EmitCount / EmitDuration), ShakeOnce, TweenFOV, a ColorCorrectionEffect tween for tint, optional ScreenGui vignette clones (ScreenGui > Vignette > ImageLabel, ImageTransparency 0.5-0.7 in, 1 out), then fade-out loops (ParticleEmitter Enabled = false, Beam Width0/Width1 -> 0, BasePart Transparency -> 1) and task.delay(n, x.Destroy, x) cleanup. Animation markers use track:GetMarkerReachedSignal("Name"). Their older scripts check LocalPlayer attrs "Photosensitive" / "CameraShakeDisabled"; the Utility module uses the "Setting_Disable..." attrs instead. forge-vfx: ForgeVFX.init() then ForgeVFX.emit(model). AkosBezierModule.BezierCurve(part, p0, p1, p2, time). Prefer Utility over re-writing these loops in new client code.

## 11. GOTCHAS
[v4] New UI gotchas (UIScale, AutomaticSize, billboards): section 18, 'Engine lessons'.
- NEVER require PlayerModule. No SetCore notifications (use Toast). Only ONE ProcessReceipt (Systems/Receipts). Gamepass purchase handlers: several scripts may each listen to PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished.
- Luau: a line can't start with "(" after a line ending in ")"; if-expressions don't return multiple values; Decals have no .Enabled; attribute names can't have spaces; don't shadow pairs/print/tick; generalized iteration over a call returning 2 values breaks (store the table in a local first); a {nil, x} table iterates fine with `for _, v in t`; string.gsub returns 2 values (wrap or assign to one local).
- Event main thread is cancelled at Duration (see EventSystem) -> cleanup through Trash. A destroyed Script/Tool can't clean itself up AND the threads it task.spawn'ed die with it (the Lightning Rod bug) -> Systems modules, a permanent Script owning the loop, Debris backups, Destroying hooks.
- Visual placeholders: rotated cylinders need an unrotated invisible PrimaryPart (EXCEPT when code derives orientation from the main part). Scale/flatten in WORLD axes. Cloned Beams keep pointing at the template's attachments -> re-link.
- The Visuals framework pivots a cloned custom model to its own pivot; a model built on its side ends up on its side -> detect/fix orientation in Spawned (piranha AUTO_ORIENT). Cloned custom models: keep part names stable, give a ground Root part.
- Moving anchored parts by CFrame doesn't carry characters -> also set AssemblyLinearVelocity (conveyor trick). Rig animation needs all parts unanchored except the HRP.
- Ground raycasts under players: exclude characters + visuals, RespectCanCollide, short range.
- Default Animate only does the tool-hold pose when the Tool has a Handle.
- LoadCharacter mid-round doesn't fire RoundManager's "character removed" -> set Alive=false first. Spawn forcefields come from SpawnLocation.Duration (0).
- RoundManager eliminates anyone below Center.Y - VoidDepth, so off-map rooms (Old Man pocket, Sigil Knight room) must be ABOVE the arena.
- Client-only physics (pets, boats) = unanchored local parts + Align constraints, or anchored parts + AssemblyLinearVelocity. Server-side pets would need SetNetworkOwner.
- Highlights are capped (~31). Roblox requires player-typed text shown to others to be FILTERED (pet names are).
- GuiObjects: set an explicit ZIndex on every child above its popup's ZIndex and use ZIndexBehavior.Sibling when popups can overlap.
- Sounds: a Sound in the world (e.g. in a tool Handle) is positional; a Sound parented to SoundService plays globally. A script that plays a sound only on one client must be a LocalScript/client module.
- Per-player hold time on a ProximityPrompt: PromptButtonHoldBegan / PromptButtonHoldEnded fire on the server (used by Excalibur).
- Moderation/kids: see section 0 content rules.

- [v14] EventUtil.Arena(plates) returns TWO values (centre, radius). `CFrame.new(K.Arena(plates))` passes the radius as argument 2 ("Vector3 expected, got number", the Spider Drop crash). Wrap a multi-return call in parentheses or put it in a local first.
- [v14] Events are required ONCE when the server starts: an edit made during Play does nothing until Play is restarted. The same error right after a fix = his old copy is still running.
- [v14] An event ends at its Duration no matter when Run returns (EventSystem task.delay(duration, stopRecord)); stopRecord cancels only the Run thread, so task.spawn / task.delay threads keep going (use that for things that must outlive the event, e.g. returning players from the Pocket Dimension; and guard them).
- [v14] Client sound slots live in the shared FX.Sounds table: the first module that registers a name wins (CannonBoom is in both dutchman and pumpkincannon).

### Engine lessons (apply to all future UI)
- A UIScale scales about the object's AnchorPoint: anything that pops or shrinks needs AnchorPoint in its middle (or the point it should stay on).
- AutomaticSize and AutomaticCanvasSize go wrong under a UIScale (Roblox staff confirmed in 2025, not known fixed), and EVERY UIKit.window is under a UIScale < 1 on small screens. Do not use them: size labels with TextService:GetTextSize (FlairUI.TextWidth / FitWidth) and set CanvasSize by hand.
- CanvasPosition: work in shares of AbsoluteCanvasSize, not in offsets.
- A BillboardGui is centred on its point: make it twice the content height and put the content in the top half to sit ON the point.
- Rotated GuiObjects are not clipped by ClipsDescendants: nothing rotated inside ScrollingFrames.
- A UIGradient on a text object tints the text; a gradient covers the label, not the letters. UIStroke on text objects needs ApplyStrokeMode = Border.
- UIKit.window scale = clamp(min((vw - 40) / w, (vh - 90) / (h + 40)), 0.4, 1): about 0.6 on a phone, so text under 14 px gets hard to read there.
- A full-screen backdrop needs Active = true (or be a TextButton) or clicks fall through.

### 20.4 Working rules learned this session
- DELIVERIES: he "really liked" the .rbxmx ORGANIZED WITH FOLDERS. Always include one: a top Folder (e.g. DMP_Titles_REPLACE) with a sub-folder per destination (ReplicatedStorage_Shared, StarterPlayerScripts, ServerScriptService...) holding the scripts as real ModuleScript / LocalScript / Script instances, next to the one-file-per-script .lua files and INSTALL.md. Build it as XML (ProtectedString Source in CDATA; check the source has no "]]>").

- "the approved list" / "that font" = refer to things by the TITLE name he uses; map it to the config value myself.
- Keep his pasted Studio copies as the base (line endings were CRLF; values he changed stay).
