---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Time and small maths
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- the server's clock: the same number on every client, so everyone sees the same moment
function FX.Now(): number
	return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

function FX.Clamp01(x: number): number
	return math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
end

-- 0..1: how far t is on its way from a to b
function FX.Span(t: number, a: number, b: number): number
	if b <= a then
		return if t >= b then 1 else 0
	end
	return math.clamp((t - a) / (b - a), 0, 1)
end

function FX.Lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number): number
	return a + (b - a) * t
end

FX.Ease = {}
function FX.Ease.Smooth(x: number): number
	x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
	return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)
end
function FX.Ease.In(x: number): number
	x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
	return x * x
end
function FX.Ease.Out(x: number): number
	x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
	return 1 - (1 - x) * (1 - x)
end
function FX.Ease.OutCubic(x: number): number
	x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
	return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
end
-- overshoots a little, then settles (things that pop up)
function FX.Ease.Back(x: number): number
	x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
	local c = 1.70158
	return 1 + (c + 1) * (x - 1) ^ 3 + c * (x - 1) ^ 2
end
-- drops and bounces (things that land)
function FX.Ease.Bounce(x: number): number
	x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
	local n, d = 7.5625, 2.75
	if x < 1 / d then
		return n * x * x
	elseif x < 2 / d then
		x -= 1.5 / d
		return n * x * x + 0.75
	elseif x < 2.5 / d then
		x -= 2.25 / d
		return n * x * x + 0.9375
	end
	x -= 2.625 / d
	return n * x * x + 0.984375
end
-- a wobble that dies away: 1 at x = 0, settles on 0 (springs, jelly)
function FX.Ease.Wobble(x: number, swings: number?, decay: number?): number
	return math.cos(x * (swings or 3) * math.pi * 2) * math.exp(-x * (decay or 4))
end

-- smooth random between -1 and 1 that changes with t (flicker, sway). seed = any number.
function FX.Noise(seed: number, t: number): number
	return math.clamp(math.noise(seed * 12.9898 + 0.5, t, seed * 4.123) * 2, -1, 1)
end

function FX.Flat(v: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

-- unit vector along the ground (fallback when it has no length)
function FX.Dir(v: Vector3, fallback: Vector3?): Vector3
	local flat = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return fallback or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end
	return flat.Unit
end

-- a CFrame standing at `position`, facing along `direction` on the ground (never NaN)
function FX.Facing(position: Vector3, direction: Vector3): CFrame
	local dir = FX.Dir(direction)
	return CFrame.lookAt(position, position + dir)
end

-- a random unit vector on the ground
function FX.RandomDir(): Vector3
	local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	return Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
end

local function getHolder(): Part
	local current = holder
	if current and current.Parent then
		return current
	end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Holder"
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

	holder = part

-- An attachment at a point in the world. life = seconds until it is removed (nil = you remove it).
function FX.Point(position: Vector3, life: number?): Attachment
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "Point"
	attachment.Parent = getHolder()
	attachment.WorldPosition = position
	if life then
		Debris:AddItem(attachment, life)
	end
	return attachment
end

-- How close the camera is to something: 1 = right there (within `full` studs), 0 = `none` studs away or more.
-- No position = 1.
function FX.Near(position: Vector3?, full: number?, none: number?): number
	if not position then
		return 1
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return 1
	end
	local a, b = full or 35, none or 150
	local distance = (camera.CFrame.Position - position).Magnitude
	if b <= a then
		return if distance <= a then 1 else 0
	end
	return math.clamp(1 - (distance - a) / (b - a), 0, 1)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Camera and screen (ReplicatedStorage > Utility does the work and respects the player's Settings)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Camera shake. position (optional) makes it weaker the farther the camera is from it.
-- Numbers are the same as Utility.Shake / CameraShaker:ShakeOnce (magnitude, roughness, fadeIn, fadeOut).
function FX.Shake(magnitude: number, roughness: number?, fadeIn: number?, fadeOut: number?, position: Vector3?, full: number?, none: number?)
	local strength = magnitude * FX.Near(position, full, none) * FX.Settings.Shake
	if strength < 0.05 then
		return
	end
	util("Shake", strength, roughness or 12, fadeIn or 0.05, fadeOut or 0.4)
end

-- A shake that GROWS from `from` to `to` over `duration` (Utility.ShakeRamp). Returns stop(fadeOut?).
function FX.Rumble(from: number, to: number, duration: number, roughness: number?, position: Vector3?): (fadeOut: number?) -> ()
	local scale = FX.Near(position) * FX.Settings.Shake
	local handle: any = nil
	if scale >= 0.05 then
		handle = util("ShakeRamp", from * scale, to * scale, duration, roughness or 12)
	end
	local stopped = false
	return function(fadeOut: number?)
		if stopped then
			return
		end
		stopped = true
		if type(handle) == "table" and type(handle.Stop) == "function" then
			local ok = pcall(handle.Stop, fadeOut or 0.3)
			if not ok then
				pcall(handle.Stop, handle, fadeOut or 0.3)
			end
		end
	end
end

function FX.Blur(size: number, duration: number, position: Vector3?)
	local strength = size * FX.Near(position)
	if strength >= 1 then
		util("Blur", strength, duration)
	end
end

function FX.Flash(strength: number?, position: Vector3?)
	local amount = (strength or 1) * FX.Near(position)
	if amount >= 0.1 then
		util("Flash", amount)
	end
end

-- delta = how much wider (+) or tighter (-) than the player's normal view
function FX.FOV(delta: number, seconds: number?)
	local base = (Utility and tonumber(Utility.BaseFOV)) or 70
	util("TweenFOV", base + delta, seconds or 0.2)
end

function FX.FOVReset(seconds: number?)
	util("ResetFOV", seconds or 0.5)
end

-- A quick view kick out and back (a big hit). strength = degrees.
function FX.Kick(strength: number, position: Vector3?)
	local amount = strength * FX.Near(position)
	if amount < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	FX.FOV(amount, 0.08)
	task.delay(0.1, function()
		FX.FOVReset(0.45)
	end)
end

-- transparency: 0 = black edges, 1 = nothing
function FX.Vignette(transparency: number, seconds: number?, color: Color3?)
	util("ShowVignette", transparency, seconds or 0.3, color or Colors.Black)
end

function FX.VignetteOff(seconds: number?)
	util("HideVignette", seconds or 0.4)
end

-- A short vignette pulse (you got hurt, you got chilled ...)
function FX.Pulse(color: Color3, transparency: number?, seconds: number?)
	FX.Vignette(transparency or 0.45, 0.1, color)
	task.delay(seconds or 0.35, function()
		FX.VignetteOff(0.5)
	end)
end

-- Colour correction that belongs to you: tint = FX.Tint(); tint.To({ Saturation = -0.5 }, 0.4); tint.Back(0.6); tint.Remove()
-- props are ColorCorrectionEffect properties (Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, TintColor).
function FX.Tint(): { To: (props: { [string]: any }, seconds: number?) -> (), Back: (seconds: number?) -> (), Remove: (delay: number?) -> () }
	local handle: any = util("ColorCorrection")
	local alive = type(handle) == "table"
	local function method(name: string, ...: any)
		if not alive then
			return
		end
		local fn = handle[name]
		if type(fn) == "function" then
			local ok, err = pcall(fn, handle, ...)
			if not ok then
				warnOnce("tint" .. name, "Utility.ColorCorrection():" .. name .. " failed: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end
	return {
		To = function(props: { [string]: any }, seconds: number?)
			method("Tween", props, seconds or 0.4)
		end,
		Back = function(seconds: number?)
			method("Reset", seconds or 0.5)
		end,
		Remove = function(delay: number?)
			method("Destroy", delay or 0)
			alive = false
		end,
	}
end

-- The standard "something big just landed here": shake + view kick + a touch of blur, all by distance.
-- power: 1 = a solid hit, 2 = huge.
function FX.Punch(position: Vector3?, power: number?)
	local p = power or 1
	FX.Shake(5 * p, 14, 0.04, 0.5 + 0.2 * p, position)
	FX.Kick(5 * p, position)
	if p >= 1.5 then
		FX.Blur(8 * p, 0.5, position)
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parts
---------------------------------------------------------------------

type Props = { [string]: any }

-- An anchored part nothing bumps into. props = any Part properties (Parent is applied last).
function FX.Part(props: Props): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	local parent = nil
	for key, value in props do
		if key == "Parent" then
			parent = value
		else
			(part :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function finish(part: BasePart, parent: Instance?, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Transparency = transparency or 0
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = parent
end

local MIN_SIZE = 0.05
local function safeSize(size: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(math.max(size.X, MIN_SIZE), math.max(size.Y, MIN_SIZE), math.max(size.Z, MIN_SIZE))
end

function FX.Block(parent: Instance?, size: Vector3, cframe: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Block"
	part.Size = safeSize(size)
	part.CFrame = cframe
	finish(part, parent, color, material, transparency)
	return part
end

function FX.Ball(parent: Instance?, diameter: number, position: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Ball"
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	local d = math.max(diameter, MIN_SIZE)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(d, d, d)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
	finish(part, parent, color, material, transparency)
	return part
end

-- Roblox cylinders lie along their X axis. CYL turns one so it stands along the Y axis of the CFrame you give.
local CYL = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
FX.CYL = CYL

-- A cylinder standing along the Y axis of `cframe` (length along Y).
function FX.Cyl(parent: Instance?, diameter: number, length: number, cframe: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Cyl"
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	part.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(length, MIN_SIZE), math.max(diameter, MIN_SIZE), math.max(diameter, MIN_SIZE))
	part.CFrame = cframe * CYL
	finish(part, parent, color, material, transparency)
	return part
end

-- An egg / stretched ball that fills `size` (pointy things: spikes, flames, teeth, tentacle pieces)
function FX.Egg(parent: Instance?, size: Vector3, cframe: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Egg"
	part.Size = safeSize(size)
	part.CFrame = cframe
	local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	mesh.Parent = part
	finish(part, parent, color, material, transparency)
	return part
end

function FX.Wedge(parent: Instance?, size: Vector3, cframe: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): WedgePart
	local part = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	part.Name = "Wedge"
	part.Size = safeSize(size)
	part.CFrame = cframe
	finish(part, parent, color, material, transparency)
	return part
end

-- A flat glowing disc lying on the ground at `position`
function FX.Disc(parent: Instance?, radius: number, position: Vector3, color: Color3, transparency: number?, thickness: number?): Part
	local part = FX.Cyl(parent, math.max(radius, 0.1) * 2, thickness or 0.2, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0)), color, Enum.Material.Neon, transparency or 0.5)
	part.Name = "Disc"
	return part
end

-- resizes a disc made by FX.Disc
function FX.SetDisc(part: BasePart, radius: number, position: Vector3?)
	local d = math.max(radius, 0.05) * 2
	part.Size = Vector3.new(part.Size.X, d, d)
	if position then
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0)) * CYL
	end
end

-- A flat glowing strip on the ground from a to b
function FX.Strip(parent: Instance?, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, width: number, color: Color3, transparency: number?): Part
	local length = math.max((b - a).Magnitude, 0.1)
	local lift = Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0)
	local part = FX.Block(parent, Vector3.new(width, 0.2, length), FX.Facing((a + b) / 2 + lift, b - a), color, Enum.Material.Neon, transparency or 0.5)
	part.Name = "Strip"
	return part
end

-- A thin part from a to b (ropes, chains, legs, bolts). Its length runs along Z.
function FX.Line(parent: Instance?, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, thickness: number, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = FX.Block(parent, Vector3.new(thickness, thickness, 1), CFrame.new(), color, material, transparency)
	part.Name = "Line"
	FX.SetLine(part, a, b)
	return part
end

-- moves a part made by FX.Line
function FX.SetLine(part: BasePart, a: Vector3, b: Vector3)
	local offset = b - a
	local length = offset.Magnitude
	if length < 0.02 then
		part.Size = Vector3.new(part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, MIN_SIZE)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(a)
		return
	end
	part.Size = Vector3.new(part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, length)
	local up = if math.abs(offset.Unit.Y) > 0.98 then Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) else Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b, up)
end

-- Tweens anything. style / direction are names ("Quad", "Back", "Bounce", "Linear", "Sine" ... / "In", "Out", "InOut").
-- With no style it goes through Utility.Tween.
function FX.Tween(instance: Instance, props: Props, seconds: number, style: string?, direction: string?, repeats: number?, reverses: boolean?): Tween?
	if not style and not direction and not repeats and not reverses then
		local tween = util("Tween", instance, props, seconds)
		if typeof(tween) == "Instance" and tween:IsA("Tween") then
			tween:Play() -- (does nothing if Utility already started it)
			return tween
		end
	end
	local easingStyle = (Enum.EasingStyle :: any)[style or "Quad"]
	local easingDirection = (Enum.EasingDirection :: any)[direction or "Out"]
	local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, TweenInfo.new(seconds, easingStyle, easingDirection, repeats or 0, reverses or false), props)
	tween:Play()
	return tween
end

-- Fades a thing (parts, lights, beams, particles) out with Utility.FadeOut, then removes it.
function FX.FadeOut(root: Instance, seconds: number?)
	local fadeTime = seconds or 0.5
	if not root.Parent then
		return
	end
	if Utility and type(Utility.FadeOut) == "function" then
		util("FadeOut", root, fadeTime)
	else
		-- no Utility: do it here
		local list = root:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(list, root)
		for _, item in list do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				FX.Tween(item, { Transparency = 1 }, fadeTime, "Quad")
			elseif item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				item.Enabled = false
			elseif item:IsA("Trail") then
				item.Enabled = false
			elseif item:IsA("Beam") then
				item.Enabled = false
			elseif item:IsA("Light") then
				FX.Tween(item, { Brightness = 0 }, fadeTime, "Quad")
			elseif item:IsA("BillboardGui") then
				item.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end
	for _, item in root:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BillboardGui") then
			item.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	Debris:AddItem(root, fadeTime + 0.15)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Rigs: several parts that move as one. Build it once, then rig:Move(cframe) every frame.
-- Offsets are relative to the rig's own CFrame; -Z is the front (the way CFrame.lookAt faces).
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local Rig = {}
Rig.__index = Rig

export type Rig = typeof(setmetatable({} :: { Parent: Instance?, Items: { any }, ByName: { [string]: any }, Scale: number, Alpha: number, CFrame: CFrame }, Rig))

function FX.Rig(parent: Instance?): Rig
	return setmetatable({ Parent = parent, Items = {}, ByName = {}, Scale = 1, Alpha = 0, CFrame = CFrame.new() }, Rig)
end

-- adds a part you made yourself. twist = a fixed turn applied after the offset (FX.CYL for cylinders).
function Rig.Add(self: Rig, part: BasePart, offset: CFrame?, name: string?, twist: CFrame?): BasePart
	local item = { Part = part, Offset = offset or CFrame.new(), Twist = twist, Size = part.Size, Transparency = part.Transparency }
	table.insert(self.Items, item)
	if name then
		part.Name = name
		self.ByName[name] = item
	end
	return part
end

function Rig.Block(self: Rig, name: string, size: Vector3, offset: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = FX.Block(self.Parent, size, offset, color, material, transparency)
	self:Add(part, offset, name)
	return part
end

function Rig.Ball(self: Rig, name: string, diameter: number, offset: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = FX.Ball(self.Parent, diameter, offset, color, material, transparency)
	self:Add(part, CFrame.new(offset), name)
	return part
end

-- a cylinder standing along the Y axis of `offset`
function Rig.Cyl(self: Rig, name: string, diameter: number, length: number, offset: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = FX.Cyl(self.Parent, diameter, length, offset, color, material, transparency)
	self:Add(part, offset, name, CYL)
	return part
end

function Rig.Egg(self: Rig, name: string, size: Vector3, offset: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = FX.Egg(self.Parent, size, offset, color, material, transparency)
	self:Add(part, offset, name)
	return part
end

function Rig.Wedge(self: Rig, name: string, size: Vector3, offset: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): WedgePart
	local part = FX.Wedge(self.Parent, size, offset, color, material, transparency)
	self:Add(part, offset, name)
	return part
end

-- a thin part from a to b (both relative to the rig)
function Rig.Line(self: Rig, name: string, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, thickness: number, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?, transparency: number?): Part
	local part = FX.Line(self.Parent, a, b, thickness, color, material, transparency)
	self:Add(part, part.CFrame, name)
	return part
end

function Rig.Get(self: Rig, name: string): BasePart?
	local item = self.ByName[name]
	return item and item.Part
end

-- changes where a named part sits in the rig (use it for moving jaws, arms, wings); shown at the next Move
function Rig.Pose(self: Rig, name: string, offset: CFrame)
	local item = self.ByName[name]
	if item then
		item.Offset = offset
	end
end

-- the offset a named part was given (so a pose can be "its normal place, turned a bit")
function Rig.Offset(self: Rig, name: string): CFrame
	local item = self.ByName[name]
	return if item then item.Offset else CFrame.new()
end

-- Places every part. scale (optional, 1 = as built) grows / shrinks the whole rig about its own middle.
function Rig.Move(self: Rig, cframe: CFrame, scale: number?)
	local s = math.max(scale or 1, 0.02)
	local resize = s ~= self.Scale
	self.Scale = s
	self.CFrame = cframe
	for _, item in self.Items do
		local offset: CFrame = item.Offset
		if s ~= 1 then
			offset = offset.Rotation + offset.Position * s
		end
		local part: BasePart = item.Part
		if resize then
			part.Size = safeSize(item.Size * s)
		end
		part.CFrame = if item.Twist then cframe * offset * item.Twist else cframe * offset
	end
end

-- 0 = as built, 1 = invisible
function Rig.Fade(self: Rig, alpha: number)
	local a = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
	if a == self.Alpha then
		return
	end
	self.Alpha = a
	for _, item in self.Items do
		item.Part.Transparency = item.Transparency + (1 - item.Transparency) * a
	end
end

-- Hides every part whose name starts with `prefix` (hidden = false shows them again). They stay that way through Fade.
function Rig.Hide(self: Rig, prefix: string, hidden: boolean?)
	for _, item in self.Items do
		if string.sub(item.Part.Name, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
			if item.Shown == nil then
				item.Shown = item.Transparency
			end
			item.Transparency = if hidden == false then item.Shown else 1
			item.Part.Transparency = item.Transparency + (1 - item.Transparency) * self.Alpha
		end
	end
end

function Rig.Each(self: Rig, fn: (part: BasePart, name: string) -> ())
	for _, item in self.Items do
		fn(item.Part, item.Part.Name)
	end
end

function Rig.Destroy(self: Rig)
	for _, item in self.Items do
		item.Part:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(self.Items)
	table.clear(self.ByName)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Particles (built-in Roblox textures only, so there is nothing to upload)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function fade(from: number, to: number): NumberSequence
	return NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, from), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, to) })
end
local function arc(a: number, b: number, c: number): NumberSequence
	return NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, b), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c) })
end

local PRESETS: { [string]: (e: ParticleEmitter, color: Color3, s: number) -> () } = {
	-- quick bright sparks that fly out and fall
	Spark = function(e, color, s)
		e.Texture = TEX_SPARK
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5), color)
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.7)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(12 * s, 28 * s)
		e.Size = fade(0.55 * s, 0)
		e.Transparency = fade(0, 1)
		e.LightEmission = 1
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -45, 0)
		e.Drag = 2
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		e.Rate = 40
	end,
	-- twinkles that drift (magic, treasure, healing)
	Star = function(e, color, s)
		e.Texture = TEX_SPARK
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.6), color)
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.3)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(2 * s, 7 * s)
		e.Size = arc(0, 0.8 * s, 0)
		e.Transparency = fade(0, 1)
		e.LightEmission = 1
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		e.Drag = 1
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-120, 120)
		e.Rate = 14
	end,
	-- tiny glowing bits that float up (embers, spirit motes)
	Ember = function(e, color, s)
		e.Texture = TEX_SPARK
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 2.2)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5 * s, 5 * s)
		e.Size = fade(0.35 * s, 0)
		e.Transparency = arc(1, 0, 1)
		e.LightEmission = 1
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35)
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		e.Rate = 12
	end,
	-- soft glowing puffs (ghost stuff, magic clouds)
	Glow = function(e, color, s)
		e.Texture = TEX_SMOKE
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.6)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(1 * s, 3 * s)
		e.Size = arc(0.6 * s, 1.8 * s, 2.6 * s)
		e.Transparency = arc(1, 0.55, 1)
		e.LightEmission = 0.9
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-30, 30)
		e.Rate = 10
	end,
	-- dark smoke that rises
	Smoke = function(e, color, s)
		e.Texture = TEX_SMOKE
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.9, 1.8)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(2 * s, 6 * s)
		e.Size = fade(1.6 * s, 4.5 * s)
		e.Transparency = arc(0.9, 0.45, 1)
		e.LightEmission = 0
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(50, 50)
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
		e.Drag = 1.5
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-40, 40)
		e.Rate = 12
	end,
	-- a low burst of dust along the ground
	Dust = function(e, color, s)
		e.Texture = TEX_SMOKE
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.1)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(7 * s, 15 * s)
		e.Size = fade(1.2 * s, 3.4 * s)
		e.Transparency = arc(0.8, 0.5, 1)
		e.LightEmission = 0
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(85, 85)
		e.Drag = 5
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		e.Rate = 20
	end,
	-- flame tongues
	Fire = function(e, color, s)
		e.Texture = TEX_FIRE
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.55), color)
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.9)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(3 * s, 7 * s)
		e.Size = arc(0.8 * s, 1.7 * s, 0.2 * s)
		e.Transparency = arc(0.6, 0.15, 1)
		e.LightEmission = 0.85
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(14, 14)
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-20, 20)
		e.Rate = 28
	end,
	-- huge slow see-through fog
	Mist = function(e, color, s)
		e.Texture = TEX_SMOKE
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2.5, 4.5)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.6)
		e.Size = fade(5 * s, 9 * s)
		e.Transparency = arc(1, 0.86, 1)
		e.LightEmission = 0.2
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-10, 10)
		e.Rate = 5
	end,
	-- drops that fly up and fall (splashes)
	Drop = function(e, color, s)
		e.Texture = TEX_SPARK
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(14 * s, 26 * s)
		e.Size = fade(0.45 * s, 0.2 * s)
		e.Transparency = fade(0.1, 1)
		e.LightEmission = 0.6
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(40, 40)
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -70, 0)
		e.Rate = 30
	end,
}

-- A ParticleEmitter from a preset: "Spark", "Star", "Ember", "Glow", "Smoke", "Dust", "Fire", "Mist", "Drop".
-- props: Color (a Color3), Scale (a number) and any ParticleEmitter property to override. It starts switched OFF.
function FX.Emitter(parent: Instance, kind: string, props: Props?): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = kind
	emitter.Enabled = false
	emitter.LightInfluence = 0
	local color: Color3 = Colors.White
	local scale = 1
	if props then
		if typeof(props.Color) == "Color3" then
			color = props.Color
		end
		if type(props.Scale) == "number" then
			scale = props.Scale
		end
	end
	local preset = PRESETS[kind] or PRESETS.Spark
	preset(emitter, color, scale)
	if props then
		for key, value in props do
			if key ~= "Scale" and not (key == "Color" and typeof(value) == "Color3") then
				(emitter :: any)[key] = value
			end
		end
	end
	emitter.Parent = parent
	return emitter
end

-- An emitter that keeps running (off when the player disabled particles). parent = a part or attachment.
function FX.Stream(parent: Instance, kind: string, props: Props?): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = FX.Emitter(parent, kind, props)
	if not FX.Off("DisableParticles") then
		emitter.Enabled = true
	end
	return emitter
end

-- Switches every emitter under root on / off (Utility.SetEmitters); never on when particles are disabled.
function FX.SetEmitters(root: Instance, enabled: boolean)
	local on = enabled and not FX.Off("DisableParticles")
	if Utility and type(Utility.SetEmitters) == "function" then
		util("SetEmitters", root, on)
		return
	end
	for _, item in root:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			item.Enabled = on
		end
	end
end

-- One puff of `count` particles at a spot in the world (through Utility.Emit).
function FX.Burst(at: Vector3, kind: string, count: number, props: Props?)
	if FX.Off("DisableParticles") or count <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local point = FX.Point(at)
	local emitter = FX.Emitter(point, kind, props)
	emitter:SetAttribute("EmitCount", math.floor(count))
	if Utility and type(Utility.Emit) == "function" then
		util("Emit", point)
	else
		emitter:Emit(math.floor(count))
	end
	Debris:AddItem(point, emitter.Lifetime.Max + 0.4)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lights, beams, trails
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function FX.Light(parent: Instance, color: Color3, range: number, brightness: number?, shadows: boolean?): PointLight
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = color
	light.Range = range
	light.Brightness = brightness or 2
	light.Shadows = shadows == true and not FX.Off("DisableShadows")
	light.Parent = parent
	return light
end

-- A flash of light in the world that fades away (skipped when the player turned flashing off)
function FX.Glint(position: Vector3, color: Color3, range: number, brightness: number?, seconds: number?)
	if FX.Off("DisableFlashing") then
		return
	end
	local life = seconds or 0.4
	local point = FX.Point(position, life + 0.2)
	local light = FX.Light(point, color, range, brightness or 4)
	FX.Tween(light, { Brightness = 0 }, life, "Quad", "Out")
end

-- an attachment on a part (offset in the part's own space)
function FX.Attach(part: BasePart, offset: Vector3?): Attachment
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Position = offset or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	attachment.Parent = part
	return attachment
end

-- A glowing ribbon between two attachments
function FX.Beam(parent: Instance, a0: Attachment, a1: Attachment, color: Color3, width: number, props: Props?): Beam
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0 = a0
	beam.Attachment1 = a1
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	beam.Width0 = width
	beam.Width1 = width
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.LightInfluence = 0
	beam.Segments = 12
	beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.25)
	if props then
		for key, value in props do
			(beam :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	beam.Parent = parent
	return beam
end

-- A glowing trail behind a moving part
function FX.Trail(part: BasePart, color: Color3, width: number, lifetime: number, props: Props?): Trail
	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Attachment0 = FX.Attach(part, Vector3.new(0, width / 2, 0))
	trail.Attachment1 = FX.Attach(part, Vector3.new(0, -width / 2, 0))
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	trail.Lifetime = lifetime
	trail.FaceCamera = true
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.LightInfluence = 0
	trail.MinLength = 0.05
	trail.Transparency = fade(0.2, 1)
	trail.WidthScale = fade(1, 0)
	if props then
		for key, value in props do
			(trail :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	trail.Parent = part
	return trail
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Text
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Floating text above a part / attachment, sized in STUDS (it shrinks with distance). Returns the TextLabel
-- (change .Text any time) and its BillboardGui.
function FX.Label(adornee: Instance, text: string, color: Color3?, studsUp: number?, width: number?, height: number?): (TextLabel, BillboardGui)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Label"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(width or 14, height or 3)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, studsUp or 4, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.MaxDistance = 320
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = FONT
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color or Colors.White
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Colors.Black
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Adornee = adornee
	gui.Parent = adornee
	return label, gui
end

-- Text that pops up at a spot, floats up and fades ("+3", "WHACK!")
function FX.Popup(position: Vector3, text: string, color: Color3?, size: number?)
	local point = FX.Point(position, 1.4)
	local label, gui = FX.Label(point, text, color, 0, (size or 2.4) * math.max(#text, 2) * 0.62, size or 2.4)
	FX.Tween(gui, { StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0) }, 1.1, "Quad", "Out")
	task.delay(0.6, function()
		if label.Parent then
			FX.Tween(label, { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }, 0.5, "Quad", "In")
		end
	end)
end

export type Banner = { Set: (title: string?, subtitle: string?) -> (), Bar: (fraction: number) -> (), Color: (color: Color3) -> (), Close: () -> () }

local bannerKill: (() -> ())? = nil
local bannerToken = 0

-- A banner at the top of the screen (dark red and black, chunky text). seconds = how long it stays
-- (nil = until you call .Close()). .Set(title, subtitle) changes the words, .Bar(0..1) shows a timer bar.
-- There is only ever one: a new banner replaces the one that is up. smallFirst = true puts the small line
-- above the big one ("Vampiette says..." over "JUMP!").
function FX.Banner(title: string, subtitle: string?, color: Color3?, seconds: number?, smallFirst: boolean?): Banner
	local accent = color or Colors.Gold
	local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	local dead: Banner = { Set = function() end, Bar = function() end, Color = function() end, Close = function() end }
	if not playerGui then
		return dead
	end
	local kill = bannerKill
	if kill then
		kill()
	end
	bannerToken += 1
	local token = bannerToken
	local closed = false
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "EventFXGui"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 45
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	bannerKill = function()
		closed = true
		gui:Destroy()
	end

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Banner"
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 104)
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 92)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Parent = gui
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	corner.Parent = panel
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(64, 14, 22), Color3.fromRGB(14, 6, 9))
	gradient.Rotation = 90
	gradient.Parent = panel
	local edge = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	edge.Color = accent
	edge.Thickness = 3
	edge.Parent = panel
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local fit = if camera then math.clamp(camera.ViewportSize.X / 560, 0.55, 1) else 1
	scale.Scale = fit * 0.6
	scale.Parent = panel

	local function words(y: number, height: number, size: number, textColor: Color3): TextLabel
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, y)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, height)
		label.Font = FONT
		label.TextSize = size
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.TextColor3 = textColor
		label.TextStrokeColor3 = Colors.Black
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
		label.Text = ""
		label.ZIndex = 2
		label.Parent = panel
		local limit = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		limit.MaxTextSize = size
		limit.MinTextSize = 10
		limit.Parent = label
		return label
	end
	local titleLabel = words(if smallFirst then 32 else 8, 44, 38, Colors.White)
	local subLabel = words(if smallFirst then 8 else 52, 24, 20, accent)
	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Name = "Timer"
	track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	track.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8)
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 6)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 16, 20)
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Visible = false
	track.ZIndex = 2
	track.Parent = panel
	local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	trackCorner.Parent = track
	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = accent
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.ZIndex = 3
	fill.Parent = track
	local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner.Parent = fill

	titleLabel.Text = title
	subLabel.Text = subtitle or ""
	gui.Parent = playerGui
	FX.Tween(scale, { Scale = fit }, 0.3, "Back", "Out")

	local banner: Banner = {
		Set = function(newTitle: string?, newSubtitle: string?)
			if closed then
				return
			end
			if newTitle then
				titleLabel.Text = newTitle
			end
			if newSubtitle then
				subLabel.Text = newSubtitle
			end
		end,
		Bar = function(fraction: number)
			if closed then
				return
			end
			track.Visible = true
			fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(fraction, 0, 1), 1)
		end,
		Color = function(newColor: Color3)
			if closed then
				return
			end
			edge.Color = newColor
			subLabel.TextColor3 = newColor
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
		end,
		Close = function()
			if closed then
				return
			end
			closed = true
			if gui.Parent then
				FX.Tween(scale, { Scale = fit * 0.5 }, 0.18, "Quad", "In")
				Debris:AddItem(gui, 0.2)
			end
			if bannerToken == token then
				bannerKill = nil
			end
		end,
	}
	if seconds then
		task.delay(seconds, banner.Close)
	end
	return banner
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Sounds
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local soundState: { [string]: string } = {} -- id -> "checking" / "ok" / "bad"

local function soundId(raw: any): string
	local id = tostring(raw or "")
	if id:match("^%d+$") then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. id
	end
	return id
end

local function checkSound(id: string)
	if soundState[id] then
		return
	end
	soundState[id] = "checking"
	task.spawn(function()
		local probe = Instance.new("Sound")
		probe.SoundId = id
		local good = true
		local ok = pcall(function()
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ probe }, function(_, status)
				if status ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
					good = false
				end
			end)
		end)
		probe:Destroy()
		if ok and not good then
			soundState[id] = "bad"
			warnOnce("sound" .. id, "the sound " .. id .. " did not load, so it is switched off (put your own id in EventFX.Sounds)")
		else
			soundState[id] = "ok"
		end
	end)
end

-- Plays one of FX.Sounds by name. at = a spot in the world or a part (nil = heard everywhere the same).
-- volume / speed multiply that sound's own Volume / Speed. Returns the Sound (or nil when it is off).
function FX.Sound(name: string, at: (Vector3 | Instance)?, volume: number?, speed: number?): Sound?
	if not FX.Settings.Sounds then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = (FX.Sounds :: any)[name]
	if type(entry) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local id = soundId(entry.Id)
	if id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local state = soundState[id]
	if state ~= "ok" then
		checkSound(id)
		return nil
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = name
	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = math.clamp((tonumber(entry.Volume) or 1) * (volume or 1) * FX.Settings.Volume, 0, 4)
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp((tonumber(entry.Speed) or 1) * (speed or 1), 0.1, 4)
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = 14
	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = 220
	if typeof(at) == "Vector3" then
		sound.Parent = FX.Point(at, 8)
	elseif typeof(at) == "Instance" then
		sound.Parent = at
	else
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end
	sound:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(sound, 8)
	return sound
end

-- test every sound once, in the background, so the first one an event needs is ready
task.spawn(function()
	for _, entry in FX.Sounds :: any do
		local id = soundId(entry.Id)
		if id ~= "" then
			checkSound(id)
		end
	end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ready-made effects
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- A warning circle on the ground that FILLS UP over `seconds` (when it is full, the thing happens). Removes itself.
function FX.WarnDisc(parent: Instance?, position: Vector3, radius: number, seconds: number, color: Color3?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Warning"
	local c = color or Colors.Warn
	local edge = FX.Disc(model, radius, position, c, 0.8)
	local fill = FX.Disc(model, 0.3, position + Vector3.new(0, 0.04, 0), c, 0.45)
	FX.Tween(edge, { Transparency = 0.55 }, 0.25, "Sine", "InOut", -1, true)
	FX.Tween(fill, { Size = Vector3.new(fill.Size.X, radius * 2, radius * 2) }, math.max(seconds, 0.05), "Linear")
	model.Parent = parent or FX.Folder()
	Debris:AddItem(model, seconds + 0.05)
	return model
end

-- A warning strip on the ground from a to b that fills up (gets wider) over `seconds`. Removes itself.
function FX.WarnStrip(parent: Instance?, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, width: number, seconds: number, color: Color3?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Warning"
	local c = color or Colors.Warn
	local edge = FX.Strip(model, a, b, width, c, 0.82)
	local lift = Vector3.new(0, 0.04, 0)
	local fill = FX.Strip(model, a + lift, b + lift, 0.3, c, 0.45)
	FX.Tween(edge, { Transparency = 0.6 }, 0.25, "Sine", "InOut", -1, true)
	FX.Tween(fill, { Size = Vector3.new(width, fill.Size.Y, fill.Size.Z) }, math.max(seconds, 0.05), "Linear")
	model.Parent = parent or FX.Folder()
	Debris:AddItem(model, seconds + 0.05)
	return model
end

-- A flat shockwave that spreads along the ground and fades
function FX.Ring(position: Vector3, fromRadius: number, toRadius: number, seconds: number, color: Color3?, parent: Instance?)
	local disc = FX.Disc(parent or FX.Folder(), fromRadius, position, color or Colors.White, 0.4, 0.25)
	disc.Name = "Ring"
	FX.Tween(disc, { Size = Vector3.new(disc.Size.X, toRadius * 2, toRadius * 2), Transparency = 1 }, seconds, "Quad", "Out")
	Debris:AddItem(disc, seconds + 0.1)
end

export type Hoop = { Set: (center: Vector3, radius: number, width: number?, height: number?) -> (), Look: (color: Color3, transparency: number?) -> (), Destroy: () -> () }

-- A real ring (a circle of segments) you can resize every frame: hoop.Set(center, radius, width, height)
function FX.Hoop(parent: Instance?, color: Color3, segments: number?, transparency: number?): Hoop
	local n = segments or 28
	local parts: { Part } = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		parts[i] = FX.Block(parent, Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), CFrame.new(0, -500, 0), color, Enum.Material.Neon, transparency or 0.15)
		parts[i].Name = "Hoop"
	end
	return {
		Set = function(center: Vector3, radius: number, width: number?, height: number?)
			local w, h = width or 1.2, height or 0.6
			local r = math.max(radius, 0.1)
			local length = math.max(2 * math.pi * r / n * 1.1, 0.05)
			local lift = Vector3.new(0, h / 2, 0)
			for i, part in parts do
				local angle = (i / n) * math.pi * 2
				local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
				part.Size = Vector3.new(length, h, w)
				part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(center + dir * r + lift, center + dir * (r + 1) + lift)
			end
		end,
		Look = function(newColor: Color3, newTransparency: number?)
			for _, part in parts do
				part.Color = newColor
				if newTransparency then
					part.Transparency = newTransparency
				end
			end
		end,
		Destroy = function()
			for _, part in parts do
				part:Destroy()
			end
			table.clear(parts)
		end,
	}
end

function FX.Sparks(position: Vector3, color: Color3?, count: number?, scale: number?)
	FX.Burst(position, "Spark", count or 16, { Color = color or Colors.Gold, Scale = scale or 1 })
end

-- a soft puff (something appears / vanishes)
function FX.Poof(position: Vector3, color: Color3?, size: number?)
	local s = size or 1
	FX.Burst(position, "Glow", 8, { Color = color or Colors.White, Scale = s })
	FX.Burst(position, "Star", 8, { Color = color or Colors.White, Scale = s })
end

function FX.Splash(position: Vector3, color: Color3?, size: number?)
	local s = size or 1
	FX.Burst(position, "Drop", 18, { Color = color or Colors.Ghost, Scale = s })
	FX.Ring(position, 0.5, 4 * s, 0.4, color or Colors.Ghost)
end

-- A bang: flash ball, sparks, smoke, a ring on the ground, light, sound and camera shake (by distance).
-- size = about how many studs wide. opts: Power (camera, default by size), Sound (a name in FX.Sounds, or false),
-- Smoke (false = none), Ring (false = none).
function FX.Boom(position: Vector3, size: number, color: Color3?, opts: Props?)
	local c = color or Colors.Orange
	local o: Props = opts or {}
	local parent = FX.Folder()
	local ball = FX.Ball(parent, size * 0.5, position, c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5), Enum.Material.Neon, if FX.Off("DisableFlashing") then 0.6 else 0.1)
	ball.Name = "Boom"
	FX.Tween(ball, { Size = Vector3.new(size * 1.7, size * 1.7, size * 1.7), Transparency = 1 }, 0.32, "Quad", "Out")
	Debris:AddItem(ball, 0.4)
	FX.Burst(position, "Spark", 14 + size * 2, { Color = c, Scale = math.clamp(size / 6, 0.6, 2.2) })
	if o.Smoke ~= false then
		FX.Burst(position, "Smoke", 6 + size * 0.5, { Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 54, 60), Scale = math.clamp(size / 7, 0.6, 2.4) })
	end
	if o.Ring ~= false then
		FX.Ring(position, size * 0.2, size * 1.2, 0.45, c)
	end
	FX.Glint(position, c, size * 4, 5, 0.4)
	if o.Sound ~= false then
		FX.Sound(if type(o.Sound) == "string" then o.Sound else "Boom", position, math.clamp(size / 8, 0.5, 1.6))
	end
	FX.Punch(position, tonumber(o.Power) or math.clamp(size / 10, 0.4, 2))
end

-- A jagged bolt from a to b that fades
function FX.Lightning(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, color: Color3?, thickness: number?, seconds: number?, jag: number?)
	local c = color or Colors.White
	local life = seconds or 0.35
	local wobble = jag or 2.5
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Bolt"
	local points: { Vector3 } = { a }
	local n = math.clamp(math.floor((b - a).Magnitude / 6), 3, 14)
	for i = 1, n - 1 do
		local p = a:Lerp(b, i / n)
		table.insert(points, p + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * wobble, (math.random() - 0.5) * wobble, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * wobble))
	end
	table.insert(points, b)
	local soft = FX.Off("DisableFlashing")
	for i = 1, #points - 1 do
		local segment = FX.Line(model, points[i], points[i + 1], thickness or 0.6, c, Enum.Material.Neon, if soft then 0.6 else 0)
		FX.Tween(segment, { Transparency = 1 }, life, "Quad", "In")
	end
	model.Parent = FX.Folder()
	Debris:AddItem(model, life + 0.1)
	FX.Glint(b, c, 34, 5, 0.3)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Flying bits (debris, confetti, coins): real little parts that fly, spin, fall and fade
---------------------------------------------------------------------

type Chunk = { Part: BasePart, Position: Vector3, Velocity: Vector3, Axis: Vector3, Spin: number, Angle: number, Age: number, Life: number, Gravity: number, Base: number, Drag: number }
local chunks: { Chunk } = {}
local needStepper: () -> ()

-- Throws `count` bits out from a spot. color = a Color3 or a list of them.
-- opts: Size 0.7, Speed 22 (sideways), Up 26, Life 1.4, Gravity 120, Spread 0.5 (how far apart they start),
--       Material, Shape ("Block" / "Ball"), Flat (true = thin squares, for confetti), Drag 0, Neon (true = glowing)
function FX.Chunks(position: Vector3, count: number, color: any, opts: Props?)
	local o: Props = opts or {}
	local amount = math.floor(if FX.Off("DisableParticles") then math.ceil(count / 3) else count)
	local parent = FX.Folder()
	local size: number = o.Size or 0.7
	local material: Enum.Material = o.Material or (if o.Neon then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	for _ = 1, amount do
		if #chunks >= FX.Settings.MaxChunks then
			local oldest = table.remove(chunks, 1)
			if oldest then
				oldest.Part:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local c: Color3 = if typeof(color) == "Color3" then color else color[math.random(1, #color)]
		local s = size * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.8)
		local dims = if o.Flat then Vector3.new(s, s * 0.12, s) else Vector3.new(s, s, s)
		local spread: number = o.Spread or 0.5
		local start = position + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * spread, math.random() * spread, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * spread)
		local part: BasePart
		if o.Shape == "Ball" then
			part = FX.Ball(parent, s, start, c, material, 0)
		else
			part = FX.Block(parent, dims, CFrame.new(start), c, material, 0)
		end
		part.Name = "Chunk"
		local sideways = FX.RandomDir() * ((o.Speed or 22) * (0.35 + math.random() * 0.65))
		local axis = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5)
		table.insert(chunks, {
			Part = part, Position = start, Velocity = sideways + Vector3.new(0, (o.Up or 26) * (0.5 + math.random() * 0.5), 0),
			Axis = if axis.Magnitude > 0.01 then axis.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Spin = 4 + math.random() * 10, Angle = math.random() * 6,
			Age = 0, Life = (o.Life or 1.4) * (0.75 + math.random() * 0.5), Gravity = o.Gravity or 120, Base = 0, Drag = o.Drag or 0,
		})
	end
	if #chunks > 0 then
		needStepper()
	end
end

local CONFETTI = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 110), Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60), Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 120), Color3.fromRGB(110, 170, 255), Color3.fromRGB(200, 120, 255), Color3.fromRGB(245, 240, 240) }
function FX.Confetti(position: Vector3, count: number?)
	FX.Chunks(position, count or 24, CONFETTI, { Size = 0.6, Speed = 16, Up = 30, Life = 2.4, Gravity = 38, Flat = true, Drag = 1.2 })
end

local function stepChunks(dt: number)
	for index = #chunks, 1, -1 do
		local chunk = chunks[index]
		chunk.Age += dt
		if chunk.Age >= chunk.Life or not chunk.Part.Parent then
			chunk.Part:Destroy()
			table.remove(chunks, index)
		else
			local velocity = chunk.Velocity + Vector3.new(0, -chunk.Gravity * dt, 0)
			if chunk.Drag > 0 then
				velocity = velocity * math.max(1 - chunk.Drag * dt, 0)
			end
			chunk.Velocity = velocity
			chunk.Position += velocity * dt
			chunk.Angle += chunk.Spin * dt
			chunk.Part.CFrame = CFrame.new(chunk.Position) * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(chunk.Axis, chunk.Angle)
			local left = 1 - chunk.Age / chunk.Life
			if left < 0.3 then
				chunk.Part.Transparency = 1 - left / 0.3
			end
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Players
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function FX.Player(userId: number): Player?
	return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
end

-- that player's HumanoidRootPart (nil when they have no character right now)
function FX.Root(userId: number): BasePart?
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return root
	end
	return nil
end

-- where that player's feet are
function FX.Feet(userId: number): Vector3?
	local root = FX.Root(userId)
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = root.Parent and root.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
		return root.Position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2 + humanoid.HipHeight, 0)
	end
	return root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
end

function FX.IsMe(userId: number): boolean
	return userId == localPlayer.UserId
end

function FX.MyRoot(): BasePart?
	return FX.Root(localPlayer.UserId)
end

-- everyone who is alive in the round right now: { { Player, root } }
function FX.AliveRoots(): { { Player: Player, Root: BasePart } }
	local list = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player:GetAttribute("Alive") == true then
			local root = FX.Root(player.UserId)
			if root then
				table.insert(list, { Player = player, Root = root })
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- the first instance the server marked with K.Tag (nil until it has arrived on this client)
function FX.Tagged(tag: any): Instance?
	if type(tag) ~= "string" or tag == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return CollectionService:GetTagged(tag)[1]
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Followers: something the SERVER steers (a snake, a zombie). The server reports where it is a few times
-- a second; follower.Push(position, heading) takes a report and follower.Step(dt) gives a smooth position.
---------------------------------------------------------------------

export type Follower = { Push: (position: Vector3, heading: Vector3?) -> (), Step: (dt: number) -> (Vector3, Vector3), Snap: (position: Vector3, heading: Vector3?) -> () }

function FX.Follower(position: Vector3, heading: Vector3?, stiffness: number?): Follower
	local current, target = position, position
	local dir = FX.Dir(heading or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
	local targetDir = dir
	local velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local lastPush = os.clock()
	local k = stiffness or 12
	local follower = {}
	function follower.Snap(p: Vector3, h: Vector3?)
		current, target, velocity = p, p, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		if h then
			dir = FX.Dir(h, dir)
			targetDir = dir
		end
		lastPush = os.clock()
	end
	function follower.Push(p: Vector3, h: Vector3?)
		local now = os.clock()
		local gap = now - lastPush
		if (p - current).Magnitude > 45 then
			follower.Snap(p, h)
			return
		end
		velocity = if gap > 0.02 and gap < 1 then (p - target) / gap else Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		target = p
		lastPush = now
		if h then
			targetDir = FX.Dir(h, targetDir)
		end
	end
	function follower.Step(dt: number): (Vector3, Vector3)
		local ahead = math.min(os.clock() - lastPush, 0.25)
		local goal = target + velocity * ahead
		local a = 1 - math.exp(-k * dt)
		current = current:Lerp(goal, a)
		dir = FX.Dir(dir:Lerp(targetDir, a), targetDir)
		return current, dir
	end
	return follower
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ready-made shapes (added to a rig; `at` is where it sits in the rig, -Z is its front)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function Rig.Resize(self: Rig, name: string, size: Vector3)
	local item = self.ByName[name]
	if item then
		item.Size = size
		item.Part.Size = safeSize(size * self.Scale)
	end
end

-- a bone from a to b (a shaft with two knobs on each end)
function FX.AddBone(rig: Rig, name: string, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, thickness: number, color: Color3?)
	local c = color or Colors.Bone
	if (b - a).Magnitude < 0.1 then
		b = a + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
	end
	local offset = b - a
	local length = offset.Magnitude
	local up = if math.abs(offset.Unit.Y) > 0.98 then Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) else Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	local frame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b, up) * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0) -- Y runs along the bone
	rig:Cyl(name, thickness, length, frame, c)
	for _, tip in { -1, 1 } do
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			rig:Ball(name .. "Knob", thickness * 1.15, frame * Vector3.new(side * thickness * 0.42, tip * length / 2, 0), c)
		end
	end
end

-- a skull. Parts: <name>, <name>Jaw (pose it to chomp), <name>EyeL / EyeR. eyeColor = glowing eyes.
function FX.AddSkull(rig: Rig, name: string, at: CFrame, size: number, color: Color3?, eyeColor: Color3?)
	local c = color or Colors.Bone
	rig:Add(FX.Ball(rig.Parent, size, at.Position, c), at, name)
	rig:Block(name .. "Jaw", Vector3.new(size * 0.62, size * 0.3, size * 0.62), at * CFrame.new(0, -size * 0.46, -size * 0.1), c)
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		local eye = rig:Add(FX.Ball(rig.Parent, size * 0.26, at.Position, eyeColor or Colors.Black, if eyeColor then Enum.Material.Neon else nil),
			at * CFrame.new(side * size * 0.2, size * 0.05, -size * 0.4), name .. (if side < 0 then "EyeL" else "EyeR"))
		eye.Name = name .. (if side < 0 then "EyeL" else "EyeR")
	end
	rig:Block(name .. "Nose", Vector3.new(size * 0.1, size * 0.14, size * 0.06), at * CFrame.new(0, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.48), Colors.Black)
	for i = -1, 1 do
		rig:Block(name .. "Tooth", Vector3.new(size * 0.14, size * 0.14, size * 0.06), at * CFrame.new(i * size * 0.17, -size * 0.3, -size * 0.42), Colors.White)
	end
end

-- a ghost. Parts: <name> (body), <name>Tail1..3, <name>ArmL / ArmR.
function FX.AddGhost(rig: Rig, name: string, at: CFrame, size: number, color: Color3?, transparency: number?)
	local c = color or Colors.White
	local tr = transparency or 0.25
	local neon = Enum.Material.Neon
	rig:Egg(name, Vector3.new(size, size * 1.15, size), at, c, neon, tr)
	rig:Egg(name .. "Tail1", Vector3.new(size * 0.8, size * 0.8, size * 0.8), at * CFrame.new(0, -size * 0.55, size * 0.12), c, neon, math.min(tr + 0.08, 0.95))
	rig:Egg(name .. "Tail2", Vector3.new(size * 0.55, size * 0.6, size * 0.55), at * CFrame.new(0, -size * 0.95, size * 0.3), c, neon, math.min(tr + 0.16, 0.95))
	rig:Egg(name .. "Tail3", Vector3.new(size * 0.3, size * 0.4, size * 0.3), at * CFrame.new(0, -size * 1.25, size * 0.5), c, neon, math.min(tr + 0.25, 0.95))
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		rig:Egg(name .. "Eye", Vector3.new(size * 0.14, size * 0.22, size * 0.1), at * CFrame.new(side * size * 0.19, size * 0.12, -size * 0.45), Colors.Black)
		rig:Egg(name .. (if side < 0 then "ArmL" else "ArmR"), Vector3.new(size * 0.3, size * 0.22, size * 0.22), at * CFrame.new(side * size * 0.55, -size * 0.05, -size * 0.05), c, neon, tr)
	end
	rig:Egg(name .. "Mouth", Vector3.new(size * 0.16, size * 0.2, size * 0.1), at * CFrame.new(0, -size * 0.14, -size * 0.46), Colors.Black)
end

-- a bat. FX.FlapBat(rig, name, at, size, angle) moves its wings.
function FX.AddBat(rig: Rig, name: string, at: CFrame, size: number)
	local wing = Color3.fromRGB(44, 30, 52)
	rig:Egg(name, Vector3.new(size * 0.5, size * 0.6, size * 0.5), at, Colors.Black)
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		rig:Block(name .. "Ear", Vector3.new(size * 0.12, size * 0.24, size * 0.08), at * CFrame.new(side * size * 0.14, size * 0.36, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, side * -0.3), Colors.Black)
		rig:Block(name .. (if side < 0 then "WingL" else "WingR"), Vector3.new(size * 0.9, size * 0.06, size * 0.5), at * CFrame.new(side * size * 0.65, size * 0.05, 0), wing)
		rig:Add(FX.Ball(rig.Parent, size * 0.1, at.Position, Colors.Warn, Enum.Material.Neon), at * CFrame.new(side * size * 0.1, size * 0.1, -size * 0.22), name .. "Eye")
	end
end

-- angle: 0 = wings flat, + = up
function FX.FlapBat(rig: Rig, name: string, at: CFrame, size: number, angle: number)
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		rig:Pose(name .. (if side < 0 then "WingL" else "WingR"), at * CFrame.new(side * size * 0.2, size * 0.05, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, side * angle) * CFrame.new(side * size * 0.45, 0, 0))
	end
end

-- a jack-o'-lantern (front = -Z). lit = glowing face with a light inside.
function FX.AddPumpkin(rig: Rig, name: string, at: CFrame, size: number, lit: boolean?)
	local orange = Colors.Orange
	local rib = orange:Lerp(Colors.Black, 0.14)
	local body = rig:Egg(name, Vector3.new(size, size * 0.82, size), at, orange)
	rig:Egg(name .. "RibL", Vector3.new(size * 0.62, size * 0.86, size * 1.02), at * CFrame.new(-size * 0.24, 0, 0), rib)
	rig:Egg(name .. "RibR", Vector3.new(size * 0.62, size * 0.86, size * 1.02), at * CFrame.new(size * 0.24, 0, 0), rib)
	rig:Cyl(name .. "Stem", size * 0.16, size * 0.3, at * CFrame.new(0, size * 0.48, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.25), Color3.fromRGB(70, 110, 50))
	local face = if lit then Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 96) else Colors.Black
	local material = if lit then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		rig:Block(name .. "Eye", Vector3.new(size * 0.2, size * 0.2, size * 0.08), at * CFrame.new(side * size * 0.22, size * 0.1, -size * 0.47) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), face, material)
	end
	for i = -1, 1 do
		rig:Block(name .. "Mouth", Vector3.new(size * 0.2, size * 0.12, size * 0.08), at * CFrame.new(i * size * 0.19, -size * 0.16 - (if i == 0 then size * 0.05 else 0), -size * 0.46), face, material)
	end
	if lit then
		FX.Light(body, orange, size * 6, 2)
	end
end

-- a flame (two glowing eggs standing on `at`). FX.Flicker(rig, name, size, t, seed) makes it dance.
function FX.AddFlame(rig: Rig, name: string, at: CFrame, size: number, color: Color3?)
	local c = color or Colors.Orange
	rig:Egg(name .. "Outer", Vector3.new(size, size * 2, size), at * CFrame.new(0, size, 0), c, Enum.Material.Neon, 0.35)
	rig:Egg(name .. "Inner", Vector3.new(size * 0.6, size * 1.3, size * 0.6), at * CFrame.new(0, size * 0.7, 0), c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.6), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.15)
end

function FX.Flicker(rig: Rig, name: string, size: number, t: number, seed: number)
	local tall = 1 + FX.Noise(seed, t * 3.1) * 0.28
	local wide = 1 + FX.Noise(seed + 7, t * 4.3) * 0.18
	rig:Resize(name .. "Outer", Vector3.new(size * wide, size * 2 * tall, size * wide))
	rig:Resize(name .. "Inner", Vector3.new(size * 0.6 * wide, size * 1.3 * tall, size * 0.6 * wide))
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Animated rigs: a Model with Motor6D joints (an R6 character, your Vampiette) playing animations YOU uploaded.
--
-- ids = the list at the top of an event's client module, one line per animation:
--       local ANIMATIONS = { Walk = 1234567890, Lunge = 0 }
--   a number (or "rbxassetid://...") = the id Roblox gave you when you uploaded that animation. It has to be
--       uploaded by the OWNER of this game (you, or the group), or Roblox refuses to play it.
--   0 = not uploaded yet. In STUDIO the KeyframeSequence with that name in the module's own "Animations"
--       folder is then played directly, so you can watch an animation before you upload it.
--       In the real game an animation with no id does not play.
---------------------------------------------------------------------

export type Actor = {
	Model: Model,
	Root: BasePart,
	Animated: boolean,                                                                    -- at least one animation is there to play
	Place: (cframe: CFrame) -> (),                                                        -- where its ROOT part is
	Has: (name: string) -> boolean,
	Play: (name: string, fade: number?, speed: number?, at: number?) -> AnimationTrack?,  -- at = start (again) from that many seconds in
	Stop: (name: string?, fade: number?) -> (),                                           -- no name = every animation
	Seek: (name: string, at: number, fade: number?) -> (),                                -- hold it at that moment (call every frame to drive it by the clock)
	Playing: (name: string) -> boolean,
	Part: (name: string) -> BasePart?,
}

local registered: { [Instance]: string } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local previews: { [string]: boolean } = {}   -- ids that are Studio previews (not uploads)
local previewBroken = false                    -- this Studio would not play a KeyframeSequence directly: stop trying
local toldAbout: { [string]: boolean } = {}

-- Studio only: an id that plays a KeyframeSequence straight from the Explorer (nil when Studio will not give one)
local function previewId(sequence: Instance): string?
	local provider: any = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider")
	local plain: string? = nil
	for _, method in { "RegisterKeyframeSequence", "RegisterActiveKeyframeSequence" } do
		local ok, result = pcall(function(): any
			return provider[method](provider, sequence)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "string" and result ~= "" then
			if string.find(result, "://", 1, true) then
				return result
			end
			plain = plain or result -- (not a full address: kept only if nothing better comes)
		end
	end
	return plain
end

-- The "Animations" folders an event's module can keep its animations in: inside the module itself, or next to it
-- (ReplicatedStorage > EventClients > Animations). Sub-folders are fine.
local function animationFolders(source: Instance?): { Instance }
	local folders: { Instance } = {}
	if source then
		local inside = source:FindFirstChild("Animations")
		if inside then
			table.insert(folders, inside)
		end
		local parent = source.Parent
		local beside = parent and parent:FindFirstChild("Animations")
		if beside then
			table.insert(folders, beside)
		end
	end
	return folders
end

local function plainName(name: string): string
	return (string.lower(name):gsub("[%s_%-]", ""))
end

-- the Animation (uploaded, has an id) and / or KeyframeSequence called `name` in those folders (capitals and spaces do not matter)
local function findAnimation(folders: { Instance }, name: string): (Animation?, KeyframeSequence?)
	local want = plainName(name)
	local animation: Animation? = nil
	local sequence: KeyframeSequence? = nil
	for _, folder in folders do
		for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do
			if plainName(item.Name) == want then
				if item:IsA("Animation") and not animation then
					animation = item
				elseif item:IsA("KeyframeSequence") and not sequence then
					sequence = item
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return animation, sequence
end

-- what to play for each animation name: { Walk = "rbxassetid://123", ... } (a name that cannot play is left out).
-- An animation is taken from, in this order: the id in `ids`; an Animation object with that name (and an
-- AnimationId) in an Animations folder; in Studio only, a KeyframeSequence with that name in an Animations folder.
function FX.Animations(ids: { [string]: any }?, source: Instance?): { [string]: string }
	local found: { [string]: string } = {}
	if type(ids) ~= "table" then
		return found
	end
	local uploaded: { string }, preview: { string }, missing: { string } = {}, {}, {}
	local folders = animationFolders(source)
	for name, value in ids do
		local id: string? = nil
		if type(value) == "number" and value > 0 then
			id = "rbxassetid://" .. string.format("%.0f", value)
		elseif type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" and value ~= "0" then
			id = if tonumber(value) then "rbxassetid://" .. value else value
		end
		local animation, sequence = findAnimation(folders, name)
		if not id and animation and animation.AnimationId ~= "" then
			id = animation.AnimationId -- (an Animation object you made from the upload)
		end
		if id then
			table.insert(uploaded, name)
		elseif RunService:IsStudio() and not previewBroken then
			if sequence then
				id = registered[sequence]
				if not id then
					id = previewId(sequence)
					if id then
						registered[sequence] = id
						previews[id] = true
					else
						warnOnce("register" .. name, "Studio would not preview the animation '" .. name .. "' (it will play once it is uploaded and its id is pasted in)")
					end
				end
			end
			table.insert(if id then preview else missing, name)
		else
			table.insert(missing, name)
		end
		if id then
			found[name] = id
		end
	end
	-- say once, in plain words, where each animation comes from
	local who = if source then source.Name else "?"
	if not toldAbout[who] then
		toldAbout[who] = true
		table.sort(uploaded)
		table.sort(preview)
		table.sort(missing)
		if #preview > 0 then
			print(("[EventFX] %s: playing %s straight from the KeyframeSequences in its Animations folder. That only works in STUDIO: upload them (right-click > Save to Roblox) and paste the ids at the top of the module for the real game."):format(who, table.concat(preview, ", ")))
		end
		if #missing > 0 then
			-- say what IS in the folders, so a wrong name or an empty AnimationId is easy to spot
			local seen: { string } = {}
			for _, folder in folders do
				for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do
					if item:IsA("Animation") then
						table.insert(seen, item.Name .. (if item.AnimationId == "" then " (Animation with an EMPTY AnimationId)" else " (Animation)"))
					elseif item:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
						table.insert(seen, item.Name .. " (KeyframeSequence)")
					end
				end
			end
			table.sort(seen)
			local why = "no id at the top of the module, and no Animation object with that name and an AnimationId in an Animations folder inside the module or next to it. "
				.. (if #folders == 0 then "No Animations folder was found" elseif #seen == 0 then "The Animations folder has no Animation in it" else "In the Animations folder: " .. table.concat(seen, ", "))
			if #uploaded + #preview == 0 then
				warn(("[EventFX] %s: none of its animations can play yet (%s: %s), so the built-in look is used."):format(who, table.concat(missing, ", "), why))
			else
				warn(("[EventFX] %s: no animation for %s (%s). Those moves are skipped."):format(who, table.concat(missing, ", "), why))
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

-- Gets a rig ready to be animated and moved by its root: the root is anchored, everything joined to it follows,
-- nothing collides, and a Humanoid inside keeps quiet (no name, no health bar, no walking about).
-- Call it BEFORE the model goes into the workspace; the animations are loaded the first time one is played.
function FX.Actor(model: Model, ids: { [string]: any }?, source: Instance?): Actor
	local parts: { BasePart } = {}
	local links: { [BasePart]: { BasePart } } = {}
	local function link(a: BasePart?, b: BasePart?)
		if a and b then
			local la = links[a] or {}
			links[a] = la
			table.insert(la, b)
			local lb = links[b] or {}
			links[b] = lb
			table.insert(lb, a)
		end
	end
	local humanoid: Humanoid? = nil
	local controller: AnimationController? = nil
	for _, item in model:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(parts, item)
		elseif item:IsA("JointInstance") then
			link(item.Part0, item.Part1)
		elseif item:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
			link(item.Part0, item.Part1)
		elseif item:IsA("Humanoid") then
			humanoid = item
		elseif item:IsA("AnimationController") then
			controller = item
		elseif item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or item:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or item:IsA("ForceField") then
			item:Destroy()
		end
	end
	-- the root: the HumanoidRootPart when there is one (every other part of a character hangs from it)
	local root: BasePart? = nil
	local named = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart", true)
	if named and named:IsA("BasePart") then
		root = named
	else
		root = model.PrimaryPart or parts[1]
	end
	if not root then
		-- (a model with no parts: nothing to move, nothing to animate)
		local empty = Instance.new("Part")
		empty.Name = "Root"
		empty.Anchored = true
		empty.Transparency = 1
		empty.CanCollide, empty.CanQuery, empty.CanTouch = false, false, false
		empty.Parent = model
		root = empty
		table.insert(parts, empty)
	end
	local rootPart: BasePart = root :: BasePart
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
		humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
		humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
		humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
		-- (a Humanoid keeps making its torso and head solid again; with its own brain switched off it stops)
		pcall(function()
			(humanoid :: any).EvaluateStateMachine = false
		end)
	end
	-- which parts hang on the root through joints / welds (they follow it); the others are carried by hand
	local joined: { [BasePart]: boolean } = { [rootPart] = true }
	local queue: { BasePart } = { rootPart }
	while #queue > 0 do
		local part = table.remove(queue) :: BasePart
		local others: { BasePart } = links[part] or {}
		for _, other in others do
			if not joined[other] then
				joined[other] = true
				table.insert(queue, other)
			end
		end
	end
	local loose: { [BasePart]: CFrame } = {}
	for _, part in parts do
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.Massless = true
		if part == rootPart then
			part.Anchored = true
		elseif joined[part] then
			part.Anchored = false
		else
			part.Anchored = true
			loose[part] = rootPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
		end
	end

	local content = FX.Animations(ids, source)
	local tracks: { [string]: AnimationTrack } = {}
	local loaded = false
	local function load(): boolean
		if loaded then
			return true
		end
		if not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			return false -- (animations can only be loaded on a rig that is in the world)
		end
		loaded = true
		if next(content) == nil then
			return true
		end
		local host: Instance? = humanoid or controller
		if not host then
			local made = Instance.new("AnimationController")
			made.Parent = model
			host = made
		end
		local animator: Animator
		local existing = (host :: Instance):FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if existing then
			animator = existing
		else
			local made = Instance.new("Animator")
			made.Parent = host
			animator = made
		end
		for name, id in content do
			local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
			animation.Name = name
			animation.AnimationId = id
			local ok, track = pcall(function(): AnimationTrack
				return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
			end)
			if ok and track then
				tracks[name] = track
			else
				warnOnce("load" .. id, "the animation '" .. name .. "' (" .. id .. ") could not be loaded: " .. tostring(track))
			end
		end
		-- an animation that is still empty after a while is not going to play
		task.delay(3, function()
			-- (a Studio preview is there at once, or never: if no track has any length AND no joint has been moved, it is not working)
			if previewBroken or not model.Parent then
				return
			end
			local empty: string? = nil
			for name, track in tracks do
				local id = content[name]
				if id and previews[id] then
					if track.Length > 0 then
						return
					end
					empty = empty or name
				end
			end
			if not empty then
				return
			end
			for _, item in model:GetDescendants() do
				if item:IsA("Motor6D") and item.Transform ~= CFrame.identity then
					return
				end
			end
			previewBroken = true
			warnOnce("preview", ("this Studio did not play the KeyframeSequence '%s' straight from the Animations folder (the id it gave was '%s'). The animations will show once they are uploaded and their ids are pasted in; until then the built-in look is used."):format(empty, tostring(content[empty])))
		end)
		task.delay(8, function()
			-- (an upload that Roblox refuses is nearly always one uploaded by somebody who does not own the game)
			for name, track in tracks do
				local id = content[name]
				if id and not previews[id] and track.Length <= 0 and model.Parent then
					warnOnce("empty" .. id, ("the animation '%s' (%s) did not load. Was it uploaded by the owner of this game (you or the group), and is the id right?"):format(name, id))
				end
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	local found: { [string]: BasePart } = {}
	local actor: Actor
	actor = {
		Model = model,
		Root = rootPart,
		Animated = next(content) ~= nil,
		Place = function(cframe: CFrame)
			rootPart.CFrame = cframe
			for part, offset in loose do
				part.CFrame = cframe * offset
			end
		end,
		Has = function(name: string): boolean
			return content[name] ~= nil
		end,
		Play = function(name: string, fade: number?, speed: number?, at: number?): AnimationTrack?
			if not load() then
				return nil
			end
			local track = tracks[name]
			if not track then
				return nil
			end
			if not track.IsPlaying then
				track:Play(fade or 0.1, 1, speed or 1)
			elseif speed then
				track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
			end
			if at then
				track.TimePosition = at
			end
			return track
		end,
		Stop = function(name: string?, fade: number?)
			for trackName, track in tracks do
				if (name == nil or name == trackName) and track.IsPlaying then
					track:Stop(fade or 0.1)
				end
			end
		end,
		Seek = function(name: string, at: number, fade: number?)
			if not load() then
				return
			end
			local track = tracks[name]
			if not track then
				return
			end
			if not track.IsPlaying then
				track:Play(fade or 0.1, 1, 0)
			end
			track:AdjustSpeed(0)
			local length = track.Length
			track.TimePosition = if length > 0 then math.clamp(at, 0, length - 0.01) else math.max(at, 0)
		end,
		Playing = function(name: string): boolean
			local track: AnimationTrack? = tracks[name]
			return track ~= nil and track.IsPlaying
		end,
		Part = function(name: string): BasePart?
			local part = found[name]
			if part and part.Parent then
				return part
			end
			local item = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
			if item and item:IsA("BasePart") then
				found[name] = item
				return item
			end
			return nil
		end,
	}
	return actor
end

-- Why a model can NOT play the R6 animations (nil = it can): it needs the six R6 body parts, each on a Motor6D.
local R6_PARTS = { "Torso", "Head", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg" }
function FX.R6Problem(model: Instance): string?
	local onMotor: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, item in model:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("Motor6D") and item.Part0 and item.Part1 then
			onMotor[item.Part1.Name] = true
		end
	end
	local problem: string? = nil
	for _, name in R6_PARTS do
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if not (part and part:IsA("BasePart")) then
			problem = "it has no part named '" .. name .. "' (the animations are made for R6 rigs)"
			break
		end
		if not onMotor[name] then
			problem = "its '" .. name .. "' does not hang on a Motor6D joint"
			break
		end
	end
	if problem and model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso", true) then
		return "it is an R15 rig (it has an UpperTorso) and the animations are made for R6"
	end
	return problem
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Vampiette (Vampiette Says, Vampiette's Tantrum, Vampiette's Group Photo)
-- Uses YOUR model when it can find one: a Model named "Vampiette" or "Vampire" under the event's own script
-- (it is copied to ReplicatedStorage > EventAssets > <event id>), else the one from Vampiette's Shop
-- (EventAssets > vampmerchant > Vampire). No model = a stand-in built from parts.
-- An event that has uploaded animations for her (Vampiette's Tantrum) passes them in: they play when your
-- model is an R6 rig (Torso, Head, Left Arm, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg, each on a Motor6D).
---------------------------------------------------------------------

FX.VampietteOptions = {
	Scale = 1.75,   -- how much bigger than the model she is shown (she has to be seen from across the arena)
	Yaw = 0,        -- degrees: turn her if she faces the wrong way (her front should be -Z)
	Raise = 0,      -- studs: lift her if her feet sink into the floor (or lower her with a negative number)
}

export type Vampiette = {
	Model: Instance,
	Custom: boolean,                                   -- true = your model, false = the stand-in
	Animated: boolean,                                 -- true = she is a jointed rig playing uploaded animations (see FX.Actor)
	Height: number,                                    -- feet to the top of her head
	Place: (cframe: CFrame) -> (),                     -- cframe = where her FEET are and which way she faces
	Arm: (side: string, pitch: number, roll: number?) -> (), -- "Left" / "Right"; pitch 0 = down, 1.57 = pointing forward, 3.14 = straight up (does nothing while Animated)
	Head: () -> Vector3,                               -- where her head is right now
	Feet: () -> CFrame,
	-- the animations (they do nothing, and Has says false, when she is not Animated):
	Has: (name: string) -> boolean,
	Play: (name: string, fade: number?, speed: number?, at: number?) -> AnimationTrack?,
	Stop: (name: string?, fade: number?) -> (),
	Seek: (name: string, at: number, fade: number?) -> (),
	Part: (name: string) -> BasePart?,                 -- one of her body parts ("Right Arm"), if her model has it
}

local function extentY(part: BasePart): number
	local cf, size = part.CFrame, part.Size
	return (math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * size.X + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * size.Z) / 2
end

local function findVampietteModel(eventId: string?): Model?
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("EventAssets")
	if not assets then
		return nil
	end
	local function named(container: Instance?): Model?
		if not container then
			return nil
		end
		for _, name in { "Vampiette", "Vampire" } do
			local found = container:FindFirstChild(name)
			if found and found:IsA("Model") then
				return found
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
