````lua
	local model = named(eventId and assets:FindFirstChild(eventId)) or named(assets:FindFirstChild("vampmerchant"))
	if model then
		return model
	end
	for _, item in assets:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("Model") and (item.Name == "Vampiette" or item.Name == "Vampire") then
			return item
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function buildVampiette(parent: Instance): Rig
	local rig = FX.Rig(parent)
	local black, red, skin, white = Color3.fromRGB(24, 18, 26), Color3.fromRGB(170, 26, 48), Color3.fromRGB(242, 228, 228), Colors.White
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		rig:Egg("Shoe", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.42, 1.05), CFrame.new(side * 0.45, 0.21, -0.1), red)
		rig:Cyl("Leg", 0.42, 1.3, CFrame.new(side * 0.45, 1, 0), black)
	end
	rig:Cyl("Frill", 3.15, 0.14, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0), white)
	rig:Cyl("Skirt1", 3, 0.5, CFrame.new(0, 1.78, 0), black)
	rig:Cyl("Skirt2", 2.5, 0.5, CFrame.new(0, 2.24, 0), red)
	rig:Cyl("Skirt3", 2, 0.5, CFrame.new(0, 2.7, 0), black)
	rig:Block("Torso", Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 0.9), CFrame.new(0, 3.55, 0), black)
	rig:Block("Bow", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.3, 0.12), CFrame.new(0, 3.95, -0.5), red)
	rig:Block("Collar", Vector3.new(1.1, 0.2, 0.96), CFrame.new(0, 4.3, 0), white)
	rig:Block("Cape", Vector3.new(2.3, 2.9, 0.15), CFrame.new(0, 3.2, 0.62), black)
	rig:Block("CapeInside", Vector3.new(2.1, 2.7, 0.06), CFrame.new(0, 3.2, 0.52), red)
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		rig:Egg(if side < 0 then "Left Arm" else "Right Arm", Vector3.new(0.52, 1.7, 0.52), CFrame.new(side * 1.05, 3.5, 0), skin)
		rig:Wedge("CollarWing", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.8, 0.7), CFrame.new(side * 0.72, 4.65, 0.4) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0), black)
		rig:Egg("Tail", Vector3.new(0.72, 1.9, 0.72), CFrame.new(side * 1.28, 4.65, 0.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, side * math.rad(14)), black)
		rig:Ball("Ribbon", 0.46, Vector3.new(side * 1.05, 5.8, 0.1), red)
		rig:Add(FX.Ball(parent, 0.3, Vector3.new(), Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 100), Enum.Material.Neon), CFrame.new(side * 0.38, 5.2, -0.8), "Eye")
		rig:Block("Fang", Vector3.new(0.1, 0.2, 0.08), CFrame.new(side * 0.15, 4.72, -0.84), white)
	end
	rig:Egg("Hair", Vector3.new(2.05, 1.95, 1.75), CFrame.new(0, 5.25, 0.25), black)
	rig:Ball("Head", 1.8, Vector3.new(0, 5.15, 0), skin)
	rig:Block("Fringe", Vector3.new(1.7, 0.45, 0.4), CFrame.new(0, 5.8, -0.72), black)
	rig:Block("Smile", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.08, 0.06), CFrame.new(0, 4.84, -0.86), red)
	return rig
end

local announcedVampiette = false
local announcedRig = false

-- Makes Vampiette inside `parent` (the visual's own instance, so she goes when it goes).
-- ids + source (optional) = the event's animation list and its module script (see FX.Actor): if YOUR model is an
-- R6 rig and at least one of the animations can play, she is animated by them (Animated = true) instead of
-- being moved as one frozen piece.
function FX.Vampiette(parent: Instance, eventId: string?, ids: { [string]: any }?, source: Instance?): Vampiette
	local options = FX.VampietteOptions
	local feet = CFrame.new()
	local arms: { [string]: { Pitch: number, Roll: number } } = { Left = { Pitch = 0, Roll = 0 }, Right = { Pitch = 0, Roll = 0 } }
	local original = findVampietteModel(eventId)
	local clone: Model? = nil
	if original then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return original:Clone()
		end)
		if ok and result and result:IsA("Model") then
			clone = result
		end
	end

	if clone then
		local model: Model = clone
		-- can she play the animations? (only asked when the event has some)
		local problem: string? = nil
		local animate = false
		if ids ~= nil then
			problem = FX.R6Problem(model)
			if not problem then
				animate = next(FX.Animations(ids, source)) ~= nil
				if not animate then
					problem = "none of this event's animations can play yet (see the message about ids above)"
				end
			end
			if not announcedRig then
				announcedRig = true
				if animate then
					print("[EventFX] Vampiette: your model is an R6 rig, so she plays the uploaded animations")
				else
					warn("[EventFX] Vampiette: she is shown WITHOUT the uploaded animations (the built-in moves are used instead), because " .. tostring(problem))
				end
			end
		end
		for _, item in model:GetDescendants() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item.Anchored = true
				item.CanCollide = false
				item.CanQuery = false
				item.CanTouch = false
			elseif item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or item:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				item:Destroy()
			elseif item:IsA("Humanoid") then
				item.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
				item.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * options.Scale)
		end)
		-- stand her at the middle of the world, measure her, and remember where every part sits (so she can be
		-- put anywhere, any number of times, without the parts ever drifting apart)
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
		local lowest, highest = math.huge, -math.huge
		local count = 0
		local sits: { [BasePart]: CFrame } = {}
		for _, item in model:GetDescendants() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				sits[item] = item.CFrame
				if item.Transparency < 0.99 then
					count += 1
					lowest = math.min(lowest, item.Position.Y - extentY(item))
					highest = math.max(highest, item.Position.Y + extentY(item))
				end
			end
		end
		if count == 0 then
			lowest, highest = -3, 3
		end
		local pivotAboveFeet = -lowest
		local height = highest - lowest
		local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head", true)
		local rest: { [string]: BasePart } = {}
		for _, side in { "Left", "Right" } do
			local arm = model:FindFirstChild(side .. " Arm", true)
			if arm and arm:IsA("BasePart") then
				rest[side] = arm
			end
		end
		if not announcedVampiette then
			announcedVampiette = true
			print(("[EventFX] Vampiette: using your model %s (%d parts, %.1f studs tall after scaling x%.2f, arms that can move: %s)"):format(
				original and original:GetFullName() or "?", count, height, options.Scale, if rest.Left and rest.Right then "yes" else "no (not R6 names)"))
		end
		local function headPosition(): Vector3
			if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
				return head.Position
			end
			return (feet * CFrame.new(0, height * 0.88, 0)).Position
		end

		if animate then
			-- a jointed rig: only her root is placed, the joints (and the animations) do the rest
			local actor = FX.Actor(model, ids, source)
			local rootSit = sits[actor.Root] or CFrame.new()
			model.Parent = parent
			return {
				Model = model, Custom = true, Animated = true, Height = height,
				Place = function(cframe: CFrame)
					feet = cframe
					actor.Place(cframe * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(options.Yaw), 0) * CFrame.new(0, pivotAboveFeet + options.Raise, 0) * rootSit)
				end,
				Arm = function(_side: string, _pitch: number, _roll: number?) end,
				Head = headPosition,
				Feet = function(): CFrame
					return feet
				end,
				Has = actor.Has, Play = actor.Play, Stop = actor.Stop, Seek = actor.Seek, Part = actor.Part,
			}
		end

		model.Parent = parent
		return {
			Model = model, Custom = true, Animated = false, Height = height,
			Place = function(cframe: CFrame)
				feet = cframe
				local pivot = cframe * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(options.Yaw), 0) * CFrame.new(0, pivotAboveFeet + options.Raise, 0)
				for part, sit in sits do
					part.CFrame = pivot * sit
				end
				-- her arms turn about the shoulder (a quarter of the way down from the top of the arm)
				for side, arm in rest do
					local pose = arms[side]
					local shoulder = Vector3.new(0, arm.Size.Y * 0.25, 0)
					arm.CFrame = pivot * sits[arm] * CFrame.new(shoulder) * CFrame.Angles(pose.Pitch, 0, (if side == "Left" then -1 else 1) * pose.Roll) * CFrame.new(-shoulder)
				end
			end,
			Arm = function(side: string, pitch: number, roll: number?)
				local pose = arms[side]
				if pose then
					pose.Pitch, pose.Roll = pitch, roll or 0
				end
			end,
			Head = headPosition,
			Feet = function(): CFrame
				return feet
			end,
			Has = function(_name: string): boolean
				return false
			end,
			Play = function(_name: string, _fade: number?, _speed: number?, _at: number?): AnimationTrack?
				return nil
			end,
			Stop = function(_name: string?, _fade: number?) end,
			Seek = function(_name: string, _at: number, _fade: number?) end,
			Part = function(name: string): BasePart?
				local item = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
				return if item and item:IsA("BasePart") then item else nil
			end,
		}
	end

	if not announcedVampiette then
		announcedVampiette = true
		print("[EventFX] Vampiette: no model named 'Vampiette' or 'Vampire' found in ReplicatedStorage > EventAssets, so a stand-in built from parts is shown")
	end
	if ids ~= nil and not announcedRig then
		announcedRig = true
		warn("[EventFX] Vampiette: the uploaded animations need YOUR Vampiette model (an R6 rig named 'Vampiette' or 'Vampire'). The stand-in uses its built-in moves.")
	end
	local holder = Instance.new("Model")
	holder.Name = "Vampiette"
	holder.Parent = parent
	local rig = buildVampiette(holder)
	local scale = options.Scale * 0.9
	local restArm: { [string]: CFrame } = { Left = rig:Offset("Left Arm"), Right = rig:Offset("Right Arm") }
	return {
		Model = holder, Custom = false, Animated = false, Height = 6.4 * scale,
		Place = function(cframe: CFrame)
			feet = cframe
			for side, base in restArm do
				local pose = arms[side]
				local shoulder = Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
				rig:Pose(side .. " Arm", base * CFrame.new(shoulder) * CFrame.Angles(pose.Pitch, 0, (if side == "Left" then -1 else 1) * pose.Roll) * CFrame.new(-shoulder))
			end
			rig:Move(cframe * CFrame.new(0, options.Raise, 0), scale)
		end,
		Arm = function(side: string, pitch: number, roll: number?)
			local pose = arms[side]
			if pose then
				pose.Pitch, pose.Roll = pitch, roll or 0
			end
		end,
		Head = function(): Vector3
			return (feet * CFrame.new(0, 5.15 * scale, 0)).Position
		end,
		Feet = function(): CFrame
			return feet
		end,
		Has = function(_name: string): boolean
			return false
		end,
		Play = function(_name: string, _fade: number?, _speed: number?, _at: number?): AnimationTrack?
			return nil
		end,
		Stop = function(_name: string?, _fade: number?) end,
		Seek = function(_name: string, _at: number, _fade: number?) end,
		Part = function(_name: string): BasePart?
			return nil
		end,
	}
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FX.Module: how an event's client module plugs into your visuals framework (EventVisualsClient).
--
--   return FX.Module({
--       Rope = {                                   -- the asset name the server used in K.Show(context, "Rope", ...)
--           Init = function(self, props) ... end,  -- build it: put parts under self.Inst
--           Step = function(self, dt, t) ... end,  -- every frame (t = seconds since props.T0, same on every client)
--           Done = function(self) ... end,         -- it is going away (optional)
--           Hit = function(self, userId) ... end,  -- any other name: the server called K.Call / K.Signal(id, "Hit", ...)
--       },
--   })
--
-- self.Inst    the instance the framework made for this visual (everything under it goes when the visual goes)
-- self.Origin  the CFrame the server gave it          self.Props  the plain values the server sent
-- self:Time()  seconds since props.T0 (server clock)  self.Alive  false once it has been removed
-- self:After(seconds, fn) / self:At(serverTime, fn)   run fn later, only if the visual is still there
-- self:Keep(x)  something else to clean up with it (an Instance, a connection, or a function)
-- Screen effects that undo themselves if the visual is removed early:
-- self:Vignette / self:VignetteOff / self:FOV / self:FOVReset / self:Tint() / self:Rumble(...)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local Visual = {}
Visual.__index = Visual

local stepping: { any } = {}
local stepConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

local function trace(err: any): string
	return debug.traceback(tostring(err), 2)
end

local function run(self: any, what: string, fn: any, ...: any): boolean
	local ok, err = xpcall(fn, trace, ...)
	if not ok then
		warnOnce(tostring(self.Asset) .. what, "the '" .. tostring(self.Asset) .. "' visual failed in " .. what .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
	return ok
end

local function stopStepperIfIdle()
	local connection = stepConnection
	if connection and #stepping == 0 and #chunks == 0 then
		connection:Disconnect()
		stepConnection = nil
	end
end

needStepper = function()
	if stepConnection then
		return
	end
	stepConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(frame: number)
		local dt = math.min(frame, 0.1)
		for index = #stepping, 1, -1 do
			local self = stepping[index]
			if not self.Alive then
				table.remove(stepping, index)
			elseif not run(self, "Step", self.Def.Step, self, dt, FX.Now() - self.T0) then
				table.remove(stepping, index) -- (an error in Step: stop calling it, keep the rest alive)
			end
		end
		stepChunks(dt)
		stopStepperIfIdle()
	end)
end

function Visual.Time(self: any): number
	return FX.Now() - self.T0
end

function Visual.After(self: any, seconds: number, fn: () -> ())
	task.delay(math.max(seconds, 0), function()
		if self.Alive then
			run(self, "a delayed step", fn)
		end
	end)
end

function Visual.At(self: any, serverTime: number, fn: () -> ())
	self:After(serverTime - FX.Now(), fn)
end

function Visual.Keep(self: any, thing: any): any
	table.insert(self.Trash, thing)
	return thing
end

function Visual.Vignette(self: any, transparency: number, seconds: number?, color: Color3?)
	self.VignetteOn = true
	FX.Vignette(transparency, seconds, color)
end

function Visual.VignetteOff(self: any, seconds: number?)
	if self.VignetteOn then
		self.VignetteOn = false
		FX.VignetteOff(seconds)
	end
end

function Visual.FOV(self: any, delta: number, seconds: number?)
	self.FovOn = true
	FX.FOV(delta, seconds)
end

function Visual.FOVReset(self: any, seconds: number?)
	if self.FovOn then
		self.FovOn = false
		FX.FOVReset(seconds)
	end
end

function Visual.Tint(self: any): any
	local tint = FX.Tint()
	table.insert(self.Tints, tint)
	return tint
end

function Visual.Rumble(self: any, from: number, to: number, duration: number, roughness: number?, position: Vector3?): (fadeOut: number?) -> ()
	local stop = FX.Rumble(from, to, duration, roughness, position)
	table.insert(self.Rumbles, stop)
	return stop
end

-- the standard "this player got hit" effect (also what the server's K.Strike shows when a visual has no Hit of its own)
function Visual.Hurt(self: any, userId: number, color: Color3?)
	local root = FX.Root(userId)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local c = color or Colors.Warn
	FX.Burst(root.Position, "Spark", 14, { Color = c })
	FX.Ring(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0), 0.5, 4.5, 0.3, c)
	FX.Sound("Thud", root.Position, 0.7, 1.3)
	if FX.IsMe(userId) then
		FX.Shake(4, 14, 0.03, 0.35)
		FX.Pulse(Colors.Blood, 0.5, 0.25)
	end
end

local function finishVisual(self: any)
	if not self.Alive then
		return
	end
	self.Alive = false
	if self.Def.Done then
		run(self, "Done", self.Def.Done, self)
	end
	if self.VignetteOn then
		self.VignetteOn = false
		FX.VignetteOff(0.4)
	end
	if self.FovOn then
		self.FovOn = false
		FX.FOVReset(0.4)
	end
	for _, tint in self.Tints do
		tint.Back(0.3)
		tint.Remove(0.35)
	end
	for _, stop in self.Rumbles do
		stop(0.2)
	end
	for index = #self.Trash, 1, -1 do
		local thing = self.Trash[index]
		if typeof(thing) == "Instance" then
			thing:Destroy()
		elseif typeof(thing) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
			thing:Disconnect()
		elseif type(thing) == "function" then
			pcall(thing)
		elseif type(thing) == "table" and type(thing.Destroy) == "function" then
			pcall(thing.Destroy)
		end
	end
	table.clear(self.Trash)
end

-- Tells the event's SERVER script something (a click on one of this visual's buttons, an answer ...). Over there:
--     context.ListenForHits(function(player, ...) end)
-- WHO sent it comes from Roblox, never from the client; everything after that is the client's word, so the server
-- checks it. (The event's name travels in the props: EventUtil.Show puts it there.)
local hitRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
function Visual.Send(self: any, ...: any)
	local name = self.Props and self.Props.EventName
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		warnOnce("send" .. tostring(self.Asset), "ServerScriptService > Systems > EventUtil is an OLDER copy than the '" .. tostring(self.Asset) .. "' visual was made for (it sent no EventName), so its buttons do nothing. Install the WHOLE update (drag its .rbxmx in).")
		return
	end
	if not hitRemote then
		local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
		local found = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("EventHit")
		if found and found:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			hitRemote = found
		end
	end
	if hitRemote then
		hitRemote:FireServer(name, ...)
	end
end

local RESERVED = { Init = true, Step = true, Done = true }
local DEFAULT_METHODS: { [string]: any } = {
	Hit = function(self: any, userId: number)
		self:Hurt(userId)
	end,
	Outro = function(self: any, seconds: number?)
		FX.FadeOut(self.Inst, seconds or 0.8)
	end,
}

function FX.Module(assets: { [string]: { [string]: any } }): { [string]: any }
	local module: { [string]: any } = {}
	local live: { [Instance]: any } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any

	-- The framework asks for a placeholder when there is no model named like the asset in EventAssets:
	-- an empty Model with one invisible root part. Init builds the real thing under it.
	function module.Build(asset: string, _props: any): Instance
		local model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = asset
		local root = FX.Block(model, Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), CFrame.new(), Colors.White, nil, 1)
		root.Name = "Root"
		model.PrimaryPart = root
		return model
	end

	function module.Spawned(inst: Instance, state: any, props: any)
		local asset: string = (type(state) == "table" and type(state.Asset) == "string" and state.Asset) or inst.Name
		local def = assets[asset]
		if not def then
			warnOnce("asset" .. asset, "this event's client module has no visual named '" .. asset .. "'")
			return
		end
		local values: { [string]: any } = if type(props) == "table" then props else {}
		local self = setmetatable({
			Inst = inst, Def = def, Asset = asset, Props = values,
			Origin = if inst:IsA("PVInstance") then inst:GetPivot() else CFrame.new(),
			T0 = tonumber(values.T0) or FX.Now(),
			Alive = true, Trash = {}, Tints = {}, Rumbles = {}, VignetteOn = false, FovOn = false,
		}, Visual)
		live[inst] = self
		inst.Destroying:Once(function()
			finishVisual(self)
		end)
		if def.Init then
			run(self, "Init", def.Init, self, values)
		end
		if self.Alive and def.Step then
			table.insert(stepping, self)
			needStepper()
		end
	end

	function module.Destroyed(inst: Instance, _state: any)
		local self = live[inst]
		if self then
			finishVisual(self)
		end
	end

	local names: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for name in DEFAULT_METHODS do
		names[name] = true
	end
	for _, def in assets do
		for name, value in def do
			if type(value) == "function" and not RESERVED[name] then
				names[name] = true
			end
		end
	end
	for name in names do
		module[name] = function(inst: Instance, _state: any, ...: any)
			local self = live[inst]
			if not self or not self.Alive then
				return
			end
			local fn = self.Def[name] or DEFAULT_METHODS[name]
			if fn then
				run(self, name, fn, self, ...)
			end
		end
	end
	return module
end

-- how many visuals / flying bits are being animated right now (for testing)
function FX.Busy(): (number, number, boolean)
	return #stepping, #chunks, stepConnection ~= nil
end

-- An event module's own sound slots. Put your uploaded id in Id; while Id is "" the built-in Roblox sound in
-- Stand plays instead (Stand = "" means silence). The FIRST module that names a slot owns it, so a slot name
-- used by two modules (e.g. "ImpCackle") must get the same id in both.
--   FX.UseSounds({ PhoneRing = { Id = "", Stand = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", Speed = 1, Volume = 1 } })
function FX.UseSounds(slots: { [string]: { [string]: any } })
	for name, entry in slots do
		if (FX.Sounds :: any)[name] == nil then
			local id = tostring(entry.Id or "")
			if id == "" then
				id = tostring(entry.Stand or "")
			end
			(FX.Sounds :: any)[name] = { Id = id, Speed = tonumber(entry.Speed) or 1, Volume = tonumber(entry.Volume) or 1 }
			local full = soundId(id)
			if full ~= "" then
				checkSound(full)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- The imp (front = -Z, `at` = between its feet). Parts: <name> (belly), <name>Head, <name>Eye, <name>Horn,
-- <name>ArmL / ArmR, <name>WingL / WingR, <name>Tail, <name>Grin. Pose it with FX.PoseImp.
local IMP_SKIN = Color3.fromRGB(78, 42, 40)
local IMP_DARK = Color3.fromRGB(36, 24, 26)
local IMP_HORN = Color3.fromRGB(176, 164, 136)
local IMP_EYE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 132, 40)
FX.ImpColors = { Skin = IMP_SKIN, Dark = IMP_DARK, Horn = IMP_HORN, Eye = IMP_EYE }

local function impArm(at: CFrame, s: number, side: number, raise: number): CFrame
	return at * CFrame.new(side * s * 0.42, s * 0.92, -s * 0.1) * CFrame.Angles(-raise * 2.7, 0, side * 0.3) * CFrame.new(0, -s * 0.27, 0)
end

local function impWing(at: CFrame, s: number, side: number, flap: number): CFrame
	return at * CFrame.new(side * s * 0.3, s * 1.0, s * 0.3) * CFrame.Angles(0, side * (0.45 + flap * 0.7), 0) * CFrame.new(side * s * 0.28, 0, s * 0.18)
end

function FX.AddImp(rig: Rig, name: string, at: CFrame, size: number)
	local s = size
	rig:Egg(name, Vector3.new(s * 0.86, s * 0.92, s * 0.8), at * CFrame.new(0, s * 0.62, 0.02 * s) * CFrame.Angles(-0.22, 0, 0), IMP_SKIN)
	rig:Egg(name .. "Head", Vector3.new(s * 0.74, s * 0.64, s * 0.68), at * CFrame.new(0, s * 1.28, -s * 0.2), IMP_SKIN)
	rig:Block(name .. "Grin", Vector3.new(s * 0.38, s * 0.05, s * 0.05), at * CFrame.new(0, s * 1.13, -s * 0.52), IMP_EYE, Enum.Material.Neon)
	rig:Line(name .. "Tail", at * Vector3.new(0, s * 0.42, s * 0.36), at * Vector3.new(s * 0.1, s * 0.18, s * 1.0), s * 0.08, IMP_DARK)
	rig:Egg(name .. "TailTip", Vector3.new(s * 0.08, s * 0.24, s * 0.22), at * CFrame.new(s * 0.11, s * 0.18, s * 1.06), IMP_DARK)
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		rig:Add(FX.Ball(rig.Parent, s * 0.15, at.Position, IMP_EYE, Enum.Material.Neon), at * CFrame.new(side * s * 0.16, s * 1.33, -s * 0.5), name .. "Eye")
		rig:Egg(name .. "Horn", Vector3.new(s * 0.14, s * 0.42, s * 0.14), at * CFrame.new(side * s * 0.21, s * 1.64, -s * 0.14) * CFrame.Angles(0.25, 0, side * -0.45), IMP_HORN)
		rig:Egg(name .. "Horn", Vector3.new(s * 0.09, s * 0.28, s * 0.09), at * CFrame.new(side * s * 0.33, s * 1.86, -s * 0.06) * CFrame.Angles(-0.35, 0, side * -1.05), IMP_HORN)
		rig:Egg(name .. "Ear", Vector3.new(s * 0.08, s * 0.16, s * 0.34), at * CFrame.new(side * s * 0.4, s * 1.33, -s * 0.12) * CFrame.Angles(0, side * 0.9, side * 0.3), IMP_SKIN)
		rig:Egg(name .. "Leg", Vector3.new(s * 0.26, s * 0.5, s * 0.28), at * CFrame.new(side * s * 0.24, s * 0.22, 0), IMP_DARK)
		rig:Egg(name .. "Foot", Vector3.new(s * 0.22, s * 0.12, s * 0.36), at * CFrame.new(side * s * 0.26, s * 0.04, -s * 0.08), IMP_DARK)
		rig:Wedge(name .. (if side < 0 then "WingL" else "WingR"), Vector3.new(s * 0.05, s * 0.6, s * 0.62), impWing(at, s, side, 0), IMP_DARK)
		rig:Egg(name .. (if side < 0 then "ArmL" else "ArmR"), Vector3.new(s * 0.17, s * 0.58, s * 0.17), impArm(at, s, side, 0), IMP_SKIN)
	end
end

-- raiseL / raiseR: 0 = arm hanging, 1 = straight up over the head. flap: 0 = wings folded, 1 = spread.
function FX.PoseImp(rig: Rig, name: string, at: CFrame, size: number, raiseL: number, raiseR: number, flap: number?)
	rig:Pose(name .. "ArmL", impArm(at, size, -1, raiseL))
	rig:Pose(name .. "ArmR", impArm(at, size, 1, raiseR))
	local f = flap or 0
	rig:Pose(name .. "WingL", impWing(at, size, -1, f))
	rig:Pose(name .. "WingR", impWing(at, size, 1, f))
end

-- Oct 10 2026 (update 8): pre-built models and the head warning
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- A Rig out of a model that already exists. An event's look is made ONCE (a Model under the event's server script
-- in ServerScriptService > Events, which EventSystem copies to ReplicatedStorage > EventAssets > <event id>) and
-- CLONED when the event runs, instead of being built part by part every time (a clone is far cheaper than 50
-- Instance.new calls). Restyle those models in Studio as you like: keep the part NAMES, they are what the code moves.
--   container = the Model / Folder whose parts become the rig's parts, in order, under their own names
--   origin    = what the rig's offsets are measured from (the model's Root part, on the ground, front = -Z)
-- A part with the attribute Twist = true is a cylinder made to stand along Y (FX.CYL), so rig:Pose keeps working.
function FX.RigFrom(container: Instance?, origin: CFrame?): Rig
	local rig = FX.Rig(container)
	if not container then
		return rig
	end
	local base = origin or (if container:IsA("PVInstance") then container:GetPivot() else CFrame.new())
	local inverse = base:Inverse()
	for _, part in container:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "Root" then
			local offset = inverse * part.CFrame
			local twist: CFrame? = nil
			if part:GetAttribute("Twist") == true then
				twist = CYL
				offset = offset * CYL:Inverse()
			end
			rig:Add(part, offset, part.Name, twist)
		end
	end
	return rig
end

-- A copy of one of an event's models (ReplicatedStorage > EventAssets > <eventId> > <name>), for a visual that needs
-- MORE of something than the one model the framework gave it (every segment of a snake, every spider of a swarm).
-- Its parts are anchored and nothing bumps into them. nil (and one warning) when the model is not there.
function FX.Clone(eventId: string, name: string, parent: Instance?): Model?
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("EventAssets")
	local folder = assets and assets:FindFirstChild(eventId)
	local source = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not (source and source:IsA("Model")) then
		warnOnce("clone" .. eventId .. name, "the model '" .. name .. "' is missing under ServerScriptService > Events > (the " .. eventId .. " event): install the update again")
		return nil
	end
	local copy = source:Clone()
	for _, item in copy:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			item.Anchored = true
			item.CanCollide = false
			item.CanQuery = false
			item.CanTouch = false
		end
	end
	copy.Parent = parent
	return copy
end

-- A bendy tube (a tentacle, a tail, a vine) out of a model that already has the pieces: cylinders named Seg1, Seg2 ...
-- and balls named Joint1, Joint2 ... (the knuckle at the far end of each Seg). The model owns the looks; code only
-- says where the tube runs, every frame:
--   local tube = FX.Tube(model)                      -- tube.Count = how many pieces it found
--   tube:Place(i, from, to, thick [, hidden])        -- piece i runs from `from` to `to`, `thick` studs thick
-- hidden = true takes that piece out of sight (under water, not grown yet) until it is placed again.
local Tube = {}
Tube.__index = Tube
export type Tube = typeof(setmetatable({} :: { Segs: { BasePart }, Joints: { BasePart }, Shown: { number }, Hidden: { boolean }, Count: number }, Tube))
local QUARTER = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0) -- (a cylinder lies along its X axis: this turns X onto the way a CFrame looks)

function FX.Tube(model: Instance?): Tube
	local self = setmetatable({ Segs = {}, Joints = {}, Shown = {}, Hidden = {}, Count = 0 }, Tube)
	local index = 1
	while model do
		local seg, joint = model:FindFirstChild("Seg" .. index), model:FindFirstChild("Joint" .. index)
		if not (seg and joint and seg:IsA("BasePart") and joint:IsA("BasePart")) then
			break
		end
		self.Segs[index], self.Joints[index] = seg, joint
		self.Shown[index] = seg.Transparency
		self.Hidden[index] = false
		self.Count = index
		index += 1
	end
	return self
end

function Tube.Place(self: Tube, index: number, from: Vector3, to: Vector3, thick: number, hidden: boolean?)
	local seg, joint = self.Segs[index], self.Joints[index]
	if not seg then
		return
	end
	if hidden then
		if not self.Hidden[index] then
			self.Hidden[index] = true
			seg.Transparency, joint.Transparency = 1, 1
		end
		return
	end
	if self.Hidden[index] then
		self.Hidden[index] = false
		seg.Transparency, joint.Transparency = self.Shown[index], self.Shown[index]
	end
	local t = math.max(thick, MIN_SIZE)
	local length = (to - from).Magnitude
	if length > 0.05 then
		local size = Vector3.new(length + t * 0.2, t, t)
		if (seg.Size - size).Magnitude > 0.02 then
			seg.Size = size
		end
		seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((from + to) / 2, to) * QUARTER
	end
	if math.abs(joint.Size.X - t) > 0.02 then
		joint.Size = Vector3.new(t, t, t)
	end
	joint.CFrame = CFrame.new(to)
end

-- hides (true) or shows (false) the whole tube
function Tube.Hide(self: Tube, hidden: boolean)
	for index = 1, self.Count do
		if self.Hidden[index] ~= hidden then
			self.Hidden[index] = hidden
			local alpha = if hidden then 1 else self.Shown[index]
			self.Segs[index].Transparency, self.Joints[index].Transparency = alpha, alpha
		end
	end
end

-- THE warning over a player's head, for every event that warns one player: your own effect, ReplicatedStorage >
-- Assets > ExclamationWarning (an Attachment full of emitters). It is copied onto their Head, 3 studs up, and
-- emitted once with Utility.Emit (so it follows the "particles off" setting). who = a userId, a Player or a character.
function FX.HeadWarning(who: any, life: number?): Attachment?
	local character: Instance? = nil
	if type(who) == "number" then
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(who)
		character = player and player.Character
	elseif typeof(who) == "Instance" then
		character = if who:IsA("Player") then who.Character else who
	end
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return nil
	end
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
	local template = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("ExclamationWarning")
	if not (template and template:IsA("Attachment")) then
		warnOnce("headwarning", "ReplicatedStorage > Assets > ExclamationWarning (an Attachment) was not found, so there is no warning over anybody's head")
		return nil
	end
	local mark = template:Clone()
	mark.Name = "HeadWarning"
	mark.Position = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	mark.Parent = head
	util("Emit", mark)
	Debris:AddItem(mark, life or 2)
	return mark
end

-- Oct 11 2026 (update 12): pre-built GUIs
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- A copy of one of an event's GUIs on THIS player's screen. Like an event's models, the GUI is made once: a ScreenGui
-- kept under the event's server script (ServerScriptService > Events > <event>), which EventSystem copies to
-- ReplicatedStorage > EventAssets > <eventId>; here it is cloned into the PlayerGui instead of being built instance
-- by instance. Restyle those ScreenGuis in Studio as you like: keep the NAMES of the things in them.
-- There is never more than one copy of the same GUI on the screen. nil (and one warning) when it is not there.
-- Destroy it when you are done: self:Keep(gui) does that when the visual goes.
function FX.Gui(eventId: string, name: string): ScreenGui?
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("EventAssets")
	local folder = assets and assets:FindFirstChild(eventId)
	local source = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not (source and source:IsA("ScreenGui")) then
		warnOnce("gui" .. eventId .. name, "the ScreenGui '" .. name .. "' is missing under ServerScriptService > Events > (the " .. eventId .. " event): install the update again")
		return nil
	end
	local playerGui = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui then
		return nil
	end
	local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local copy = source:Clone()
	copy.Enabled = true
	copy.Parent = playerGui
	return copy
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Oct 12 2026 (update 23)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Keeps something where the server put it ON a plate (props.Tag = EventUtil.Tag(context, plate)): returns a
-- function that gives, every frame, the CFrame `start` has now: it stays on the plate's TOP (a plate that rises,
-- sinks or grows taller carries it) and keeps its place across the plate when the plate gets narrower or wider.
-- The second result: whether the plate is still there (before it has arrived on this client, or once it is gone:
-- the last place, and false).
function FX.OnPlate(tag: any, start: CFrame): () -> (CFrame, boolean)
	local plate: BasePart? = nil
	local offset: CFrame? = nil
	local size: Vector3? = nil
	local last = start
	return function(): (CFrame, boolean)
		if not plate then
			local found = FX.Tagged(tag)
			if found and found:IsA("BasePart") then
				plate = found
				size = found.Size
				offset = (found.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, found.Size.Y / 2, 0)):ToObjectSpace(start)
			end
		end
		if plate and offset and size and plate.Parent then
			local o = offset :: CFrame
			local s = size :: Vector3
			local stretch = CFrame.new(o.X * plate.Size.X / s.X - o.X, 0, o.Z * plate.Size.Z / s.Z - o.Z)
			last = plate.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, plate.Size.Y / 2, 0) * stretch * o
			return last, true
		end
		return last, false
	end
end

-- Holds an R6 rig in a pose by hand (every Motor6D named in `pose` gets that Transform): for when its animations
-- are not uploaded yet. Call it every frame (Roblox puts Transforms back while nothing is playing).
-- pose = { ["Right Shoulder"] = CFrame, ... } (animgen writes these tables).
function FX.HoldPose(model: Instance, pose: { [string]: CFrame })
	for _, item in model:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("Motor6D") then
			local transform = pose[item.Name]
			if transform then
				item.Transform = transform
			end
		end
	end
end

return FX
````

### 99.4 _Install (inside every update package)
<<<SOURCE _Install | ModuleScript | 563 lines | [v22] installer v3 (KEEP blocks + the base check: it refuses to overwrite scripts he edited since the export, 38.6), Oct 10 2026. Run for real in the test bench (55 checks); not run in Studio by me.
````lua
-- ModuleScript: _Install     (inside every DMP update package: DMP_<update> > _Install)     DMP installer v3
-- v3 (Oct 10 2026): YOUR OWN EDITS ARE SAFE. An update is built from an export of your game. If you have edited
-- one of the scripts it replaces SINCE that export, the update would wipe your edit out, so the installer checks
-- first: when it finds such a script it installs NOTHING and tells you which ones. Then either send a fresh
-- export and get the update rebuilt on your scripts, or install anyway by running it once more (click "Install
-- update" on the Plugins tab): your versions are kept in the backups. Values you filled in inside a
-- --[[DMP:KEEP]] block do not count as an edit (they are carried over, as before).
-- Installs the update it sits in. The package's folders mirror your game (ServerScriptService/Events/...,
-- ReplicatedStorage/EventClients/..., ServerStorage/Items/...), so everything goes where its folders say:
--   * A SCRIPT that already exists there keeps its place, its children (models, sounds, animations under it) and
--     its attributes: only its CODE is replaced. Your old code is copied first to
--     ServerStorage > DMP_Backups > <update name> (scripts there never run). If you had moved that script into a
--     subfolder of the same folder, that one is updated instead of adding a second copy.
--   * YOUR SETTINGS SURVIVE: in a block between the lines --[[DMP:KEEP name]] and --[[DMP:END]] (the SOUNDS /
--     ANIMATIONS tables, TUNE_ID ...), every id you filled in (Id = "...", Name = 123, local X = "...") is copied
--     into the new code. (A script you had from before these markers existed: the same table is found by its first
--     line, e.g. "local SOUNDS = {".)
--   * A script that doesn't exist yet is moved in.
--   * Folders are merged into yours. Anything else (parts, models, tools, values) is only ADDED when it is missing:
--     yours is kept (the package's copy can force a replace with the attribute DMPReplace = true; your old one then
--     goes to the backups).
--   * _Delete (a StringValue in the package, one path per line, e.g. ServerScriptService/Systems/EventKit2) lists
--     things to take out: they are MOVED to the backups, not destroyed.
--   * _Notes (a StringValue in the package) is printed at the end.
--   * _Base (a StringValue in the package) is how it knows what your scripts looked like in the export (and in
--     the updates sent since).
-- Everything it did is printed in Output, and Ctrl+Z undoes it.
-- Run it: the "DMP Installer" plugin runs it by itself when you drag the update into Studio. Without the plugin,
-- paste this into the Command Bar (View > Command Bar) and press Enter:
--     require(workspace.DMP_Oct8_Update3._Install).Install()
-- (use the update's folder name). Never while playing: Studio throws away changes made during Play.

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Installer = {}
Installer.Version = 3

local RESERVED = { _Install = true, _Notes = true, _Delete = true, _Base = true }

local function serviceFor(name: string): Instance?
	if name == "Workspace" then
		return workspace
	end
	local ok, found = pcall(function()
		return game:GetService(name :: any)
	end)
	if ok and found then
		return found
	end
	return game:FindFirstChild(name)
end

local function isScript(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Keeping his settings: the ids he filled in inside --[[DMP:KEEP name]] ... --[[DMP:END]] blocks
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function linesOf(source: string): { string }
	local list = {}
	for line in (source .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\r?\n") do
		table.insert(list, line)
	end
	return list
end

local function keyOf(line: string): string?
	return line:match("^%s*local%s+([%w_]+)%s*=[^=]") or line:match("^%s*([%w_]+)%s*=[^=]")
end

-- name -> { first, last } line numbers of the lines INSIDE each KEEP block
local function keepBlocks(lines: { string }): { [string]: { number } }
	local found: { [string]: { number } } = {}
	local name: string? = nil
	local first = 0
	for index, line in lines do
		local open = line:match("^%s*%-%-%[%[DMP:KEEP%s+([%w_]+)%]%]")
		if open then
			name, first = open, index + 1
		elseif line:match("^%s*%-%-%[%[DMP:END%]%]") and name then
			found[name] = { first, index - 1 }
			name = nil
		end
	end
	return found
end

-- the same table in an OLD source that has no markers: the line "local NAME = {" down to the closing "}"
local function findTable(oldLines: { string }, key: string): { number }?
	for index, line in oldLines do
		if keyOf(line) == key and line:match("{%s*$") then
			for last = index + 1, #oldLines do
				if oldLines[last]:match("^}%s*$") then
					return { index, last }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function escape(text: string): string
	return (text:gsub("%%", "%%%%"))
end

-- his value from oldLine put into newLine (nil = nothing of his to keep)
local function carry(newLine: string, oldLine: string): string?
	local quoted = oldLine:match('[^%w_]Id%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"') or oldLine:match('^%s*Id%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"')
	local bare = oldLine:match("[^%w_]Id%s*=%s*(%d+)")
	local id = if quoted and quoted ~= "" then quoted elseif bare and bare ~= "0" then bare else nil
	if id and newLine:match("Id%s*=") then
		local replaced, count = newLine:gsub('([^%w_]Id%s*=%s*)"[^"]*"', "%1\"" .. escape(id) .. "\"", 1)
		if count == 0 then
			replaced, count = newLine:gsub("([^%w_]Id%s*=%s*)%d+", "%1\"" .. escape(id) .. "\"", 1)
		end
		return if count > 0 then replaced else nil
	end
	local number = oldLine:match("^%s*[%w_]+%s*=%s*(%d[%d%.]*)")
	if number and tonumber(number) and tonumber(number) ~= 0 then
		local replaced, count = newLine:gsub("^(%s*[%w_]+%s*=%s*)%d[%d%.]*", "%1" .. escape(number), 1)
		return if count > 0 then replaced else nil
	end
	local text = oldLine:match('^%s*local%s+[%w_]+%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"')
	if text and text ~= "" then
		local replaced, count = newLine:gsub('^(%s*local%s+[%w_]+%s*=%s*)"[^"]*"', "%1\"" .. escape(text) .. "\"", 1)
		return if count > 0 then replaced else nil
	end
	return nil
end

-- new source with his settings carried over; and how many values were kept
local function keepSettings(oldSource: string, newSource: string): (string, number)
	local newLines = linesOf(newSource)
	local blocks = keepBlocks(newLines)
	if next(blocks) == nil then
		return newSource, 0
	end
	local oldLines = linesOf(oldSource)
	local oldBlocks = keepBlocks(oldLines)
	local kept = 0
	for name, range in blocks do
		local mine: { [string]: string } = {}
		local oldRange = oldBlocks[name]
		if not oldRange then
			-- an old copy from before the markers: a table block is found by its first line ("local SOUNDS = {"),
			-- single settings ("local TUNE_ID = ...") by their names, at the top level of the old script
			for index = range[1], range[2] do
				local key = keyOf(newLines[index])
				if key then
					if newLines[index]:match("{%s*$") then
						oldRange = findTable(oldLines, key)
					else
						for _, line in oldLines do
							local top = line:match("^local%s+([%w_]+)%s*=[^=]")
							if top then
								mine[top] = line
							end
						end
					end
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if oldRange then
			for index = oldRange[1], oldRange[2] do
				local key = keyOf(oldLines[index])
				if key then
					mine[key] = oldLines[index]
				end
			end
		end
		if next(mine) ~= nil then
			for index = range[1], range[2] do
				local key = keyOf(newLines[index])
				local old = key and mine[key]
				if old then
					local merged = carry(newLines[index], old)
					if merged and merged ~= newLines[index] then
						newLines[index] = merged
						kept += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local text = table.concat(newLines, "\n")
	if string.sub(newSource, -1) ~= "\n" and string.sub(text, -1) == "\n" then
		text = string.sub(text, 1, -2)
	end
	return text, kept
end
Installer.KeepSettings = keepSettings

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Has he edited a script since the export this update was built from?
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- A short fingerprint of a script's code. What is INSIDE a KEEP block does not count (his ids live there), nor do
-- spaces at the end of a line or empty lines at the end of the script. KEEP IN SYNC with fingerprint() in the
-- packing tool (pack_update.py): both must give the same answer for the same code.
local function fingerprint(source: string): string
	local lines = linesOf(source)
	local keeping = false
	local out: { string } = {}
	for _, line in lines do
		local text = (line:gsub("[ \t\r]+$", ""))
		if text:match("^%s*%-%-%[%[DMP:END%]%]") then
			keeping = false
		end
		if not keeping then
			table.insert(out, text)
		end
		if text:match("^%s*%-%-%[%[DMP:KEEP%s+[%w_]+%]%]") then
			keeping = true
		end
	end
	while #out > 0 and out[#out] == "" do
		table.remove(out)
	end
	local joined = table.concat(out, "\n")
	local a, b = 1, 0
	for index = 1, #joined do
		a = (a + string.byte(joined, index)) % 65521
		b = (b + a) % 65521
	end
	return string.format("%d:%d:%d", #joined, a, b)
end
Installer.Fingerprint = fingerprint

local function setSource(target: Instance, source: string): (boolean, string?)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local editor = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
		editor:UpdateSourceAsync(target :: any, function()
			return source
		end)
	end)
	if ok and (target :: any).Source == source then
		return true, nil
	end
	local ok2, err2 = pcall(function()
		(target :: any).Source = source
	end)
	if ok2 then
		return true, nil
	end
	return false, tostring(err2 or err)
end

-- force = true installs even when you have edited scripts it replaces (running it a second time does the same)
function Installer.Install(package: Instance?, force: boolean?): { [string]: { string } }?
	local pkg = package or script.Parent
	if not pkg or pkg == game then
		warn("[DMP] _Install has to sit inside an update folder")
		return nil
	end
	if RunService:IsRunning() then
		warn("[DMP] Stop Play first: Studio throws away changes made while playing.")
		return nil
	end
	if pkg:GetAttribute("DMPInstalling") then
		warn("[DMP] " .. pkg.Name .. " is already being installed")
		return nil
	end
	pkg:SetAttribute("DMPInstalling", true)

	local report = { Updated = {}, Added = {}, Kept = {}, Same = {}, Removed = {}, Failed = {}, Settings = {}, Edited = {} }
	local backupRoot: Folder? = nil
	local function backups(): Folder
		if backupRoot and backupRoot.Parent then
			return backupRoot
		end
		local all = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("DMP_Backups")
		if not all then
			all = Instance.new("Folder")
			all.Name = "DMP_Backups"
			all.Parent = ServerStorage
		end
		local mine = all:FindFirstChild(pkg.Name)
		if not mine then
			mine = Instance.new("Folder")
			mine.Name = pkg.Name
			mine.Parent = all
		end
		backupRoot = mine :: Folder
		return mine :: Folder
	end
	-- a copy of the old script (without its children) in the backups, named by where it lived
	local function backupSource(target: Instance)
		local ok, copy = pcall(function()
			return target:Clone()
		end)
		if ok and copy then
			copy:ClearAllChildren()
			copy.Name = target:GetFullName()
			copy.Parent = backups()
		end
	end
	-- moves something out of the game into the backups (it stops running there)
	local function retire(target: Instance)
		target.Name = target:GetFullName()
		target.Parent = backups()
	end

	local function findScriptBelow(container: Instance, name: string, className: string): Instance?
		for _, item in container:GetDescendants() do
			if item.Name == name and item.ClassName == className then
				return item
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local merge: (item: Instance, destination: Instance) -> ()
	merge = function(item: Instance, destination: Instance)
		local existing = destination:FindFirstChild(item.Name)
		if isScript(item) then
			local target = if existing and isScript(existing) then existing else nil
			if not target and not existing then
				target = findScriptBelow(destination, item.Name, item.ClassName)
			end
			if target and target.ClassName ~= item.ClassName then
				-- same name, different kind of script: the package's one takes its place, its children come along
				for _, child in target:GetChildren() do
					child.Parent = item
				end
				local where = target.Parent
				retire(target)
				item.Parent = where
				table.insert(report.Updated, item:GetFullName() .. "  (was a " .. target.ClassName .. ")")
				return
			end
			if target then
				local new, kept = keepSettings((target :: any).Source, (item :: any).Source)
				if kept > 0 then
					table.insert(report.Settings, target:GetFullName() .. "  (" .. kept .. " of your values)")
				end
				if (target :: any).Source ~= new then
					backupSource(target)
					local ok, err = setSource(target, new)
					if ok then
						table.insert(report.Updated, target:GetFullName())
					else
						table.insert(report.Failed, target:GetFullName() .. ": " .. tostring(err))
					end
				else
					table.insert(report.Same, target:GetFullName())
				end
				for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
					merge(child, target)
				end
				return
			end
			item.Parent = destination
			table.insert(report.Added, item:GetFullName())
			return
		end
		if existing then
			if item:GetAttribute("DMPReplace") and not item:IsA("Folder") then
				local where = existing.Parent
				retire(existing)
				item.Parent = where
				table.insert(report.Updated, item:GetFullName() .. "  (replaced; yours is in the backups)")
				return
			end
			local children = item:GetChildren()
			if #children == 0 then
				if not item:IsA("Folder") then
					table.insert(report.Kept, existing:GetFullName())
				end
				return
			end
			for _, child in children do
				merge(child, existing)
			end
			return
		end
		item.Parent = destination
		local scripts = 0
		for _, child in item:GetDescendants() do
			if isScript(child) then
				scripts += 1
			end
		end
		table.insert(report.Added, item:GetFullName() .. (if scripts > 0 and not isScript(item) then "  (" .. scripts .. " script" .. (if scripts == 1 then "" else "s") .. " inside)" else ""))
	end

	-- BEFORE anything is changed: has he edited a script this update replaces since the export it was built from?
	-- _Base: "# export: <when it was made>" and one line per script: path <tab> fingerprint[,fingerprint ...]
	-- (the export's copy first, then every version an earlier update shipped: all of those are "not his edit")
	local bases: { [string]: { [string]: boolean } } = {}
	local builtFrom = "your last export"
	local baseValue = pkg:FindFirstChild("_Base")
	if baseValue and baseValue:IsA("StringValue") then
		for line in string.gmatch(baseValue.Value, "[^\r\n]+") do
			local from = line:match("^#%s*export:%s*(.+)$")
			local path, prints = line:match("^([^\t]+)\t([%d:,]+)$")
			if from then
				builtFrom = "the export made " .. from
			elseif path and prints then
				local known: { [string]: boolean } = {}
				for print_ in string.gmatch(prints, "[^,]+") do
					known[print_] = true
				end
				bases[path] = known
			end
		end
	end
	local scan: (item: Instance, destination: Instance, path: string) -> ()
	scan = function(item: Instance, destination: Instance, path: string)
		local existing = destination:FindFirstChild(item.Name)
		if isScript(item) then
			local target = if existing and isScript(existing) then existing else nil
			if not target and not existing then
				target = findScriptBelow(destination, item.Name, item.ClassName)
			end
			if target and target.ClassName == item.ClassName then
				local known = bases[path]
				if known then
					local current = fingerprint((target :: any).Source)
					if not known[current] and current ~= fingerprint((item :: any).Source) then
						table.insert(report.Edited, target:GetFullName())
					end
				end
				for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
					scan(child, target, path .. "/" .. child.Name)
				end
			end
		elseif existing then
			for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
				scan(child, existing, path .. "/" .. child.Name)
			end
		end
	end
	if next(bases) ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			for _, top in pkg:GetChildren() do
				if not RESERVED[top.Name] then
					local service = serviceFor(top.Name)
					if service then
						for _, item in top:GetChildren() do
							scan(item, service, top.Name .. "/" .. item.Name)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if #report.Edited > 0 and not force and not pkg:GetAttribute("DMPEditedShown") then
		warn("[DMP] " .. pkg.Name .. " was NOT installed. Nothing was changed.")
		warn("[DMP] You have edited " .. (if #report.Edited == 1 then "this script" else "these scripts") .. " since " .. builtFrom .. ", which is what this update was built from:")
		for _, name in report.Edited do
			warn("[DMP]     " .. name)
		end
		warn("[DMP] Installing would replace " .. (if #report.Edited == 1 then "it with a version" else "them with versions") .. " that do not have your edits.")
		warn("[DMP]   BEST: send a fresh export (drag DMP_ExportTool into Studio) so the update can be rebuilt on your scripts.")
		warn("[DMP]   OR install it anyway: click \"Install update\" on the Plugins tab (DMP Updates). Your versions are then kept in ServerStorage > DMP_Backups > " .. pkg.Name .. ".")
		pkg:SetAttribute("DMPEditedShown", true)
		pkg:SetAttribute("DMPInstalling", nil)
		return report
	end
	if #report.Edited > 0 then
		for _, name in report.Edited do
			print("[DMP] YOUR EDITED VERSION IS IN THE BACKUPS  " .. name)
		end
	end

	local recording: string? = nil
	pcall(function()
		recording = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("Install " .. pkg.Name, "Install " .. pkg.Name)
	end)
	if not recording then
		pcall(function()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Before " .. pkg.Name)
		end)
	end

	print("[DMP] Installing " .. pkg.Name .. " (installer v" .. Installer.Version .. ")...")
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local deletions = pkg:FindFirstChild("_Delete")
		if deletions and deletions:IsA("StringValue") then
			for line in string.gmatch(deletions.Value, "[^\r\n]+") do
				local trimmed = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
				if trimmed ~= "" then
					local parts = string.split(trimmed, "/")
					local current: Instance? = serviceFor(parts[1])
					for index = 2, #parts do
						current = current and current:FindFirstChild(parts[index])
					end
					if current and current ~= game and #parts >= 2 then
						local name = current:GetFullName()
						retire(current)
						table.insert(report.Removed, name)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, top in pkg:GetChildren() do
			if not RESERVED[top.Name] then
				local service = serviceFor(top.Name)
				if service then
					for _, item in top:GetChildren() do
						merge(item, service)
					end
				else
					table.insert(report.Failed, top.Name .. ": there is no service called that")
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	if recording then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(recording, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit)
	else
		pcall(function()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Installed " .. pkg.Name)
		end)
	end

	for _, line in report.Removed do
		print("[DMP] REMOVED  " .. line .. "  (moved to the backups)")
	end
	for _, line in report.Updated do
		print("[DMP] UPDATED  " .. line)
	end
	for _, line in report.Added do
		print("[DMP] ADDED    " .. line)
	end
	for _, line in report.Kept do
		print("[DMP] KEPT YOURS  " .. line)
	end
	for _, line in report.Settings do
		print("[DMP] KEPT YOUR SETTINGS  " .. line)
	end
	for _, line in report.Failed do
		warn("[DMP] FAILED   " .. line)
	end
	if not ok then
		warn("[DMP] The install stopped with an error: " .. tostring(err) .. "  (press Ctrl+Z to undo what it did)")
	end
	print(string.format("[DMP] Done: %d updated, %d added, %d unchanged, %d kept yours, %d removed, %d failed.%s",
		#report.Updated, #report.Added, #report.Same, #report.Kept, #report.Removed, #report.Failed,
		if backupRoot then " Your old code: ServerStorage > DMP_Backups > " .. pkg.Name .. "." else ""))
	local notes = pkg:FindFirstChild("_Notes")
	if notes and notes:IsA("StringValue") and notes.Value ~= "" then
		for line in string.gmatch(notes.Value, "[^\r\n]+") do
			print("[DMP] NOTE: " .. line)
		end
	end
	print("[DMP] Stop and start Play to load the new code.")

	if ok then
		pkg:Destroy()
	else
		pkg:SetAttribute("DMPInstalling", nil)
	end
	return report
end

return Installer
````

### 99.5 DMP_Installer (Studio plugin)
<<<SOURCE DMP_Installer | Script (plugin) | 109 lines | [v16] Oct 8 2026 (section 32). Not run in Studio by me.
````lua
-- DMP Installer: a Roblox Studio PLUGIN (set it up once, it works in every place you open).
-- SET UP (once): Studio > Plugins tab > Plugins Folder. Put this file (DMP_Installer.lua) in the folder that opens,
-- then close and reopen Studio. You get a "DMP Updates" toolbar on the Plugins tab with two buttons.
-- EVERY UPDATE: drag the update's .rbxmx (e.g. DMP_Oct8_Update3.rbxmx) into Studio. That's it: with "Auto install"
-- on (it is, at first) the update installs itself the moment it lands. With it off, click "Install update".
-- The first time it changes a script, Studio may ask whether this plugin may modify scripts: click Allow.
-- What the install does (and the backups it keeps) is written at the top of the update's own _Install module.
-- Everything it did is printed in Output; Ctrl+Z undoes it.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SETTING = "DMPAutoInstall"

local toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar("DMP Updates")
local installButton = toolbar:CreateButton("DMPInstall", "Install the DMP update you dragged into Studio", "", "Install update")
local autoButton = toolbar:CreateButton("DMPAuto", "Install DMP updates the moment you drag them in", "", "Auto install")
installButton.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true
autoButton.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true

local auto = plugin:GetSetting(SETTING)
if auto == nil then
	auto = true
end
autoButton:SetActive(auto == true)

local function isPackage(item: Instance): boolean
	if not item:IsA("Folder") or string.sub(item.Name, 1, 4) ~= "DMP_" then
		return false
	end
	local module = item:FindFirstChild("_Install")
	return module ~= nil and module:IsA("ModuleScript")
end

local WATCHED = { workspace, ServerStorage, ReplicatedStorage, ServerScriptService }

local function findPackages(): { Instance }
	local list = {}
	for _, container in WATCHED do
		for _, child in container:GetChildren() do
			if isPackage(child) then
				table.insert(list, child)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, selected in game:GetService("Selection"):Get() do
		if isPackage(selected) and not table.find(list, selected) then
			table.insert(list, selected)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local busy = false
local function install(package: Instance)
	if RunService:IsRunning() then
		warn("[DMP] Stop Play first, then click Install update.")
		return
	end
	if busy or package:GetAttribute("DMPInstalling") then
		return
	end
	busy = true
	local module = package:FindFirstChild("_Install")
	local ok, installer = pcall(require, module :: ModuleScript)
	if not ok or type(installer) ~= "table" or type(installer.Install) ~= "function" then
		warn("[DMP] " .. package.Name .. " has no working _Install: " .. tostring(installer))
	else
		local done, err = pcall(installer.Install, package)
		if not done then
			warn("[DMP] Installing " .. package.Name .. " failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	busy = false
end

installButton.Click:Connect(function()
	installButton:SetActive(false)
	local packages = findPackages()
	if #packages == 0 then
		warn("[DMP] No update found. Drag the update's .rbxmx into Studio first (or select its DMP_ folder).")
		return
	end
	for _, package in packages do
		install(package)
	end
end)

autoButton.Click:Connect(function()
	auto = not auto
	plugin:SetSetting(SETTING, auto)
	autoButton:SetActive(auto)
	print("[DMP] Auto install is " .. (if auto then "ON: updates install when you drag them in." else "OFF: click Install update."))
end)

for _, container in WATCHED do
	container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
		if not auto or RunService:IsRunning() then
			return
		end
		task.delay(0.5, function() -- (let the whole folder arrive first)
			if child.Parent and isPackage(child) then
				install(child)
			end
		end)
	end)
end
````
