````lua
-- ModuleScript: ServerScriptService > Systems > Contracts     (NEW)
-- THE DEVIL'S CONTRACTS: a power NOW, a cost LATER. Events > BrokersTable offers them; any later contract event
-- (The Collector, The Crossroads ...) should use this module too, so a player only ever has ONE contract a round.
--
--   Contracts.Offers                    the deals (Id, Title, Power, FinePrint, Grant(player, state), Collect(player, state))
--   Contracts.Get(id) -> offer
--   Contracts.Pick(count, except?) -> { offer }   that many different deals, at random (none of the ids in `except`)
--   Contracts.Sign(player, id) -> ok, why   gives the power now; the cost comes due later (DEBT_TIME seconds, or
--                                          whatever the deal's own DueWhen says)
--   Contracts.Has(player) -> id?         the contract this player signed this round (nil = none)
--   Contracts.Signed(player) -> boolean  did they sign one at any point this round (for Your Reading: The Devil)
--
-- When a debt comes due the Broker "collects": the cost is applied and the player is told, plainly, what it was.
-- Everything a contract does belongs to the player's CURRENT character: dying or the round ending wipes it.
-- The Devil (tarot, reversed): that player's debts come due twice as fast (attributes TarotCard / TarotUpright).
-- Rules kept: nothing here ever takes candles, shifts Soul or puts an outline on anybody.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Systems = script.Parent
local EventUtil = require(Systems:WaitForChild("EventUtil"))

local Contracts = {}

local DEBT_TIME = 40          -- seconds between signing and the cost coming due
local MIN_DEBT = 10           -- a debt that waits for something (Borrowed Heart) never lands sooner than this
local INK = Color3.fromRGB(200, 70, 60)

type Offer = {
	Id: string, Title: string, Power: string, FinePrint: string, Quiet: boolean?,
	Grant: (player: Player, state: any) -> (), Collect: (player: Player, state: any) -> (),
	DueWhen: ((player: Player, state: any) -> boolean)?,
}
type State = {
	Offer: Offer, Character: Model?, SignedAt: number, Due: number, Collected: boolean, AliveAtSigning: number,
	Ids: { string }, Trail: { Vector3 }, Cleanup: { () -> () }, Inner: Offer?, Debtor: Player?, Tool: Tool?,
}

local signed: { [Player]: State } = {}
local signedThisRound: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

local function tell(player: Player, title: string, text: string)
	EventUtil.Notify(player, title, text, INK)
end

local function mod(player: Player, state: State, stat: string, values: { [string]: number }, id: string)
	EventUtil.Mod(player, stat, values, id)
	table.insert(state.Ids, id)
end

-- the cost, said plainly ("In 40 seconds you lose ..." -> "You lose ...")
local function plain(finePrint: string): string
	local text = finePrint:gsub("^In %d+ seconds,? ", ""):gsub("^When [^:]-: ", "")
	text = text:gsub("^%l", string.upper)
	return text
end

-- Systems > EventChoice (the pick-a-player window), loaded when it is first needed
local choiceModule: any = nil
local function choice(): any
	if choiceModule == nil then
		choiceModule = false
		local module = Systems:FindFirstChild("EventChoice")
		if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
			if ok then
				choiceModule = result
			end
		end
	end
	return choiceModule or nil
end

-- asks `player` to pick one of `candidates` (EventChoice), nil = no answer
local function askPlayer(player: Player, candidates: { Player }, title: string, subtitle: string, seconds: number): Player?
	local Choice = choice()
	if not Choice or #candidates == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local ids = {}
	for _, other in candidates do
		table.insert(ids, other.UserId)
	end
	local ok, picked = pcall(Choice.Ask, player, "Player", { Title = title, Subtitle = subtitle, UserIds = ids }, seconds)
	if ok and type(picked) == "number" then
		local other = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(picked)
		if other and table.find(candidates, other) then
			return other
		end
	end
	return nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------- Shadow Step (the tool) and the shadow (its debt)
local DASH_EVERY = 2          -- seconds between dashes
local SHADOW_LAG, SHADOW_TIME, SHADOW_DAMAGE = 5, 20, 5

local function buildShadowTool(): Tool
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = "Shadow Step"
	tool.ToolTip = "Click to dash forward through the dark"
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
	handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(16, 14, 18)
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	handle.CanCollide = false
	handle.Massless = true
	handle.Parent = tool
	local smoke = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	smoke.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
	smoke.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(20, 18, 22))
	smoke.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.6, 1.4)
	smoke.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.4, 1)
	smoke.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8)
	smoke.Rate = 12
	smoke.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5)
	smoke.Parent = handle
	return tool
end

local function puff(position: Vector3)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
	local smoke = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	smoke.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
	smoke.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(14, 12, 16))
	smoke.Size = NumberSequence.new(2, 4)
	smoke.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
	smoke.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9)
	smoke.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6)
	smoke.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	smoke.Rate = 0
	smoke.Parent = part
	part.Parent = workspace
	smoke:Emit(26)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1.5)
end

-- a dark copy of the player that walks their path from SHADOW_LAG seconds ago, and hurts to touch
local function releaseShadow(player: Player, state: State)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = player.Name .. "'s Shadow"
	local function piece(name: string, size: Vector3, offset: Vector3): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 12)
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Transparency = 0.25
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p:SetAttribute("Offset", offset)
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end
	local torso = piece("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	piece("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0))
	piece("Left Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Vector3.new(-1.5, 0, 0))
	piece("Right Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Vector3.new(1.5, 0, 0))
	piece("Left Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Vector3.new(-0.5, -2, 0))
	piece("Right Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Vector3.new(0.5, -2, 0))
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		local eye = piece("Eye", Vector3.new(0.25, 0.18, 0.1), Vector3.new(side * 0.28, 1.7, -0.62))
		eye.Color = INK
		eye.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		eye.Transparency = 0
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = torso
	model.Parent = workspace
	tell(player, "The Broker collects: Shadow Step", "Your shadow has come loose. It walks where you walked " .. SHADOW_LAG .. " seconds ago. Don't let it catch you.")
	local character = state.Character
	local started = os.clock()
	local lastHurt = 0
	task.spawn(function()
		local info = TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
		while os.clock() - started < SHADOW_TIME and player.Parent and player.Character == character and EventUtil.IsAlive(player) do
			local trail = state.Trail
			local index = math.max(#trail - SHADOW_LAG * 10, 1)
			local at = trail[index]
			if at then
				local ahead = trail[math.min(index + 2, #trail)] or at
				local flat = Vector3.new(ahead.X - at.X, 0, ahead.Z - at.Z)
				local frame = if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then CFrame.lookAt(at, at + flat) else CFrame.new(at)
				for _, part in model:GetChildren() do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						local offset = part:GetAttribute("Offset") :: Vector3
						TweenService:Create(part, info, { CFrame = frame * CFrame.new(offset) }):Play()
					end
				end
				local root = EventUtil.Root(player)
				if root and (root.Position - at).Magnitude <= 2.8 and os.clock() - lastHurt >= 0.5 then
					lastHurt = os.clock()
					EventUtil.Hurt(player, SHADOW_DAMAGE, "Shadow")
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		for _, part in model:GetChildren() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(0.6), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			end
		end
		Debris:AddItem(model, 0.7)
	end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------- the deals
-- Power is what you read plainly. FinePrint is the cost: on the scroll it is smudged (you have to guess it from
-- the few letters you can make out); at the end of the Broker's visit and when it comes due, you are told it plainly.
-- (Not built, see the ideation doc: Gilded Hands and Open Eyes need item / tell systems that don't exist yet;
-- Soul Sale shifts Soul, which needs the dev's OK first.)
Contracts.Offers = {
	{
		Id = "QuickFeet", Title = "Quick Feet", Power = "Run 30% faster.",
		FinePrint = "In 40 seconds you lose 25 max health for the rest of the round.",
		Grant = function(player, state)
			mod(player, state, "WalkSpeed", { Mult = 1.3 }, "ContractQuickFeet")
		end,
		Collect = function(player, state)
			mod(player, state, "MaxHealth", { Add = -25 }, "ContractQuickFeetDebt")
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "IronHide", Title = "Iron Hide", Power = "Take half damage from everything.",
		FinePrint = "In 40 seconds your legs turn to iron: you jump 40% lower for the rest of the round.",
		Grant = function(player, state)
			mod(player, state, "DamageTaken", { Mult = 0.5 }, "ContractIronHide")
		end,
		Collect = function(player, state)
			mod(player, state, "Jump", { Mult = 0.6 }, "ContractIronHideDebt")
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "BorrowedHeart", Title = "Borrowed Heart", Power = "+40 max health, right now.",
		FinePrint = "When only two of you are left standing (or in 90 seconds): the heart is taken back, and you lose 60 health at once.",
		-- (the dev's version: "20 seconds before the round ends". A round ends when one is left, so: the final two)
		DueWhen = function(_player, state)
			local alive = #EventUtil.Alive()
			return (alive <= 2 and alive < state.AliveAtSigning) or os.clock() - state.SignedAt >= 90
		end,
		Grant = function(player, state)
			mod(player, state, "MaxHealth", { Add = 40 }, "ContractBorrowedHeart")
		end,
		Collect = function(player, _state)
			EventUtil.Hurt(player, 60, "The Broker")
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "SecondWind", Title = "Second Wind", Power = "The first time you would be knocked out, you get back up with 30 health.",
		-- (the old cost, the candles you earned, broke the no-candle-loss rule: this is the replacement)
		FinePrint = "In 40 seconds you lose 30 max health for the rest of the round.",
		Grant = function(player, state)
			local Damage = EventUtil.Sys("Damage")
			local _, humanoid = EventUtil.Root(player)
			if not (Damage and humanoid) then
				return
			end
			Damage.AddHandler(player, "ContractSecondWind", 100, function(hit: any)
				if hit.Amount >= humanoid.Health and not hit.InstantKill then
					hit.Cancelled = true
					Damage.RemoveHandler(player, "ContractSecondWind")
					task.defer(function()
						if humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 then
							humanoid.Health = math.min(30, humanoid.MaxHealth)
						end
					end)
					player:SetAttribute("RevivedThisRound", true) -- (Your Reading: Judgement)
					tell(player, "Second Wind", "You should be out. The contract says otherwise.")
				end
			end)
			table.insert(state.Cleanup, function()
				pcall(Damage.RemoveHandler, player, "ContractSecondWind")
			end)
		end,
		Collect = function(player, state)
			mod(player, state, "MaxHealth", { Add = -30 }, "ContractSecondWindDebt")
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "PoisonedGift", Title = "Poisoned Gift", Power = "A random item and 30 candles, right now.",
		FinePrint = "In 40 seconds the events start coming for YOU first, for the rest of the round.",
		Grant = function(player, _state)
			EventUtil.GiveItem(player)
			EventUtil.Candles(player, 30)
		end,
		Collect = function(player, state)
			local before = player:GetAttribute("EventTargetWeight")
			player:SetAttribute("EventTargetWeight", 5)
			table.insert(state.Cleanup, function()
				if player:GetAttribute("EventTargetWeight") == 5 then
					player:SetAttribute("EventTargetWeight", before)
				end
			end)
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "ShadowStep", Title = "Shadow Step", Power = "A Shadow Step: click to dash forward through the dark, as often as every " .. DASH_EVERY .. " seconds.",
		FinePrint = "In 40 seconds the dash is gone and your shadow comes loose. It follows your steps, and it hurts to touch.",
		Quiet = true, -- (releaseShadow says it)
		Grant = function(player, state)
			local tool = buildShadowTool()
			local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			tool.Parent = backpack or player.Character
			local last = 0
			tool.Activated:Connect(function()
				local root, humanoid = EventUtil.Root(player)
				if not (root and humanoid) or state.Collected or os.clock() - last < DASH_EVERY or tool.Parent ~= player.Character then
					return
				end
				last = os.clock()
				puff(root.Position)
				local look = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
				if look.Magnitude < 0.05 then
					look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
				end
				EventUtil.Push(player, look.Unit * 80 + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), 0.18)
			end)
			state.Tool = tool
			table.insert(state.Cleanup, function()
				if tool.Parent then
					tool:Destroy()
				end
			end)
		end,
		Collect = function(player, state)
			local tool: Tool? = state.Tool
			if tool and tool.Parent then
				local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				local root = EventUtil.Root(player)
				local at = if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then handle.Position elseif root then root.Position else nil
				if at then
					puff(at)
				end
				tool:Destroy()
			end
			releaseShadow(player, state)
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "Cosign", Title = "Cosign", Power = "A free power (fast feet or an iron hide). You name somebody else to pay for it.",
		FinePrint = "In 40 seconds the debt lands on the one you named. They can pass it on, and if it comes back round to you, YOU pay.",
		Quiet = true, -- (it tells everybody involved itself)
		Grant = function(player, state)
			local inner = Contracts.Get(if math.random() < 0.5 then "QuickFeet" else "IronHide") :: Offer
			state.Inner = inner
			inner.Grant(player, state)
			tell(player, "Cosign: " .. inner.Title, inner.Power)
			task.spawn(function()
				local others: { Player } = {}
				for _, other in EventUtil.Alive() do
					if other ~= player then
						table.insert(others, other)
					end
				end
				local debtor = askPlayer(player, others, "Who cosigns?", "Pick who pays your debt to the Broker.", 8)
				if not debtor and #others > 0 then
					debtor = others[math.random(1, #others)]
				end
				if signed[player] ~= state then
					return
				end
				state.Debtor = debtor or player
				if debtor and debtor ~= player then
					tell(player, "Cosigned", debtor.DisplayName .. " will pay your debt.")
					tell(debtor, "You cosigned a contract!", player.DisplayName .. " signed with the Broker and put YOUR name on it. When the debt comes due it lands on you, unless you pass it on.")
				end
			end)
		end,
		Collect = function(player, state)
			local inner: Offer? = state.Inner
			if not inner then
				return
			end
			local holder: Player = state.Debtor or player
			local held: { [Player]: boolean } = { [holder] = true }
			-- the debt can be passed on (at most 3 times); a debtor who is out sends it back to the signer
			for _ = 1, 3 do
				if holder == player then
					break
				end
				if not EventUtil.IsAlive(holder) then
					holder = player
					break
				end
				local candidates: { Player } = {}
				for _, other in EventUtil.Alive() do
					if other ~= holder and (not held[other] or other == player) then
						table.insert(candidates, other)
					end
				end
				local passTo = askPlayer(holder, candidates, "Pass the debt on?", player.DisplayName .. "'s debt has come due. Pick someone to pass it to, or pay it yourself.", 6)
				if not passTo then
					break
				end
				tell(holder, "Passed on", "You passed the debt to " .. passTo.DisplayName .. ".")
				if passTo ~= player then
					tell(passTo, "The debt is yours now!", holder.DisplayName .. " passed " .. player.DisplayName .. "'s debt to you.")
				end
				held[passTo] = true
				holder = passTo
			end
			if not EventUtil.IsAlive(holder) then
				return
			end
			local holderState: any = if holder == player then state else { Ids = {}, Cleanup = {}, Trail = {}, Character = holder.Character }
			inner.Collect(holder, holderState)
			local cost = plain(inner.FinePrint)
			if holder == player then
				tell(player, "The Broker collects: " .. inner.Title, "It came back round to you. " .. cost)
			else
				tell(holder, "The Broker collects: " .. inner.Title, "You paid " .. player.DisplayName .. "'s debt. " .. cost)
				tell(player, "Debt paid", holder.DisplayName .. " paid your debt.")
			end
		end,
	},
} :: { Offer }

local byId: { [string]: Offer } = {}
for _, offer in Contracts.Offers do
	byId[offer.Id] = offer
end

function Contracts.Get(id: string): Offer?
	return byId[id]
end

function Contracts.Pick(count: number, except: { string }?): { Offer }
	local pool: { Offer } = {}
	for _, offer in Contracts.Offers do
		if not (except and table.find(except, offer.Id)) then
			table.insert(pool, offer)
		end
	end
	EventUtil.Shuffle(pool)
	local list = {}
	for index = 1, math.min(count, #pool) do
		list[index] = pool[index]
	end
	return list
end

function Contracts.Has(player: Player): string?
	local state = signed[player]
	if state and state.Character == player.Character then
		return state.Offer.Id
	end
	return nil
end

function Contracts.Signed(player: Player): boolean
	return signedThisRound[player] == true
end

-- (Systems > Tarot calls this when a round starts)
function Contracts.NewRound()
	table.clear(signedThisRound)
end

function Contracts.Plain(id: string): string
	local offer = byId[id]
	return if offer then plain(offer.FinePrint) else ""
end

local function clear(player: Player)
	local state = signed[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	signed[player] = nil
	for _, fn in state.Cleanup do
		pcall(fn)
	end
	if player.Parent and player.Character == state.Character then
		for _, id in state.Ids do
			EventUtil.Unmod(player, id)
		end
	end
end

-- how long until this player's debt comes due (The Devil reversed: twice as fast)
local function debtTime(player: Player): number
	if player:GetAttribute("TarotCard") == "devil" and player:GetAttribute("TarotUpright") == false then
		return DEBT_TIME / 2
	end
	return DEBT_TIME
end

function Contracts.Sign(player: Player, id: string): (boolean, string?)
	local offer = byId[id]
	if not offer then
		return false, "There is no such contract."
	end
	if not EventUtil.IsAlive(player) then
		return false, "Only the living can sign."
	end
	if Contracts.Has(player) then
		return false, "You have already signed a contract this round."
	end
	clear(player) -- (an old one from a character that is gone)
	local now = os.clock()
	local state: State = {
		Offer = offer, Character = player.Character, SignedAt = now, Due = now + debtTime(player), Collected = false,
		AliveAtSigning = #EventUtil.Alive(), Ids = {}, Trail = {}, Cleanup = {},
	}
	signed[player] = state
	signedThisRound[player] = true
	local ok, err = pcall(offer.Grant, player, state)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Contracts] " .. offer.Id .. " could not be granted: " .. tostring(err))
	end
	local function due(): boolean
		local dueWhen = offer.DueWhen
		if dueWhen then
			if os.clock() - state.SignedAt < MIN_DEBT then
				return false
			end
			local checked, result = pcall(dueWhen, player, state)
			return checked and result == true
		end
		return os.clock() >= state.Due
	end
	-- the debt
	task.spawn(function()
		while not due() do
			if signed[player] ~= state or not player.Parent or player.Character ~= state.Character then
				return
			end
			-- (Shadow Step remembers your path for the shadow)
			if offer.Id == "ShadowStep" then
				local root = EventUtil.Root(player)
				if root then
					table.insert(state.Trail, root.Position)
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		if signed[player] ~= state or player.Character ~= state.Character or not EventUtil.IsAlive(player) then
			return
		end
		state.Collected = true
		if not offer.Quiet then
			tell(player, "The Broker collects: " .. offer.Title, plain(offer.FinePrint))
		end
		local collected, why = pcall(offer.Collect, player, state)
		if not collected then
			warn("[Contracts] " .. offer.Id .. " could not be collected: " .. tostring(why))
		end
		-- the shadow keeps reading the trail after it is collected
		if offer.Id == "ShadowStep" then
			local since = os.clock()
			while signed[player] == state and player.Parent and player.Character == state.Character and os.clock() - since < SHADOW_TIME + 1 do
				local root = EventUtil.Root(player)
				if root then
					table.insert(state.Trail, root.Position)
				end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end
	end)
	return true, nil
end

-- a contract belongs to one character: a new one (respawn, round over) wipes it
local function watch(player: Player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		clear(player)
	end)
end
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	watch(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watch)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	clear(player)
	signedThisRound[player] = nil
end)

return Contracts
````

````lua
-- ModuleScript: ServerScriptService > Systems > EventSystem
-- Loads every event module in ServerScriptService > Events, picks random ones,
-- runs them, and cleans up everything they made when they end.
--
-- Event module shape:
--   local Event = {
--       Name = "Gargoyle Attack",
--       Id = "gargoyle",       -- short name for /setevent gargoyle
--       Weight = 1,            -- higher = picked more often
--       Duration = 12,         -- seconds before it's cleaned up
--       Target = "Player",     -- "Player" (hits one alive player) or "Arena"
--   }
--   function Event.Run(context) ... end
--   return Event
--
-- context:
--   Target        the targeted Player (Player events only)
--   TargetPlate   their plate (Player events only)
--   Center        Workspace.Map.Plates.Center
--   Folder        put everything you create in here
--   Trash.Add(x)  Instance / connection / function to clean up when the event ends
--   IsRunning()   false once the event has ended
--   ListenForHits(fn)  fn(player, ...) runs when a client reports something for this event
--   Visuals       client-side visuals (see EventVisuals). Everything spawned is removed when the event ends.
--     Visuals.Spawn(assetName, cframe, props?) -> id    asset = a Model/Part under the event's script
--     Visuals.Circle(position, radius, color?) -> id    flat warning circle
--     Visuals.Move(id, cframe) / Visuals.Tween(id, cframe, time, style?, direction?)
--     Visuals.Call(id, method, ...)                     runs a function in ReplicatedStorage > EventClients > <Id>
--     Visuals.Signal(id, method, ...)                   same, but not replayed for late joiners (for frequent updates)
--     Visuals.Destroy(id)
--
-- Assets: any Models/Parts/Folders under an event's script (or next to it in the Events folder
-- with the same name) are copied to ReplicatedStorage > EventAssets > <Id> at startup, so clients
-- can build them. Keep editing them under the script as usual.
--                      (always validate it on the server before dealing damage)
--
-- Player targeting is weighted by the player's "EventTargetWeight" attribute (default 1),
-- which is how the Doomed feed makes you a more likely target.
-- A player with the "BlackCat" attribute (Black Cat item) gets skipped once.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Systems = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Systems")
local PlateSpawner = require(Systems:WaitForChild("PlateSpawner"))
local EventUtil = require(Systems:WaitForChild("EventUtil"))
local EventVisuals = require(Systems:WaitForChild("EventVisuals"))

local EventSystem = {}

local eventHitRemote = EventUtil.GetRemote("EventHit")
local clientEffectRemote = EventUtil.GetRemote("ClientEffect")

local events = {}
local running = {}
local lastEventName: string? = nil
local eventCounter = 0
local prepared: { Event: any, Target: Player? }? = nil
local hitListeners: { [string]: (Player, ...any) -> () } = {}

local map = workspace:WaitForChild("Map")
local eventObjects = map:FindFirstChild("EventObjects")
if not eventObjects then
	eventObjects = Instance.new("Folder")
	eventObjects.Name = "EventObjects"
	eventObjects.Parent = map
end

-- Copies an event's assets where clients can see them: ReplicatedStorage > EventAssets > <Id>
local eventAssets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("EventAssets")
if not eventAssets then
	eventAssets = Instance.new("Folder")
	eventAssets.Name = "EventAssets"
	eventAssets.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local eventsFolder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Events")

local function mirrorAssets(module: ModuleScript, eventId: string)
	local folder = eventAssets:FindFirstChild(eventId)
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
	end
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = eventId

	local sources = module:GetChildren()
	-- Also allow the asset to sit next to the script, with the same name as it
	for _, sibling in eventsFolder:GetChildren() do
		if sibling ~= module and sibling.Name == module.Name and not sibling:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			table.insert(sources, sibling)
		end
	end
	for _, source in sources do
		if not source:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			source:Clone().Parent = folder
		end
	end
	folder.Parent = eventAssets
end

for _, module in eventsFolder:GetDescendants() do
	if module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, event = pcall(require, module)
		if ok and type(event) == "table" and event.Name and event.Run then
			event.Id = event.Id or module.Name
			table.insert(events, event)
			mirrorAssets(module, event.Id)
		else
			warn("[EventSystem] Couldn't load event " .. module.Name .. ": " .. tostring(event))
		end
	end
end
print(("[EventSystem] Loaded %d events"):format(#events))

-- Clients report hits (or other info, like "I'm looking at the doll") for client-side hazards.
-- Anything after the event name is passed along; validate it in the event.
eventHitRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, eventName, ...)
	if typeof(eventName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local listener = hitListeners[eventName]
	if listener and EventUtil.IsAlive(player) then
		listener(player, ...)
	end
end)

local function newTrash()
	local items = {}
	local trash = {}

	function trash.Add(item)
		table.insert(items, item)
		return item
	end

	function trash.Clean()
		for index = #items, 1, -1 do
			local item = items[index]
			if typeof(item) == "Instance" then
				item:Destroy()
			elseif typeof(item) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
				item:Disconnect()
			elseif type(item) == "function" then
				task.spawn(item)
			end
		end
		table.clear(items)
	end

	return trash
end

local function announce(eventName: string, target: Player?)
	eventCounter += 1
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("ActiveEvent", eventName)
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("ActiveEventTarget", if target then target.DisplayName else "")
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("EventId", eventCounter)
end

local function stopRecord(record)
	if not record.Active then
		return
	end
	record.Active = false
	running[record] = nil

	if record.Thread and coroutine.status(record.Thread) ~= "dead" then
		pcall(task.cancel, record.Thread)
	end
	record.Trash.Clean()

	if ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("ActiveEvent") == record.Event.Name and next(running) == nil then
		ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("ActiveEvent", "")
		ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("ActiveEventTarget", "")
	end
end

local function isValidTarget(player: Player?): boolean
	return player ~= nil and EventUtil.IsAlive(player) and PlateSpawner.GetPlate(player) ~= nil
end

-- Weighted by each player's EventTargetWeight attribute
local function chooseTarget(exclude: Player?): Player?
	local candidates = {}
	local totalWeight = 0
	for _, player in EventUtil.GetAlivePlayers() do
		if player ~= exclude and isValidTarget(player) then
			local weight = player:GetAttribute("EventTargetWeight") or 1
			table.insert(candidates, { Player = player, Weight = weight })
			totalWeight += weight
		end
	end
	if totalWeight <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local roll = math.random() * totalWeight
	for _, candidate in candidates do
		roll -= candidate.Weight
		if roll <= 0 then
			return candidate.Player
		end
	end
	return candidates[#candidates].Player
end

-- Black Cat item: the event picks someone else instead (if anyone else is left)
local function applyBlackCat(target: Player?): Player?
	if target and target:GetAttribute("BlackCat") then
		local replacement = chooseTarget(target)
		if replacement then
			target:SetAttribute("BlackCat", nil)
			print(("[EventSystem] %s's black cat sent the event to %s"):format(target.Name, replacement.Name))
			return replacement
		end
	end
	return target
end

local function isRunning(event): boolean
	for record in running do
		if record.Event == event then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Weighted random event: never the same one twice in a row, and never one that's
-- still running (events overlap now, so e.g. two Last Lights can't fight over the lighting)
local function chooseEvent()
	local pool = {}
	local totalWeight = 0
	for _, event in events do
		if (event.Name ~= lastEventName or #events == 1) and not isRunning(event) then
			table.insert(pool, event)
			totalWeight += event.Weight or 1
		end
	end
	if totalWeight <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local roll = math.random() * totalWeight
	for _, event in pool do
		roll -= event.Weight or 1
		if roll <= 0 then
			return event
		end
	end
	return pool[#pool]
end

-- Starts an event without yielding. Returns its duration, or nil if it couldn't run.
-- Pass a target to force who a Player event hits.
function EventSystem.Run(event, forcedTarget: Player?): number?
	local target: Player? = nil
	local targetPlate: BasePart? = nil

	if event.Target == "Player" then
		target = applyBlackCat(if isValidTarget(forcedTarget) then forcedTarget else chooseTarget())
		if not target then
			return nil
		end
		targetPlate = PlateSpawner.GetPlate(target :: Player)
	end

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = event.Name
	folder.Parent = eventObjects

	local trash = newTrash()
	trash.Add(folder)

	local record = { Event = event, Trash = trash, Active = true, Thread = nil }
	running[record] = true

	local context = {
		Event = event,
		Target = target,
		TargetPlate = targetPlate,
		Center = PlateSpawner.GetCenter(),
		Folder = folder,
		Trash = trash,
		IsRunning = function()
			return record.Active
		end,
		Visuals = nil :: any, -- filled in below
		ListenForHits = function(callback: (Player, ...any) -> ())
			hitListeners[event.Name] = callback
			trash.Add(function()
				if hitListeners[event.Name] == callback then
					hitListeners[event.Name] = nil
				end
			end)
		end,
	}

	-- Client-side visuals, cleaned up automatically when the event ends
	local visuals = {}
	function visuals.Spawn(asset: string, cframe: CFrame, props: { [string]: any }?): number
		local id = EventVisuals.Spawn(event.Id, asset, cframe, props)
		trash.Add(function()
			EventVisuals.Destroy(id)
		end)
		return id
	end
	function visuals.Circle(position: Vector3, radius: number, color: Color3?): number
		return visuals.Spawn("@Circle", CFrame.new(position), { Radius = radius, Color = color })
	end
	visuals.Move = EventVisuals.Move
	visuals.Tween = EventVisuals.Tween
	visuals.Call = EventVisuals.Call
	visuals.Signal = EventVisuals.Signal
	visuals.Destroy = EventVisuals.Destroy
	context.Visuals = visuals

	lastEventName = event.Name
	announce(event.Name, target)
	--print(("[EventSystem] %s%s"):format(event.Name, if target then " -> " .. target.Name else ""))

	record.Thread = task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(event.Run, context)
		if not ok then
			warn(("[EventSystem] %s errored: %s"):format(event.Name, tostring(err)))
		end
	end)

	local duration = event.Duration or 10
	task.delay(duration, stopRecord, record)
	return duration
end

-- Picks the next event (and its target) ahead of time so Sixth Sense can warn people.
-- Safe to call repeatedly; it only picks once until that event runs.
function EventSystem.PrepareNext()
	if prepared then
		return prepared
	end

	local event = chooseEvent()
	if not event then
		return nil
	end

	local target = if event.Target == "Player" then applyBlackCat(chooseTarget()) else nil
	prepared = { Event = event, Target = target }

	-- Sixth Sense: show players who have it which plate is about to get hit
	if target then
		local plate = PlateSpawner.GetPlate(target)
		for _, player in EventUtil.GetAlivePlayers() do
			if player:GetAttribute("SixthSense") then
				clientEffectRemote:FireClient(player, "SixthSense", { Plate = plate, EventName = event.Name })
			end
		end
	end

	return prepared
end

-- Runs the prepared event (or picks one now). Returns its duration.
function EventSystem.RunRandom(): number?
	local nextEvent = prepared or EventSystem.PrepareNext()
	prepared = nil
	if not nextEvent then
		return nil
	end
	return EventSystem.Run(nextEvent.Event, nextEvent.Target)
end

-- Finds an event by its short Id first ("coffin"), then by part of its name or Id
function EventSystem.Find(name: string)
	local search = name:lower():gsub("[%s'_]", "")
	if search == "" then
		return nil
	end
	for _, event in events do
		if event.Id and event.Id:lower() == search then
			return event
		end
	end
	for _, event in events do
		local eventName = event.Name:lower():gsub("[%s']", "")
		local eventId = if event.Id then event.Id:lower() else ""
		if eventName:find(search, 1, true) or eventId:find(search, 1, true) then
			return event
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- "gargoyle (Gargoyle Attack)" for /listevents
function EventSystem.GetEventNames(): { string }
	local names = {}
	for _, event in events do
		table.insert(names, if event.Id then ("%s (%s)"):format(event.Id, event.Name) else event.Name)
	end
	table.sort(names)
	return names
end

-- { { Id = "coffin", Name = "Coffin Rise" }, ... } for the admin panel
function EventSystem.GetEventList(): { { Id: string, Name: string } }
	local list = {}
	for _, event in events do
		table.insert(list, { Id = event.Id or event.Name, Name = event.Name })
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end)
	return list
end

-- Called when a round ends
function EventSystem.StopAll()
	for record in table.clone(running) do
		stopRecord(record)
	end
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("ActiveEvent", "")
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("ActiveEventTarget", "")
	lastEventName = nil
	prepared = nil
end

return EventSystem
````
<<<END SOURCE ServerScriptService/Systems/EventSystem

<<<SOURCE ServerScriptService/Systems/ItemCrates | ModuleScript | 246 lines | [v41] AS DELIVERED IN OCT 12 UPDATE 27 (his Oct 8 export copy + ItemCrates.Spawn (38.4) + chest.Open (43.4)). THE chest: every chest in the game comes from here (EventUtil.Chest).
````lua
-- ModuleScript: ServerScriptService > Systems > ItemCrates
--   The chest model lives in ReplicatedStorage > Assets > Chest (see EventClients > crates).
--
-- Every few events (GameConfig.CrateEvery), item chests drop on random plates: the more
-- players still alive, the more chests (GameConfig.CratesPerPlayer each). Hold E to open one and get a random item from
-- ServerStorage > Items. Chests vanish when their plate breaks, after a while, or when
-- the round ends.
--
-- SERVER: where chests land, who opens them, giving the item.
-- CLIENT (ReplicatedStorage > EventClients > crates): the chest falling, bobbing, opening animation.
--
-- Oct 10 2026 (update 8): ItemCrates.Spawn(position, options) = the same chest anywhere you want one (an event's
-- prize, the top of the Stairway of Spirits ...). Events reach it through EventUtil.Chest. Dropped chests are
-- unchanged.
-- Oct 11 2026 (update 12): a chest from Spawn can be told to open by itself (chest.Open()): The Bidding's prize.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local Systems = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Systems")
local EventUtil = require(Systems:WaitForChild("EventUtil"))
local EventVisuals = require(Systems:WaitForChild("EventVisuals"))
local PlateSpawner = require(Systems:WaitForChild("PlateSpawner"))

local VISUAL_ID = "crates"
local DROP_HEIGHT = 40
local DROP_TIME = 0.6
local LIFETIME = 40
local OPEN_TIME = 2 -- how long the opened chest stays (opening animation + fade)

local ItemCrates = {}

-- Copy any model under this module to where clients can see it
-- (not needed for the Chest, which is already in ReplicatedStorage > Assets)
do
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("EventAssets")
	if not assets then
		assets = Instance.new("Folder")
		assets.Name = "EventAssets"
		assets.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	local old = assets:FindFirstChild(VISUAL_ID)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = VISUAL_ID
	for _, child in script:GetChildren() do
		if not child:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			child:Clone().Parent = folder
		end
	end
	folder.Parent = assets
end

local serverFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
serverFolder.Name = "ItemCrates"
serverFolder.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild("Map")

type Crate = { Visual: number, Anchor: BasePart, Plate: BasePart?, Expires: number, Options: { [string]: any }? }
local crates: { Crate } = {}

local function getItemPool(): { Tool }
	local pool = {}
	local folder = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Items", true)
	for _, item in if folder then folder:GetDescendants() else {} do
		if item:IsA("Tool") then
			table.insert(pool, item)
		end
	end
	return pool
end

local function removeCrate(crate: Crate, opened: boolean)
	local index = table.find(crates, crate)
	if not index then
		return
	end
	table.remove(crates, index)
	crate.Anchor:Destroy()
	if opened then
		EventVisuals.Call(crate.Visual, "Open")
		task.delay(OPEN_TIME, EventVisuals.Destroy, crate.Visual)
	else
		EventVisuals.Destroy(crate.Visual)
	end
end

-- One chest standing at `landed` (the bottom middle of the chest). plate = the plate it is on (nil = not on one).
local function addCrate(landed: CFrame, plate: BasePart?, pool: { Tool }, options: { [string]: any }?): Crate
	local ground = landed.Position
	local drop = not (options and options.Drop == false)
	local visual: number
	if drop then
		visual = EventVisuals.Spawn(VISUAL_ID, "Chest", landed + Vector3.new(0, DROP_HEIGHT, 0))
		EventVisuals.Tween(visual, landed, DROP_TIME, "Quad", "In")
	else
		visual = EventVisuals.Spawn(VISUAL_ID, "Chest", landed)
	end

	local objectText = if options and type(options.Name) == "string" then options.Name else "Chest"
	local anchor, prompt = EventUtil.MakePrompt(ground + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), "Open", objectText, 0.3, serverFolder)
	prompt.Enabled = false
	task.delay(if drop then DROP_TIME else 0.1, function()
		if prompt.Parent then
			prompt.Enabled = true
		end
	end)

	local lifetime = if options and type(options.Lifetime) == "number" then options.Lifetime else LIFETIME
	local crate: Crate = { Visual = visual, Anchor = anchor, Plate = plate, Expires = os.clock() + lifetime, Options = options }
	table.insert(crates, crate)

	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		if not table.find(crates, crate) or player:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= true then
			return
		end
		if options and type(options.CanOpen) == "function" then
			local ok, allowed = pcall(options.CanOpen, player)
			if not ok or not allowed then
				return
			end
		end
		local itemName: string? = nil
		if not (options and options.NoItem) then
			local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			if not backpack or #pool == 0 then
				return
			end
			local item = pool[math.random(#pool)]:Clone()
			item.Parent = backpack
			itemName = item.Name
			EventUtil.Notify(player, objectText, "You found a " .. item.Name .. ".", Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 140))
		end
		removeCrate(crate, true)
		if options and type(options.OnOpened) == "function" then
			task.spawn(options.OnOpened, player, itemName)
		end
	end)
	return crate
end

local function spawnCrate(plate: BasePart, pool: { Tool })
	local halfX, halfZ = plate.Size.X / 2 - 2.5, plate.Size.Z / 2 - 2.5
	local ground = plate.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new((math.random() * 2 - 1) * halfX, 0, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * halfZ))
	ground = Vector3.new(ground.X, EventUtil.GetPlateTop(plate), ground.Z)
	addCrate(CFrame.new(ground) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.random() * math.pi * 2, 0), plate, pool, nil)
end

-- The same chest, wherever you want one. position = the spot it stands on (its bottom middle).
-- options (all optional):
--   Plate    = a plate: the chest goes when that plate breaks (like a dropped chest)
--   Lifetime = seconds until it disappears if nobody opens it (default 40)
--   Drop     = false: it is simply there (default: it falls out of the sky like the others)
--   Name     = what the prompt and the "You found a ..." toast call it (default "Chest")
--   Yaw      = which way it faces, in radians (default: random)
--   CanOpen  = function(player) -> boolean: who may open it (default: anyone alive)
--   OnOpened = function(player, itemName?): runs after it was opened (the item, if any, is already theirs)
--   NoItem   = true: no item comes out of it (OnOpened decides what they get)
-- Returns the chest: chest.Remove() takes it away, chest.IsOpen() is true once somebody opened it, chest.Open()
-- makes it open by itself (its own opening animation, then it goes; nobody gets anything from that).
-- nil when there are no items in ServerStorage > Items (and NoItem is not set).
function ItemCrates.Spawn(position: Vector3, options: { [string]: any }?): { Remove: () -> (), IsOpen: () -> boolean, Open: () -> () }?
	local pool = getItemPool()
	if #pool == 0 and not (options and options.NoItem) then
		warn("[ItemCrates] No items found. Put the item tools in ServerStorage > Items")
		return nil
	end
	local settings: { [string]: any } = if options then table.clone(options) else {}
	local yaw = if type(settings.Yaw) == "number" then settings.Yaw else math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local plate = if typeof(settings.Plate) == "Instance" and settings.Plate:IsA("BasePart") then settings.Plate else nil
	local opened = false
	local userOpened = settings.OnOpened
	settings.OnOpened = function(player: Player, itemName: string?)
		opened = true
		if type(userOpened) == "function" then
			userOpened(player, itemName)
		end
	end
	local crate = addCrate(CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0), plate, pool, settings)
	return {
		Remove = function()
			removeCrate(crate, false)
		end,
		IsOpen = function(): boolean
			return opened
		end,
		Open = function()
			removeCrate(crate, true)
		end,
	}
end

-- Drops chests on random plates (one per plate at most).
-- With no count, it's CratesPerPlayer for every player still alive.
function ItemCrates.Drop(count: number?)
	local pool = getItemPool()
	if #pool == 0 then
		warn("[ItemCrates] No items found. Put the item tools in ServerStorage > Items")
		return 0
	end

	local alive = 0
	for _, player in game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers() do
		if player:GetAttribute("Alive") == true then
			alive += 1
		end
	end
	local amount = count or math.ceil(alive * GameConfig.CratesPerPlayer)

	local plates = PlateSpawner.GetAllPlates()
	for i = #plates, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		plates[i], plates[j] = plates[j], plates[i]
	end
	amount = math.min(amount, #plates)
	for index = 1, amount do
		spawnCrate(plates[index], pool)
	end
	return amount
end

-- Removes every chest (end of round)
function ItemCrates.ClearAll()
	for _, crate in table.clone(crates) do
		removeCrate(crate, false)
	end
end

-- Chests on broken plates, or left too long, disappear
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.5)
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, crate in table.clone(crates) do
			local plate = crate.Plate
			if (plate and not plate.Parent) or now > crate.Expires then
				removeCrate(crate, false)
			end
		end
	end
end)

return ItemCrates
````

````lua
local function optional(name: string): any
	local module = Shared:FindFirstChild(name)

do
	local module = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Utility")
	if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
		if ok then
			Utility = result
		else
			warn("[TarotClient] ReplicatedStorage > Utility couldn't be loaded, so the draw has no screen effects: " .. tostring(result))
		end
	end
end

local C = UIKit.Colors
local make, corner, stroke, gradient, bigText = UIKit.make, UIKit.corner, UIKit.stroke, UIKit.gradient, UIKit.bigText
local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(214, 172, 92)
local GOLD_LIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(248, 226, 164)
local CRIMSON = Color3.fromRGB(200, 34, 46)
local BACK_TOP, BACK_BOTTOM = Color3.fromRGB(70, 14, 20), Color3.fromRGB(18, 6, 8)
local BACK_EDGE = GOLD
local UPRIGHT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(240, 206, 120) -- upright = gold
local REVERSED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(226, 72, 68)  -- reversed = red
local SOFT = Color3.fromRGB(232, 214, 196)
local DIM = Color3.fromRGB(150, 124, 110)
local INK = Color3.fromRGB(214, 170, 96)
local ACTIVE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) -- the side bar's red (under the mouse / open)
local GHOST_GREY = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 170)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Tarot") :: RemoteEvent

local gui = make("ScreenGui", { Name = "TarotGui", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 54, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, Parent = playerGui })

local warned: { [string]: boolean } = {}
local function warnOnce(key: string, text: string)
	if not warned[key] then
		warned[key] = true
		warn("[TarotClient] " .. text)
	end
end

local function toast(title: string, text: string?)
	if Toast then
		Toast.Show(title, text, INK)
	end
end

local function asset(id: any): string
	local text = tostring(id or "")
	if text == "" or text == "0" then
		return ""
	end
	return if tonumber(text) then "rbxassetid://" .. text else text
end

-- a sound from the settings above (speed / volume optional); returns it so it can be bent while it plays
local SOUND_SECONDS = 1.5 -- every tarot sound starts fading after this many seconds
local SOUND_FADE = 0.4    -- how long the fade-out takes
local function playSound(id: string, volume: number?, speed: number?, looped: boolean?): Sound?
	local soundId = asset(id)
	if soundId == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.Volume = volume or 0.6
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed or 1
	sound.Looped = looped == true
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	sound:Play()
	task.delay(SOUND_SECONDS, function()
		if sound.Parent then
			TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(SOUND_FADE), { Volume = 0 }):Play()
			task.delay(SOUND_FADE, function()
				sound:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end)
	return sound
end

local function flipSound()
	playSound(FLIP_SOUND, 0.6)
end

local function label(parent: Instance, props: { [string]: any }): TextLabel
	local textLabel = make("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = UIKit.Font, TextColor3 = SOFT, TextSize = 15, TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Parent = parent,
	})
	for key, value in props do
		(textLabel :: any)[key] = value
	end
	return textLabel
end

local function tween(object: Instance, time: number, props: { [string]: any }, style: Enum.EasingStyle?, direction: Enum.EasingDirection?): Tween
	local t = TweenService:Create(object, TweenInfo.new(time, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	t:Play()
	return t
end

-- may this player see bright flashes? (Settings > Disable flashing lights)
local function canFlash(): boolean
	if Utility and Utility.CanFlash then
		return Utility.CanFlash()
	end
	return player:GetAttribute("Setting_DisableFlashing") ~= true
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------- a card (a clone of the Card under this script)
type Card = {
	Frame: Frame, Full: UDim2, Back: GuiObject, Face: GuiObject, Numeral: TextLabel?, Art: ImageLabel?, Seal: GuiObject?,
	SealText: TextLabel?, SealRing: UIStroke?, Name: TextLabel?, Glow: GuiObject?, Shine: GuiObject?, Busy: number,
	Shown: string?,
}

local cardTemplate: GuiObject? = nil
do
	local found = script:FindFirstChild("Card")
	if found and found:IsA("GuiObject") then
		cardTemplate = found
	else
		warnOnce("card", "StarterPlayerScripts > TarotClient > Card (the picture of a card) is missing: install the update again, always the WHOLE file. Cards are plain until then.")
	end
end
local BACK_IMAGE, FACE_IMAGE = asset(CARD_BACK), asset(CARD_FACE)

-- (only when the Card is missing: a plain card, so nothing breaks)
local function plainCard(): Frame
	local frame = make("Frame", { Name = "Card", BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	local back = make("Frame", { Name = "Back", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Parent = frame })
	corner(back, UDim.new(0.07, 0))
	gradient(back, BACK_TOP, BACK_BOTTOM)
	stroke(back, BACK_EDGE, 2)
	local face = make("Frame", { Name = "Face", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 16, 18), Visible = false, Parent = frame })
	corner(face, UDim.new(0.07, 0))
	stroke(face, BACK_EDGE, 2)
	bigText({ Name = "Numeral", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.045), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.1), TextScaled = true, Text = "", Parent = face })
	bigText({ Name = "Name", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.955), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.09), TextScaled = true, Text = "", Parent = face })
	return frame
end

-- your uploaded picture on one side of a card (else the frames drawn in the Card show)
local function setSideImage(side: Instance?, image: string)
	if not side then
		return
	end
	local picture = side:FindFirstChild("Image")
	local plain = side:FindFirstChild("Plain")
	if picture and picture:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		picture.Image = image
		picture.Visible = image ~= ""
	end
	if plain and plain:IsA("GuiObject") then
		plain.Visible = image == ""
	end
end

local function newCard(parent: Instance, width: number, height: number, position: UDim2?): Card
	local frame = (if cardTemplate then cardTemplate:Clone() else plainCard()) :: Frame
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.Position = position or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
	frame.Visible = true
	-- (the lines are drawn for a 150 px card: thinner on a small one, thicker on a big one)
	local k = width / 150
	for _, item in frame:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("UIStroke") then
			item.Thickness = math.max(1, item.Thickness * k)
		end
	end
	frame.Parent = parent
	local back = frame:FindFirstChild("Back") :: GuiObject
	local face = frame:FindFirstChild("Face") :: GuiObject
	setSideImage(back, BACK_IMAGE)
	setSideImage(face, FACE_IMAGE)
	local seal = face and face:FindFirstChild("Seal")
	return {
		Frame = frame, Full = frame.Size, Back = back, Face = face,
		Numeral = face and face:FindFirstChild("Numeral") :: any, Art = face and face:FindFirstChild("Art") :: any,
		Seal = seal :: any, SealText = seal and seal:FindFirstChild("SealText") :: any, SealRing = seal and seal:FindFirstChild("Ring") :: any,
		Name = face and face:FindFirstChild("Name") :: any, Glow = frame:FindFirstChild("Glow") :: any,
		Shine = face and face:FindFirstChild("Shine") :: any, Busy = 0, Shown = nil,
	}
end

local function showBack(card: Card)
	card.Back.Visible = true
	card.Face.Visible = false
	card.Shown = "back"
end

-- a reversed card isn't turned upside down (it stays readable): its numeral and its name just swap ends, and only the
-- frame picture of the face (your CARD_FACE) is turned over, so the name sits in the wide plaque again
local function layout(card: Card, upright: boolean)
	local frameArt = card.Face and card.Face:FindFirstChild("Image")
	if frameArt and frameArt:IsA("GuiObject") then
		frameArt.Rotation = if upright then 0 else 180
	end
	if card.Numeral then
		card.Numeral.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, if upright then 0 else 1)
		card.Numeral.Position = if upright then UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.045) else UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.955)
	end
	if card.Name then
		card.Name.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, if upright then 1 else 0)
		card.Name.Position = if upright then UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.955) else UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.045)
	end
end

local function showFace(card: Card, id: string, upright: boolean)
	local def = TarotConfig.Get(id)
	if not def then
		return
	end
	card.Back.Visible = false
	card.Face.Visible = true
	if card.Numeral then
		card.Numeral.Text = def.Numeral
	end
	if card.Name then
		card.Name.Text = string.upper(def.Name)
	end
	if card.SealRing then
		card.SealRing.Color = if upright then def.Color:Lerp(GOLD, 0.35) else CRIMSON
	end
	local art = asset(def.Art)
	if card.Art then
		card.Art.Image = art
		card.Art.Visible = art ~= ""
	end
	if card.Seal then
		card.Seal.Visible = art == ""
	end
	if card.SealText then
		card.SealText.Text = def.Numeral
	end
	layout(card, upright)
	card.Shown = id .. (if upright then "+" else "-")
end

-- a ghost flip's card (not one of the 22)
local function showMinor(card: Card, name: string)
	card.Back.Visible = false
	card.Face.Visible = true
	if card.Numeral then
		card.Numeral.Text = ""
	end
	if card.Art then
		card.Art.Visible = false
	end
	if card.Seal then
		card.Seal.Visible = true
	end
	if card.SealRing then
		card.SealRing.Color = GHOST_GREY
	end
	if card.SealText then
		card.SealText.Text = "?"
	end
	if card.Name then
		card.Name.Text = string.upper(name)
	end
	layout(card, true)
	card.Shown = "minor"
end

-- turns the card over: it narrows to nothing, `toOtherSide` swaps what's showing, and it widens again
local function flip(card: Card, toOtherSide: () -> ())
	card.Busy += 1
	local token = card.Busy
	local full = card.Full
	flipSound()
	TweenService:Create(card.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, full.Y.Scale, full.Y.Offset) }):Play()
	task.delay(0.16, function()
		if card.Busy ~= token then
			return
		end
		toOtherSide()
		TweenService:Create(card.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = full }):Play()
	end)
end

-- the light behind a card (colour, or nil = off)
local function glowCard(card: Card, color: Color3?)
	local glow = card.Glow
	if not glow then
		return
	end
	glow.Visible = color ~= nil
	if color then
		for _, halo in glow:GetChildren() do
			if halo:IsA("GuiObject") then
				halo.BackgroundColor3 = color
			end
		end
	end
end

-- a streak of light across the face
local function shine(card: Card, time: number?)
	local streak = card.Shine
	local sweep = streak and streak:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	if not (streak and sweep) then
		return
	end
	streak.Visible = true
	sweep.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
	local t = tween(sweep, time or 0.55, { Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	t.Completed:Once(function()
		streak.Visible = false
	end)
end

-- an X in the cards' colours (dark red, dull gold edge) for the top right corner of a panel; red under the mouse
local function closeButton(parent: Instance): TextButton
	local x = make("TextButton", {
		Name = "Close", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", ZIndex = 6, Parent = parent,
	})
	corner(x, UDim.new(0, 8))
	gradient(x, BACK_TOP, BACK_BOTTOM)
	local edge = stroke(x, BACK_EDGE, 2)
	edge.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	local mark = bigText({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), TextSize = 20, Text = "X", ZIndex = 7, Parent = x })
	local white = mark.TextColor3
	local function paint(hot: boolean)
		edge.Color = if hot then ACTIVE else BACK_EDGE
		mark.TextColor3 = if hot then ACTIVE else white
	end
	x.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		paint(true)
	end)
	x.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		paint(false)
	end)
	x.Activated:Connect(function()
		paint(false)
	end)
	return x
end

-- shrinks a panel on short screens (phones) so it still fits above the little card
local function fit(height: number): number
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local screen = if camera then camera.ViewportSize.Y else 720
	return math.clamp((screen - CARD_BOTTOM - 160) / height, 0.45, 1)
end

local hint = label(widget, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 340), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 44), TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = DIM, Text = "" })

local mode = "none"         -- "draw", "card", "ghost", "rest", "none"
local drawing = false       -- waiting for the server's card
local flipsLeft = 0
local readingUntil = 0
local ghostShowing = false  -- a flipped ghost card is face up for a moment
local widgetOpen = false    -- the little card next to AFK opens / closes the panel (closed at first, so it takes no room)
local refresh: () -> () = function() end

-- THE LITTLE CARD, in its own ScreenGui set up like the side bar's (IgnoreGuiInset) so it lines up with the AFK button
local cardGui = make("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "TarotCardGui", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 53, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	Parent = playerGui,
})
local opener = make("Frame", {
	Name = "TarotCard", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -CARD_RIGHT, 1, -CARD_BOTTOM),
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 54), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = cardGui,
})
local openerScale = make("UIScale", { Parent = opener })
local openerCard = newCard(opener, 38, 54)
-- the rim: red under the mouse / while the panel is open (like the side bar), gold while a draw waits for you
local rim = make("Frame", {
	Name = "Rim", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 6, 1, 6),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 4, Parent = opener,
})
corner(rim, UDim.new(0, 7))
local rimStroke = stroke(rim, ACTIVE, 2, 1)
local pip = make("Frame", {
	Name = "Waiting", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -3, 0, 3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13),
	BackgroundColor3 = INK, Visible = false, ZIndex = 6, Parent = opener,
})
corner(pip, UDim.new(0.5, 0))
stroke(pip, Color3.fromRGB(20, 8, 10), 2)
TweenService:Create(pip, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }):Play()
local openerClick = make("TextButton", { Name = "Click", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", ZIndex = 7, Parent = opener })
local hovering = false
local inviting = false      -- a draw is waiting: the little card glows and wiggles
local function paintOpener()
	if hovering or widgetOpen then
		rimStroke.Color = ACTIVE
		rimStroke.Transparency = 0
	elseif inviting then
		rimStroke.Color = GOLD_LIGHT
		rimStroke.Transparency = 0.15
	else
		rimStroke.Transparency = 1
	end
end
local function hover(on: boolean)
	hovering = on
	paintOpener()
	TweenService:Create(openerScale, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { Scale = if on then 1.12 else 1 }):Play()
end
openerClick.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
	hover(true)
end)
openerClick.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
	hover(false)
end)

-- the invitation: while a draw waits, the little card's light pulses and it gives a little wiggle now and then
local inviteTweens: { Tween } = {}
local function setInviting(on: boolean)
	if on == inviting then
		return
	end
	inviting = on
	for _, t in inviteTweens do
		t:Cancel()
	end
	table.clear(inviteTweens)
	glowCard(openerCard, if on then GOLD else nil)
	if on and openerCard.Glow then
		for _, halo in openerCard.Glow:GetChildren() do
			if halo:IsA("GuiObject") then
				local base = halo.BackgroundTransparency
				local t = TweenService:Create(halo, TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, base + 0.08) })
				t:Play()
				table.insert(inviteTweens, t)
			end
		end
	end
	paintOpener()
end
task.spawn(function()
	while opener.Parent do
		task.wait(2.4)
		if inviting and not hovering then
			local frame = openerCard.Frame
			tween(frame, 0.08, { Rotation = -9 })
			task.wait(0.08)
			tween(frame, 0.12, { Rotation = 8 })
			task.wait(0.12)
			tween(frame, 0.22, { Rotation = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		end
	end
end)

bigText({
````
